verses.1CH 15:3: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the LORD’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.1CH 15:4: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
verses.1CH 15:15: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to the LORD’s word.
verses.1CH 15:16: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.
verses.1CH 16:1: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
verses.1CH 16:2: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD’s name.
verses.1CH 29:10: Therefore David blessed the LORD before all the assembly; and David said, “You are blessed, LORD, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.
verses.1CH 29:11: Yours, LORD, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and on the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, LORD, and you are exalted as head above all.
verses.1CH 29:12: Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all!
verses.1CO 10:1: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
verses.1CO 10:2: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
verses.1CO 10:3: and all ate the same spiritual food;
verses.1CO 10:4: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.
verses.1CO 10:5: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
verses.1CO 10:6: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.
verses.1CO 10:10: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.
verses.1CO 10:11: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.
verses.1CO 10:12: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.
verses.1CO 10:14: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
verses.1CO 10:15: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.
verses.1CO 10:16: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?
verses.1CO 10:17: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.
verses.1CO 10:18: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?
verses.1CO 10:19: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
verses.1CO 10:20: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.
verses.1CO 10:21: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.
verses.1CO 10:22: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?
verses.1CO 10:31: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
verses.1CO 10:32: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;
verses.1CO 10:33: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.
verses.1CO 11:1: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.
verses.1CO 11:17: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.
verses.1CO 11:18: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.
verses.1CO 11:19: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.
verses.1CO 11:20: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.
verses.1CO 11:21: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.
verses.1CO 11:22: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.
verses.1CO 11:23: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.
verses.1CO 11:24: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”
verses.1CO 11:25: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”
verses.1CO 11:26: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.
verses.1CO 12:12: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
verses.1CO 12:13: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.
verses.1CO 12:14: For the body is not one member, but many.
verses.1CO 12:27: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
verses.1CO 12:28: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.
verses.1CO 12:29: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?
verses.1CO 12:30: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?
verses.1CO 12:31: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
verses.1CO 12:15: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.
verses.1CO 12:16: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.
verses.1CO 12:17: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?
verses.1CO 12:18: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.
verses.1CO 12:19: If they were all one member, where would the body be?
verses.1CO 12:20: But now they are many members, but one body.
verses.1CO 12:21: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
verses.1CO 12:22: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.
verses.1CO 12:23: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,
verses.1CO 12:24: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,
verses.1CO 12:25: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
verses.1CO 12:26: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
verses.1CO 13:1: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.
verses.1CO 13:2: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.
verses.1CO 13:3: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.
verses.1CO 13:4: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
verses.1CO 13:5: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;
verses.1CO 13:6: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;
verses.1CO 13:7: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.
verses.1CO 13:8: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.
verses.1CO 13:9: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;
verses.1CO 13:10: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.
verses.1CO 13:11: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.
verses.1CO 13:12: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.
verses.1CO 13:13: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
verses.1CO 12:3: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.
verses.1CO 12:4: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.
verses.1CO 12:5: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.
verses.1CO 12:6: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.
verses.1CO 12:7: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.
verses.1CO 12:8: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,
verses.1CO 12:9: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,
verses.1CO 12:10: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.
verses.1CO 12:11: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.
verses.1CO 15:1: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,
verses.1CO 15:2: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.
verses.1CO 15:3: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
verses.1CO 15:4: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
verses.1CO 15:5: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.
verses.1CO 15:6: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.
verses.1CO 15:7: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,
verses.1CO 15:8: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.
verses.1CO 15:9: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.
verses.1CO 15:10: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
verses.1CO 15:11: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.
verses.1CO 15:12: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
verses.1CO 15:16: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.
verses.1CO 15:17: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.
verses.1CO 15:18: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
verses.1CO 15:19: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.
verses.1CO 15:20: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.
verses.1CO 15:13: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.
verses.1CO 15:14: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.
verses.1CO 15:15: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.
verses.1CO 15:21: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.
verses.1CO 15:22: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
verses.1CO 15:23: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.
verses.1CO 15:24: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.
verses.1CO 15:25: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
verses.1CO 15:26: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.
verses.1CO 15:28: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.
verses.1CO 15:35: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”
verses.1CO 15:36: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.
verses.1CO 15:37: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.
verses.1CO 15:42: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.
verses.1CO 15:43: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
verses.1CO 15:44: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.
verses.1CO 15:45: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
verses.1CO 15:46: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.
verses.1CO 15:47: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.
verses.1CO 15:48: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
verses.1CO 15:49: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.
verses.1CO 15:51: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,
verses.1CO 15:52: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.
verses.1CO 15:53: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.
verses.1CO 15:54: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”
verses.1CO 15:55: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”
verses.1CO 15:56: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
verses.1CO 15:57: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.1CO 15:58: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
verses.1CO 1:1: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,
verses.1CO 1:2: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:
verses.1CO 1:3: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.1CO 1:4: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,
verses.1CO 1:5: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—
verses.1CO 1:6: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—
verses.1CO 1:7: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.1CO 1:8: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.1CO 1:9: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.1CO 1:10: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
verses.1CO 1:11: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.
verses.1CO 1:12: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”
verses.1CO 1:13: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?
verses.1CO 1:17: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.
verses.1CO 1:18: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
verses.1CO 1:19: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”
verses.1CO 1:20: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
verses.1CO 1:21: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.
verses.1CO 1:22: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,
verses.1CO 1:23: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,
verses.1CO 1:24: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;
verses.1CO 1:25: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
verses.1CO 1:26: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;
verses.1CO 1:27: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.
verses.1CO 1:28: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,
verses.1CO 1:29: that no flesh should boast before God.
verses.1CO 1:30: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,
verses.1CO 1:31: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
verses.1CO 2:1: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.
verses.1CO 2:2: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.
verses.1CO 2:3: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.
verses.1CO 2:4: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,
verses.1CO 2:5: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
verses.1CO 2:6: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.
verses.1CO 2:7: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,
verses.1CO 2:8: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.
verses.1CO 2:9: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”
verses.1CO 2:10: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.
verses.1CO 2:11: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.
verses.1CO 2:12: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.
verses.1CO 2:13: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.
verses.1CO 2:14: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
verses.1CO 2:15: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.
verses.1CO 2:16: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.
verses.1CO 3:1: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.
verses.1CO 3:2: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,
verses.1CO 3:3: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?
verses.1CO 3:4: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?
verses.1CO 3:5: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?
verses.1CO 3:6: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
verses.1CO 3:7: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.
verses.1CO 3:8: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.
verses.1CO 3:9: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.
verses.1CO 3:16: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?
verses.1CO 3:17: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.
verses.1CO 3:18: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.
verses.1CO 3:19: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”
verses.1CO 3:20: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”
verses.1CO 3:21: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,
verses.1CO 3:22: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,
verses.1CO 3:23: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.
verses.1CO 3:10: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.
verses.1CO 3:11: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.
verses.1CO 4:1: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.
verses.1CO 4:2: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
verses.1CO 4:3: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.
verses.1CO 4:4: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.
verses.1CO 4:5: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.
verses.1CO 4:6: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.
verses.1CO 4:7: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?
verses.1CO 4:8: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!
verses.1CO 4:9: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.
verses.1CO 4:10: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.
verses.1CO 4:11: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.
verses.1CO 4:12: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.
verses.1CO 4:13: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.
verses.1CO 4:14: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
verses.1CO 4:15: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.
verses.1CO 5:1: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.
verses.1CO 5:2: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.
verses.1CO 5:3: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.
verses.1CO 5:4: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.1CO 5:5: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
verses.1CO 5:6: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?
verses.1CO 5:7: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.
verses.1CO 5:8: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
verses.1CO 6:1: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?
verses.1CO 6:2: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
verses.1CO 6:3: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?
verses.1CO 6:4: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?
verses.1CO 6:5: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?
verses.1CO 6:6: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!
verses.1CO 6:7: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?
verses.1CO 6:8: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.
verses.1CO 6:9: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,
verses.1CO 6:10: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.
verses.1CO 6:11: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.
verses.1CO 6:13: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
verses.1CO 6:14: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.
verses.1CO 6:15: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!
verses.1CO 6:17: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.
verses.1CO 6:18: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.
verses.1CO 6:19: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,
verses.1CO 6:20: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
verses.1CO 7:25: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.
verses.1CO 7:26: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.
verses.1CO 7:27: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.
verses.1CO 7:28: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.
verses.1CO 7:29: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;
verses.1CO 7:30: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;
verses.1CO 7:31: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.
verses.1CO 7:32: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;
verses.1CO 7:33: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.
verses.1CO 7:34: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.
verses.1CO 7:35: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.
verses.1CO 8:1: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
verses.1CO 8:2: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.
verses.1CO 8:3: But anyone who loves God is known by him.
verses.1CO 8:4: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.
verses.1CO 8:5: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—
verses.1CO 8:6: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.
verses.1CO 8:7: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.
verses.1CO 8:11: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.
verses.1CO 8:12: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.
verses.1CO 8:13: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.
verses.1CO 9:16: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.
verses.1CO 9:17: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.
verses.1CO 9:18: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.
verses.1CO 9:19: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.
verses.1CO 9:22: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.
verses.1CO 9:23: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.
verses.1CO 9:24: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.
verses.1CO 9:25: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.
verses.1CO 9:26: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,
verses.1CO 9:27: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.
verses.1JO 1:1: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life
verses.1JO 1:2: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);
verses.1JO 1:3: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
verses.1JO 1:4: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.
verses.1JO 1:5: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
verses.1JO 1:6: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.
verses.1JO 1:7: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.
verses.1JO 1:8: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
verses.1JO 1:9: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.1JO 1:10: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
verses.1JO 2:1: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
verses.1JO 2:2: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
verses.1JO 2:3: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
verses.1JO 2:4: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
verses.1JO 2:5: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:
verses.1JO 2:12: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
verses.1JO 2:13: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.
verses.1JO 2:14: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
verses.1JO 2:15: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
verses.1JO 2:16: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
verses.1JO 2:17: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
verses.1JO 2:18: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
verses.1JO 2:19: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
verses.1JO 2:20: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
verses.1JO 2:21: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
verses.1JO 2:22: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
verses.1JO 2:23: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
verses.1JO 2:24: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
verses.1JO 2:25: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
verses.1JO 2:26: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
verses.1JO 2:27: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
verses.1JO 2:28: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
verses.1JO 2:29: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
verses.1JO 3:1: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
verses.1JO 3:2: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
verses.1JO 3:3: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
verses.1JO 3:4: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
verses.1JO 3:5: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.
verses.1JO 3:6: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.
verses.1JO 2:6: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
verses.1JO 2:7: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
verses.1JO 2:8: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.
verses.1JO 2:9: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
verses.1JO 2:10: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
verses.1JO 2:11: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
verses.1JO 3:21: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;
verses.1JO 3:22: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
verses.1JO 3:23: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.
verses.1JO 3:24: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
verses.1JO 3:11: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—
verses.1JO 3:12: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
verses.1JO 3:13: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
verses.1JO 3:14: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.
verses.1JO 3:15: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
verses.1JO 3:16: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
verses.1JO 3:17: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
verses.1JO 3:18: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
verses.1JO 3:19: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,
verses.1JO 3:20: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
verses.1JO 4:1: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
verses.1JO 4:2: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,
verses.1JO 4:3: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.
verses.1JO 4:4: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
verses.1JO 4:5: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
verses.1JO 4:6: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
verses.1JO 3:7: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
verses.1JO 3:8: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
verses.1JO 3:9: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
verses.1JO 3:10: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
verses.1JO 4:10: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
verses.1JO 4:11: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
verses.1JO 4:12: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
verses.1JO 4:13: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
verses.1JO 4:14: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.
verses.1JO 4:15: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.
verses.1JO 4:16: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
verses.1JO 4:17: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.
verses.1JO 4:18: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
verses.1JO 4:19: We love him, because he first loved us.
verses.1JO 4:20: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
verses.1JO 4:21: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.
verses.1JO 5:1: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.
verses.1JO 5:2: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
verses.1JO 5:3: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.
verses.1JO 5:4: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
verses.1JO 4:7: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
verses.1JO 4:8: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
verses.1JO 4:9: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
verses.1JO 5:5: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
verses.1JO 5:6: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
verses.1JO 5:7: For there are three who testify:
verses.1JO 5:8: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.
verses.1JO 5:9: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.
verses.1JO 5:14: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
verses.1JO 5:15: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
verses.1JO 5:16: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.
verses.1JO 5:17: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.
verses.1JO 5:18: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.
verses.1JO 5:19: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
verses.1JO 5:20: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
verses.1JO 5:21: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
verses.1JO 5:10: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.
verses.1JO 5:11: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
verses.1JO 5:12: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
verses.1JO 5:13: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
verses.1KI 10:1: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the LORD’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.
verses.1KI 10:2: She came to Jerusalem with a very great caravan, with camels that bore spices, very much gold, and precious stones; and when she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.
verses.1KI 10:3: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from the king which he didn’t tell her.
verses.1KI 10:4: When the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
verses.1KI 10:5: the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.
verses.1KI 10:6: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.
verses.1KI 10:7: However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.
verses.1KI 10:8: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom.
verses.1KI 10:9: Blessed is the LORD your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because the LORD loved Israel forever, therefore he made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”
verses.1KI 10:10: She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
verses.1KI 11:29: At that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the way. Now Ahijah had clad himself with a new garment; and the two of them were alone in the field.
verses.1KI 11:30: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.
verses.1KI 11:31: He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you
verses.1KI 11:32: (but he shall have one tribe, for my servant David’s sake and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel),
verses.1KI 12:19: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.
verses.1KI 11:4: When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father was.
verses.1KI 11:5: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.1KI 11:6: Solomon did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and didn’t go fully after the LORD, as David his father did.
verses.1KI 11:7: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, on the mountain that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon.
verses.1KI 11:8: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.
verses.1KI 11:9: The LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,
verses.1KI 11:10: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which the LORD commanded.
verses.1KI 11:11: Therefore the LORD said to Solomon, “Because this is done by you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.
verses.1KI 11:12: Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father’s sake; but I will tear it out of your son’s hand.
verses.1KI 11:13: However, I will not tear away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to your son, for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.”
verses.1KI 12:26: Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom will return to David’s house.
verses.1KI 12:27: If this people goes up to offer sacrifices in the LORD’s house at Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn again to their lord, even to Rehoboam king of Judah; and they will kill me, and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.”
verses.1KI 12:28: So the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold; and he said to them, “It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Look and behold your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”
verses.1KI 12:29: He set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.
verses.1KI 12:30: This thing became a sin, for the people went even as far as Dan to worship before the one there.
verses.1KI 12:31: He made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.
verses.1KI 12:32: Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he went up to the altar. He did so in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made, and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.
verses.1KI 13:33: After this thing, Jeroboam didn’t turn from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.
verses.1KI 13:34: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.
verses.1KI 17:1: Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.”
verses.1KI 17:2: Then the LORD’s word came to him, saying,
verses.1KI 17:3: “Go away from here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.
verses.1KI 17:4: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”
verses.1KI 17:5: So he went and did according to the LORD’s word, for he went and lived by the brook Cherith that is before the Jordan.
verses.1KI 17:6: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.
verses.1KI 17:10: So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and said, “Please get me a little water in a jar, that I may drink.”
verses.1KI 17:11: As she was going to get it, he called to her and said, “Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand.”
verses.1KI 17:12: She said, “As the LORD your God lives, I don’t have anything baked, but only a handful of meal in a jar and a little oil in a jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”
verses.1KI 17:13: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.
verses.1KI 17:14: For the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘The jar of meal will not run out, and the jar of oil will not fail, until the day that the LORD sends rain on the earth.’”
