verses.EZE 18:5: “But if a man is just, and does that which is lawful and right,
verses.EZE 18:6: and has not eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife, hasn’t come near a woman in her impurity,
verses.EZE 18:7: and has not wronged any, but has restored to the debtor his pledge, has taken nothing by robbery, has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;
verses.EZE 18:8: he who hasn’t lent to them with interest, hasn’t taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has executed true justice between man and man,
verses.EZE 18:9: has walked in my statutes, and has kept my ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.EZE 18:10: “If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things,
verses.EZE 18:13: has lent with interest, and has taken increase from the poor, shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations. He shall surely die. His blood will be on him.
verses.EZE 18:30: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord GOD. “Return, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, so iniquity will not be your ruin.
verses.EZE 18:31: Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit. For why will you die, house of Israel?
verses.EZE 18:32: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord GOD. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!
verses.EZE 18:21: “But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die.
verses.EZE 18:22: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.
verses.EZE 18:23: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord GOD, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?
verses.EZE 18:24: “But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, should he live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered. In his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.
verses.EZE 18:25: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways unequal?
verses.EZE 18:26: When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in it, then he dies in his iniquity that he has done.
verses.EZE 18:27: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he will save his soul alive.
verses.EZE 18:28: Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall not die.
verses.EZE 1:2: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,
verses.EZE 1:3: the LORD’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the LORD’s hand was there on him.
verses.EZE 1:4: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.
verses.EZE 1:5: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.
verses.EZE 1:24: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.
verses.EZE 1:25: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.
verses.EZE 1:26: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.
verses.EZE 1:27: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.
verses.EZE 1:28: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the LORD’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.
verses.EZE 24:15: Also the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.EZE 24:16: “Son of man, behold, I will take away from you the desire of your eyes with one stroke; yet you shall neither mourn nor weep, neither shall your tears run down.
verses.EZE 24:17: Sigh, but not aloud. Make no mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your sandals on your feet. Don’t cover your lips, and don’t eat mourner’s bread.”
verses.EZE 24:18: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and at evening my wife died. So I did in the morning as I was commanded.
verses.EZE 24:19: The people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things mean to us, that you act like this?”
verses.EZE 24:20: Then I said to them, “The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.EZE 24:21: ‘Speak to the house of Israel, “The Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pities; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.
verses.EZE 24:22: You will do as I have done. You won’t cover your lips or eat mourner’s bread.
verses.EZE 24:23: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won’t mourn or weep; but you will pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.
verses.EZE 24:24: Thus Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When this comes, then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’”’”
verses.EZE 28:1: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
verses.EZE 28:2: “Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the middle of the seas;’ yet you are man, and no god, though you set your heart as the heart of a god—
verses.EZE 28:3: behold, you are wiser than Daniel. There is no secret that is hidden from you.
verses.EZE 28:4: By your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your treasuries.
verses.EZE 28:5: By your great wisdom and by your trading you have increased your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches—”
verses.EZE 28:6: “‘therefore the Lord GOD says: “Because you have set your heart as the heart of God,
verses.EZE 28:7: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you, the terrible of the nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom. They will defile your brightness.
verses.EZE 28:8: They will bring you down to the pit. You will die the death of those who are slain in the heart of the seas.
verses.EZE 28:9: Will you yet say before him who kills you, ‘I am God’? But you are man, and not God, in the hand of him who wounds you.
verses.EZE 28:10: You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers; for I have spoken it,” says the Lord GOD.’”
verses.EZE 2:2: The Spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard him who spoke to me.
verses.EZE 2:3: He said to me, “Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have transgressed against me even to this very day.
verses.EZE 2:4: The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’
verses.EZE 2:5: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them.
verses.EZE 2:8: But you, son of man, hear what I tell you. Don’t be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth, and eat that which I give you.”
verses.EZE 2:9: When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.
verses.EZE 2:10: He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.
verses.EZE 3:1: He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”
verses.EZE 3:2: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.
verses.EZE 3:3: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll that I give you and fill your belly and your bowels with it.” Then I ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth.
verses.EZE 3:4: He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.
verses.EZE 33:11: Tell them, ‘“As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why will you die, house of Israel?”’
verses.EZE 33:7: “So you, son of man, I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and give them warnings from me.
verses.EZE 33:8: When I tell the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ and you don’t speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, but I will require his blood at your hand.
verses.EZE 33:9: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn’t turn from his way; he will die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your soul.
verses.EZE 34:1: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.EZE 34:2: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and tell them, even the shepherds, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Shouldn’t the shepherds feed the sheep?
verses.EZE 34:3: You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don’t feed the sheep.
verses.EZE 34:4: You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was broken. You haven’t brought back that which was driven away. You haven’t sought that which was lost, but you have ruled over them with force and with rigor.
verses.EZE 34:5: They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.
verses.EZE 34:6: My sheep wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Yes, my sheep were scattered on all the surface of the earth. There was no one who searched or sought.”
verses.EZE 34:7: “‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word:
verses.EZE 34:8: “As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, and my shepherds didn’t search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn’t feed my sheep,
verses.EZE 34:9: therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word!”
verses.EZE 34:10: The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep. The shepherds won’t feed themselves any more. I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.”
verses.EZE 34:11: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.
verses.EZE 34:12: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
verses.EZE 34:15: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.EZE 34:16: “I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.”’
verses.EZE 34:17: “As for you, O my flock, the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.
verses.EZE 34:13: I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
verses.EZE 34:14: I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
verses.EZE 36:16: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.EZE 36:17: “Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.
verses.EZE 36:18: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.
verses.EZE 36:19: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. I judged them according to their way and according to their deeds.
verses.EZE 36:20: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned my holy name, in that men said of them, ‘These are the LORD’s people, and have left his land.’
verses.EZE 36:21: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.
verses.EZE 36:22: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I don’t do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.
verses.EZE 36:23: I will sanctify my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD,” says the Lord GOD, “when I am proven holy in you before their eyes.
verses.EZE 36:24: “‘“For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.
verses.EZE 36:25: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.
verses.EZE 36:26: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.
verses.EZE 36:27: I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.
verses.EZE 36:28: You will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.EZE 37:1: The LORD’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in the LORD’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.
verses.EZE 37:4: Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear the LORD’s word.
verses.EZE 37:5: The Lord GOD says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.
verses.EZE 37:6: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”
verses.EZE 37:12: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.
verses.EZE 37:13: You will know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.
verses.EZE 37:14: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it and performed it,” says the LORD.’”
verses.EZE 37:2: He caused me to pass by them all around; and behold, there were very many in the open valley, and behold, they were very dry.
verses.EZE 37:3: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord GOD, you know.”
verses.EZE 37:7: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, there was an earthquake. Then the bones came together, bone to its bone.
verses.EZE 37:8: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.
verses.EZE 37:9: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and tell the wind, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.”’”
verses.EZE 37:10: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.
verses.EZE 37:11: Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost. We are completely cut off.’
verses.EZE 37:21: Say to them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land.
verses.EZE 37:22: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will be king to them all. They will no longer be two nations. They won’t be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.
verses.EZE 37:23: They won’t defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. So they will be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.EZE 37:24: “‘“My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances and observe my statutes, and do them.
verses.EZE 37:25: They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, forever. David my servant will be their prince forever.
verses.EZE 37:26: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them. It will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will place them, multiply them, and will set my sanctuary among them forever more.
verses.EZE 37:27: My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
verses.EZE 37:28: The nations will know that I am the LORD who sanctifies Israel, when my sanctuary is among them forever more.”’”
verses.EZE 3:16: At the end of seven days, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.EZE 3:17: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.
verses.EZE 3:18: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.
verses.EZE 3:19: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”
verses.EZE 3:20: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you have not given him warning, he will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered; but I will require his blood at your hand.
verses.EZE 3:21: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous not sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live, because he took warning; and you have delivered your soul.”
verses.EZE 43:1: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looks toward the east.
verses.EZE 43:2: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth was illuminated with his glory.
verses.EZE 43:4: The LORD’s glory came into the house by the way of the gate which faces toward the east.
verses.EZE 43:5: The Spirit took me up and brought me into the inner court; and behold, the LORD’s glory filled the house.
verses.EZE 43:6: I heard one speaking to me out of the house, and a man stood by me.
verses.EZE 43:7: He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell among the children of Israel forever. The house of Israel will no more defile my holy name, neither they nor their kings, by their prostitution and by the dead bodies of their kings in their high places;
verses.EZE 43:3: It was like the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.
verses.EZE 47:1: He brought me back to the door of the temple; and behold, waters flowed out from under the threshold of the temple eastward, for the front of the temple faced toward the east. The waters came down from underneath, from the right side of the temple, on the south of the altar.
verses.EZE 47:2: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.
verses.EZE 47:8: Then he said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region and will go down into the Arabah. Then they will go toward the sea and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out; and the waters will be healed.
verses.EZE 47:9: It will happen that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.
verses.EZE 47:12: By the river banks, on both sides, will grow every tree for food, whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail. It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”
verses.EZE 47:3: When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.
verses.EZE 47:4: Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through waters that were to the waist.
verses.EZE 47:5: Afterward he measured one thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass through, for the waters had risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be walked through.
verses.EZE 47:6: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen this?” Then he brought me and caused me to return to the bank of the river.
verses.EZE 47:7: Now when I had returned, behold, on the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
verses.EZE 9:1: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Cause those who are in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.”
verses.EZE 9:2: Behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. They went in, and stood beside the bronze altar.
verses.EZE 9:3: The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn by his side.
verses.EZE 9:4: The LORD said to him, “Go through the middle of the city, through the middle of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done within it.”
verses.EZE 9:5: To the others he said in my hearing, “Go through the city after him, and strike. Don’t let your eye spare, neither have pity.
verses.EZE 9:6: Kill utterly the old man, the young man, the virgin, little children and women; but don’t come near any man on whom is the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.” Then they began at the old men who were before the house.
verses.EZE 9:7: He said to them, “Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!” They went out, and struck in the city.
verses.EZE 10:18: The LORD’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.
verses.EZE 10:19: The cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels beside them. Then they stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
verses.EZE 10:20: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.
verses.EZE 10:21: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
verses.EZE 10:22: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward.
verses.EZR 1:1: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the LORD’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
verses.EZR 1:2: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘The LORD, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.
verses.EZR 1:3: Whoever there is among you of all his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD, the God of Israel (he is God), which is in Jerusalem.
verses.EZR 1:4: Whoever is left, in any place where he lives, let the men of his place help him with silver, with gold, with goods, and with animals, in addition to the free will offering for God’s house which is in Jerusalem.’”
verses.EZR 1:5: Then the heads of fathers’ households of Judah and Benjamin, the priests and the Levites, all whose spirit God had stirred to go up, rose up to build the LORD’s house which is in Jerusalem.
verses.EZR 1:6: All those who were around them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, with animals, and with precious things, in addition to all that was willingly offered.
verses.EZR 6:7: Leave the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.
verses.EZR 6:8: Moreover I make a decree regarding what you shall do for these elders of the Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the River, expenses must be given with all diligence to these men, that they not be hindered.
verses.EZR 6:12: May the God who has caused his name to dwell there overthrow all kings and peoples who stretch out their hand to alter this, to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree. Let it be done with all diligence.
verses.EZR 6:14: The elders of the Jews built and prospered, through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. They built and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the decree of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
verses.EZR 6:15: This house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
verses.EZR 6:16: The children of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy.
verses.EZR 6:17: They offered at the dedication of this house of God one hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
verses.EZR 6:18: They set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God which is at Jerusalem, as it is written in the book of Moses.
verses.EZR 6:19: The children of the captivity kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.EZR 6:20: Because the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together, all of them were pure. They killed the Passover for all the children of the captivity, for their brothers the priests, and for themselves.
verses.EZR 9:5: At the evening offering I rose up from my humiliation, even with my garment and my robe torn; and I fell on my knees, and spread out my hands to the LORD my God;
verses.EZR 9:6: and I said, “My God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to you, my God, for our iniquities have increased over our head, and our guiltiness has grown up to the heavens.
verses.EZR 9:7: Since the days of our fathers we have been exceedingly guilty to this day; and for our iniquities we, our kings, and our priests have been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, to plunder, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.
verses.EZR 9:8: Now for a little moment grace has been shown from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a stake in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and revive us a little in our bondage.
verses.EZR 9:9: For we are bondservants; yet our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but has extended loving kindness to us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to revive us, to set up the house of our God, and to repair its ruins, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.
verses.GAL 1:1: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—
verses.GAL 1:2: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
verses.GAL 1:6: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,
verses.GAL 1:7: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.
verses.GAL 1:8: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.
verses.GAL 1:9: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.
verses.GAL 1:10: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
verses.GAL 1:11: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.
verses.GAL 1:12: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.GAL 1:13: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.
verses.GAL 1:14: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
verses.GAL 1:15: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,
verses.GAL 1:16: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,
verses.GAL 1:17: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.
verses.GAL 1:18: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.
verses.GAL 1:19: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.
verses.GAL 1:20: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.
verses.GAL 1:21: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
verses.GAL 1:22: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,
verses.GAL 1:23: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”
verses.GAL 1:24: So they glorified God in me.
verses.GAL 2:1: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.
verses.GAL 2:2: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.
verses.GAL 2:7: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—
verses.GAL 2:8: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—
verses.GAL 2:9: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.
verses.GAL 2:10: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.
verses.GAL 2:11: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.
verses.GAL 2:12: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.
verses.GAL 2:13: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.
verses.GAL 2:14: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?
verses.GAL 2:16: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.
verses.GAL 2:19: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.
verses.GAL 2:20: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.
verses.GAL 2:21: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”
verses.GAL 3:1: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?
verses.GAL 3:2: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
verses.GAL 3:3: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?
verses.GAL 3:4: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?
verses.GAL 3:5: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
verses.GAL 3:22: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
verses.GAL 3:23: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
verses.GAL 3:24: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
verses.GAL 3:25: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.
verses.GAL 3:26: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.GAL 3:27: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
verses.GAL 3:28: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.GAL 3:29: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.
verses.GAL 3:7: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.
verses.GAL 3:8: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”
verses.GAL 3:9: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
verses.GAL 3:10: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”
verses.GAL 3:11: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”
verses.GAL 3:12: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”
verses.GAL 3:13: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”
verses.GAL 3:14: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
verses.GAL 3:15: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.
verses.GAL 3:16: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.
verses.GAL 3:17: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.
verses.GAL 4:22: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.
verses.GAL 4:23: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.
verses.GAL 4:24: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.
verses.GAL 4:26: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
verses.GAL 4:27: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”
verses.GAL 4:31: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.
verses.GAL 5:1: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
verses.GAL 4:4: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,
verses.GAL 4:5: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.
verses.GAL 4:6: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”
verses.GAL 4:7: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
verses.GAL 5:13: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
verses.GAL 5:14: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
verses.GAL 5:15: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
verses.GAL 5:16: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
verses.GAL 5:17: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.
verses.GAL 5:18: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
verses.GAL 5:2: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
verses.GAL 5:3: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
verses.GAL 5:4: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.
verses.GAL 5:5: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
verses.GAL 5:6: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.
verses.GAL 5:19: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
verses.GAL 5:20: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
verses.GAL 5:21: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.
verses.GAL 5:22: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
verses.GAL 5:23: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
verses.GAL 5:24: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
verses.GAL 5:25: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.
verses.GAL 6:15: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
verses.GAL 6:16: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.
verses.GAL 6:17: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
verses.GAL 6:18: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
verses.GEN 11:1: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.
verses.GEN 11:2: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.
verses.GEN 11:3: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.
verses.GEN 11:4: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”
verses.GEN 11:5: The LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.
verses.GEN 11:6: The LORD said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.
verses.GEN 11:7: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”
verses.GEN 11:8: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.
verses.GEN 11:9: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth. From there, the LORD scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.
verses.GEN 12:1: Now the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.
verses.GEN 12:2: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.
verses.GEN 12:3: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”
verses.GEN 12:4: So Abram went, as the LORD had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
verses.GEN 12:5: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.
verses.GEN 12:6: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.
verses.GEN 12:7: The LORD appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” He built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.
verses.GEN 12:8: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the LORD and called on the LORD’s name.
verses.GEN 12:9: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.
verses.GEN 13:2: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
verses.GEN 13:5: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.
verses.GEN 13:6: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their possessions were so great that they couldn’t live together.
verses.GEN 13:7: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.
verses.GEN 13:8: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.
verses.GEN 13:9: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”
verses.GEN 13:10: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.
verses.GEN 13:11: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.
verses.GEN 13:12: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.
verses.GEN 13:13: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against the LORD.
verses.GEN 13:14: The LORD said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,
verses.GEN 13:15: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.
verses.GEN 13:16: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.
verses.GEN 13:17: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”
verses.GEN 13:18: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to the LORD.
verses.GEN 14:18: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.
verses.GEN 14:19: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.
verses.GEN 14:20: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.
verses.GEN 15:1: After these things the LORD’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”
verses.GEN 15:2: Abram said, “Lord GOD, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”
verses.GEN 15:3: Abram said, “Behold, you have given no children to me: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”
verses.GEN 15:4: Behold, the LORD’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”
verses.GEN 15:5: The LORD brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So your offspring will be.”
verses.GEN 15:6: He believed in the LORD, who credited it to him for righteousness.
verses.GEN 15:7: He said to Abram, “I am the LORD who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”
verses.GEN 15:8: He said, “Lord GOD, how will I know that I will inherit it?”
verses.GEN 15:9: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”
verses.GEN 15:10: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.
verses.GEN 15:11: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
verses.GEN 15:12: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.
verses.GEN 15:17: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.
verses.GEN 15:18: In that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:
verses.GEN 21:1: The LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did to Sarah as he had spoken.
verses.GEN 21:2: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
verses.GEN 21:3: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.
verses.GEN 15:21: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”
verses.GEN 16:1: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
verses.GEN 16:2: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, the LORD has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
verses.GEN 16:3: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.
verses.GEN 16:4: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
verses.GEN 16:5: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, she despised me. May the LORD judge between me and you.”
verses.GEN 16:6: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.
verses.GEN 16:7: The LORD’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.
verses.GEN 16:8: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”
verses.GEN 16:9: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”
verses.GEN 16:10: The LORD’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”
verses.GEN 16:11: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because the LORD has heard your affliction.
verses.GEN 16:12: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposed to all of his brothers.”
verses.GEN 16:15: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
verses.GEN 16:16: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
verses.GEN 17:1: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless.
verses.GEN 17:9: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.
verses.GEN 17:10: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.
verses.GEN 17:15: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name shall be Sarah.
verses.GEN 17:16: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”
verses.GEN 17:17: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”
verses.GEN 17:18: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”
verses.GEN 17:19: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.
verses.GEN 17:20: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.
verses.GEN 17:21: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”
verses.GEN 17:22: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.
verses.GEN 17:3: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,
verses.GEN 17:4: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.
verses.GEN 17:5: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
verses.GEN 17:6: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.
verses.GEN 17:7: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.
verses.GEN 17:8: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”
verses.GEN 18:1: The LORD appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.
verses.GEN 18:2: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood near him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,
verses.GEN 18:3: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.
verses.GEN 18:4: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.
verses.GEN 18:5: I will get a piece of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They said, “Very well, do as you have said.”
verses.GEN 18:6: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”
verses.GEN 18:7: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.
verses.GEN 18:8: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.
verses.GEN 18:9: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “There, in the tent.”
verses.GEN 18:10: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.
verses.GEN 18:11: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
verses.GEN 18:12: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”
verses.GEN 18:13: The LORD said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child when I am old?’
verses.GEN 18:14: Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son.”
verses.GEN 18:15: Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He said, “No, but you did laugh.”
verses.GEN 18:16: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.
verses.GEN 18:17: The LORD said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,
verses.GEN 18:18: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?
verses.GEN 18:19: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of the LORD, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that the LORD may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”
verses.GEN 18:20: The LORD said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,
verses.GEN 18:21: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”
verses.GEN 18:22: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.
verses.GEN 18:23: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?
verses.GEN 18:24: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?
verses.GEN 18:25: May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”
verses.GEN 18:26: The LORD said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”
verses.GEN 18:27: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.
verses.GEN 18:28: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there.”
verses.GEN 18:29: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”
verses.GEN 18:30: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not do it if I find thirty there.”
verses.GEN 18:31: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”
verses.GEN 18:32: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”
verses.GEN 18:33: The LORD went his way as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.
verses.GEN 19:15: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”
verses.GEN 19:16: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, the LORD being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.
verses.GEN 19:17: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”
verses.GEN 19:18: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.
verses.GEN 19:19: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.
verses.GEN 19:20: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”
verses.GEN 19:21: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.
verses.GEN 19:22: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
verses.GEN 19:23: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.
verses.GEN 19:24: Then the LORD rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the LORD out of the sky.
verses.GEN 19:25: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.
verses.GEN 19:26: But Lot’s wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.GEN 19:27: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the LORD.
verses.GEN 19:28: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.
verses.GEN 19:29: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.
verses.GEN 1:1: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.GEN 1:26: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”
verses.GEN 1:27: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
verses.GEN 1:28: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”
verses.GEN 1:29: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.
verses.GEN 1:30: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.
verses.GEN 1:31: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
verses.GEN 1:2: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.
verses.GEN 1:3: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
verses.GEN 1:4: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.GEN 1:5: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
verses.GEN 1:6: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
verses.GEN 1:7: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
verses.GEN 1:8: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.
verses.GEN 1:9: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.
verses.GEN 1:10: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.
verses.GEN 1:11: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.
verses.GEN 1:12: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.
verses.GEN 1:13: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.
verses.GEN 1:14: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;
verses.GEN 1:15: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.
verses.GEN 1:16: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.
verses.GEN 1:17: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,
verses.GEN 1:18: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.
verses.GEN 1:19: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
verses.GEN 1:20: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
verses.GEN 1:21: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.
verses.GEN 1:22: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
verses.GEN 1:23: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
verses.GEN 1:24: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.
verses.GEN 1:25: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.
verses.GEN 2:1: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.
verses.GEN 2:2: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.
verses.GEN 2:3: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.
verses.GEN 2:4: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.
verses.GEN 21:5: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.
verses.GEN 21:8: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
verses.GEN 21:9: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.
verses.GEN 21:10: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”
verses.GEN 21:11: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.
verses.GEN 21:12: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.
verses.GEN 21:13: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”
verses.GEN 21:14: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
verses.GEN 21:15: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.
verses.GEN 21:16: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat opposite him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.
verses.GEN 21:17: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.
verses.GEN 21:18: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”
verses.GEN 21:19: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.
verses.GEN 21:20: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, he became an archer.
verses.GEN 22:1: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
verses.GEN 22:2: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”
verses.GEN 22:3: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.
verses.GEN 22:4: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.
verses.GEN 22:5: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there. We will worship, and come back to you.”
verses.GEN 22:6: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.
verses.GEN 22:7: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”
verses.GEN 22:8: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.
verses.GEN 22:9: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.
verses.GEN 22:10: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.
verses.GEN 22:11: The LORD’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
verses.GEN 22:12: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”
verses.GEN 22:13: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.
verses.GEN 22:14: Abraham called the name of that place “The LORD Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On the LORD’s mountain, it will be provided.”
verses.GEN 22:15: The LORD’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,
verses.GEN 22:16: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says the LORD, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,
verses.GEN 22:17: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.
verses.GEN 22:18: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’”
verses.GEN 22:19: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.
verses.GEN 23:1: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.
verses.GEN 23:2: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
verses.GEN 23:3: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,
verses.GEN 23:4: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”
verses.GEN 23:19: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.
verses.GEN 24:1: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. The LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.
verses.GEN 24:2: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.
verses.GEN 24:3: I will make you swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.
verses.GEN 24:4: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”
verses.GEN 24:5: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”
verses.GEN 24:6: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.
verses.GEN 24:7: The LORD, the God of heaven—who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring—he will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.
verses.GEN 24:8: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”
verses.GEN 24:62: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.
verses.GEN 24:63: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes and looked. Behold, there were camels coming.
verses.GEN 24:64: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.
verses.GEN 24:65: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The servant said, “It is my master.” She took her veil, and covered herself.
verses.GEN 24:66: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.
verses.GEN 24:67: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
verses.GEN 27:1: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?” He said to him, “Here I am.”
verses.GEN 27:2: He said, “See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.
verses.GEN 27:3: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison.
verses.GEN 27:4: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”
verses.GEN 27:5: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
verses.GEN 27:15: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.
verses.GEN 27:16: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.
verses.GEN 27:17: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
verses.GEN 27:18: He came to his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am. Who are you, my son?”
verses.GEN 27:19: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done what you asked me to do. Please arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.”
verses.GEN 27:20: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?” He said, “Because the LORD your God gave me success.”
verses.GEN 27:21: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”
verses.GEN 27:22: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”
verses.GEN 27:23: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.
verses.GEN 27:24: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He said, “I am.”
verses.GEN 27:25: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He brought it near to him, and he ate. He brought him wine, and he drank.
verses.GEN 27:26: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”
verses.GEN 27:27: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, “Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD has blessed.
verses.GEN 27:28: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.
verses.GEN 27:29: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers. Let your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you. Blessed be everyone who blesses you.”
verses.GEN 28:10: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
verses.GEN 28:11: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.
verses.GEN 28:12: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.
verses.GEN 28:13: Behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, “I am the LORD, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.
verses.GEN 28:14: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.
verses.GEN 28:15: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”
verses.GEN 28:16: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”
verses.GEN 28:17: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”
verses.GEN 28:18: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.
verses.GEN 28:19: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
verses.GEN 28:20: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,
verses.GEN 28:21: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and the LORD will be my God,
verses.GEN 28:22: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”
verses.GEN 2:18: The LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
verses.GEN 2:19: Out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.
verses.GEN 2:20: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.
verses.GEN 2:21: The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.
verses.GEN 2:22: The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.
verses.GEN 2:23: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”
verses.GEN 2:24: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.
verses.GEN 2:25: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
verses.GEN 2:5: No plant of the field was yet on the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,
verses.GEN 2:6: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.
verses.GEN 2:7: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
verses.GEN 2:8: The LORD God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.
