verses.GEN 2:9: Out of the ground the LORD God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
verses.GEN 2:15: The LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
verses.GEN 2:16: The LORD God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;
verses.GEN 2:17: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”
verses.GEN 3:1: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which the LORD God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?”
verses.GEN 3:2: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,
verses.GEN 3:3: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”
verses.GEN 3:4: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,
verses.GEN 3:5: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”
verses.GEN 3:6: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.
verses.GEN 3:7: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.
verses.GEN 32:22: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.
verses.GEN 32:23: He took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.
verses.GEN 32:24: Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day.
verses.GEN 32:25: When he saw that he didn’t prevail against him, the man touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained as he wrestled.
verses.GEN 32:26: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”
verses.GEN 32:27: He said to him, “What is your name?” He said, “Jacob”.
verses.GEN 32:28: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”
verses.GEN 32:29: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He said, “Why is it that you ask what my name is?” So he blessed him there.
verses.GEN 32:30: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel; for he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”
verses.GEN 32:31: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped because of his thigh.
verses.GEN 32:32: Therefore the children of Israel don’t eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew of the hip.
verses.GEN 37:3: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a tunic of many colors.
verses.GEN 37:4: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.
verses.GEN 37:12: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.
verses.GEN 37:13: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”
verses.GEN 37:17: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.
verses.GEN 37:18: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.
verses.GEN 37:19: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.
verses.GEN 37:20: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”
verses.GEN 37:21: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”
verses.GEN 37:22: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.
verses.GEN 37:23: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him;
verses.GEN 37:24: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.
verses.GEN 37:25: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
verses.GEN 37:26: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?
verses.GEN 37:27: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.
verses.GEN 37:28: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt.
verses.GEN 3:8: They heard the LORD God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.
verses.GEN 3:9: The LORD God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”
verses.GEN 3:10: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”
verses.GEN 3:11: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”
verses.GEN 3:12: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
verses.GEN 3:13: The LORD God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”
verses.GEN 3:14: The LORD God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.
verses.GEN 3:15: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”
verses.GEN 3:20: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.
verses.GEN 3:16: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”
verses.GEN 3:17: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and have eaten from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.
verses.GEN 3:18: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.
verses.GEN 3:19: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are dust, and you shall return to dust.”
verses.GEN 3:21: The LORD God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.
verses.GEN 3:22: The LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”
verses.GEN 3:23: Therefore the LORD God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.
verses.GEN 3:24: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
verses.GEN 41:55: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.”
verses.GEN 41:56: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
verses.GEN 41:57: All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.
verses.GEN 42:5: The sons of Israel came to buy among those who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
verses.GEN 42:6: Joseph was the governor over the land. It was he who sold to all the people of the land. Joseph’s brothers came, and bowed themselves down to him with their faces to the earth.
verses.GEN 42:7: Joseph saw his brothers, and he recognized them, but acted like a stranger to them, and spoke roughly with them. He said to them, “Where did you come from?” They said, “From the land of Canaan, to buy food.”
verses.GEN 42:17: He put them all together into custody for three days.
verses.GEN 42:18: Joseph said to them the third day, “Do this, and live, for I fear God.
verses.GEN 42:19: If you are honest men, then let one of your brothers be bound in your prison; but you go, carry grain for the famine of your houses.
verses.GEN 42:20: Bring your youngest brother to me; so will your words be verified, and you won’t die.” They did so.
verses.GEN 42:21: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn’t listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.”
verses.GEN 42:22: Reuben answered them, saying, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘Don’t sin against the child,’ and you wouldn’t listen? Therefore also, behold, his blood is required.”
verses.GEN 42:23: They didn’t know that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.
verses.GEN 42:24: He turned himself away from them, and wept. Then he returned to them, and spoke to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.
verses.GEN 44:18: Then Judah came near to him, and said, “Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears, and don’t let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even as Pharaoh.
verses.GEN 44:19: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father, or a brother?’
verses.GEN 44:20: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’
verses.GEN 44:21: You said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’
verses.GEN 44:23: You said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will see my face no more.’
verses.GEN 44:24: When we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
verses.GEN 44:25: Our father said, ‘Go again and buy us a little food.’
verses.GEN 44:26: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’
verses.GEN 44:27: Your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.
verses.GEN 44:28: One went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces;” and I haven’t seen him since.
verses.GEN 44:29: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’
verses.GEN 45:1: Then Joseph couldn’t control himself before all those who stood before him, and he called out, “Cause everyone to go out from me!” No one else stood with him, while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.
verses.GEN 45:2: He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.
verses.GEN 45:3: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Does my father still live?” His brothers couldn’t answer him; for they were terrified at his presence.
verses.GEN 45:4: Joseph said to his brothers, “Come near to me, please.” They came near. He said, “I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.
verses.GEN 45:5: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.
verses.GEN 46:1: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.
verses.GEN 46:2: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”
verses.GEN 46:3: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.
verses.GEN 46:4: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph’s hand will close your eyes.”
verses.GEN 46:5: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.GEN 46:6: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,
verses.GEN 46:7: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his offspring with him into Egypt.
verses.GEN 46:28: Jacob sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.
verses.GEN 46:29: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
verses.GEN 46:30: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”
verses.GEN 49:1: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.
verses.GEN 49:2: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.
verses.GEN 49:8: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.
verses.GEN 49:9: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?
verses.GEN 49:10: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. The obedience of the peoples will be to him.
verses.GEN 49:29: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
verses.GEN 49:30: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.
verses.GEN 49:31: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:
verses.GEN 49:32: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”
verses.GEN 50:15: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him.”
verses.GEN 50:16: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,
verses.GEN 50:17: ‘You shall tell Joseph, “Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers, and their sin, because they did evil to you.”’ Now, please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father.” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.
verses.GEN 50:18: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”
verses.GEN 50:19: Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for am I in the place of God?
verses.GEN 50:20: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.
verses.GEN 50:21: Now therefore don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones.” He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.
verses.GEN 50:22: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.
verses.GEN 50:23: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.
verses.GEN 50:24: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”
verses.GEN 50:25: Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”
verses.GEN 50:26: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.GEN 4:1: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with the LORD’s help.”
verses.GEN 4:2: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
verses.GEN 4:3: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground.
verses.GEN 4:4: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. The LORD respected Abel and his offering,
verses.GEN 4:5: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.
verses.GEN 4:6: The LORD said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?
verses.GEN 4:7: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”
verses.GEN 4:8: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.
verses.GEN 4:9: The LORD said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”
verses.GEN 4:10: The LORD said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.
verses.GEN 4:11: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
verses.GEN 4:12: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”
verses.GEN 4:13: Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.
verses.GEN 4:14: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”
verses.GEN 4:15: The LORD said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” The LORD appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.
verses.GEN 4:25: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”
verses.GEN 6:5: The LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great on the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.
verses.GEN 6:6: The LORD was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.
verses.GEN 6:7: The LORD said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”
verses.GEN 6:8: But Noah found favor in the LORD’s eyes.
verses.GEN 7:1: The LORD said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.
verses.GEN 7:2: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.
verses.GEN 7:3: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.
verses.GEN 7:4: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”
verses.GEN 7:5: Noah did everything that the LORD commanded him.
verses.GEN 7:10: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.
verses.GEN 8:6: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,
verses.GEN 8:7: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.
verses.GEN 8:8: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,
verses.GEN 8:9: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.
verses.GEN 8:10: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.
verses.GEN 8:11: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.
verses.GEN 8:12: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.
verses.GEN 8:13: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.
verses.GEN 8:20: Noah built an altar to the LORD, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.GEN 8:21: The LORD smelled the pleasant aroma. The LORD said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.
verses.GEN 8:22: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”
verses.GEN 9:1: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.
verses.GEN 9:2: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.
verses.GEN 9:3: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.
verses.GEN 9:4: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.
verses.GEN 9:5: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.
verses.GEN 9:6: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.
verses.GEN 9:7: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly on the earth, and multiply in it.”
verses.GEN 9:8: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,
verses.GEN 9:9: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,
verses.GEN 9:10: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.
verses.GEN 9:11: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”
verses.GEN 9:12: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
verses.GEN 9:13: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.
verses.GEN 9:14: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,
verses.GEN 9:15: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.HAB 1:12: Aren’t you from everlasting, LORD my God, my Holy One? We will not die. LORD, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.
verses.HAB 1:13: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,
verses.HAB 1:14: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?
verses.HAB 1:15: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.
verses.HAB 1:16: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.
verses.HAB 1:17: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?
verses.HAB 2:1: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.
verses.HAB 2:2: The LORD answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.
verses.HAB 2:3: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.
verses.HAB 2:4: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
verses.HAB 1:2: LORD, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?
verses.HAB 1:3: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.
verses.HEB 10:1: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.
verses.HEB 10:2: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?
verses.HEB 10:3: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.
verses.HEB 10:4: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.
verses.HEB 10:5: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.
verses.HEB 10:6: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.
verses.HEB 10:7: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”
verses.HEB 10:8: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),
verses.HEB 10:9: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,
verses.HEB 10:10: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
verses.HEB 10:11: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,
verses.HEB 10:12: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,
verses.HEB 10:13: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.
verses.HEB 10:14: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.
verses.HEB 10:18: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
verses.HEB 10:15: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,
verses.HEB 10:16: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says,
verses.HEB 10:17: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”
verses.HEB 10:19: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
verses.HEB 10:20: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,
verses.HEB 10:21: and having a great priest over God’s house,
verses.HEB 10:22: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,
verses.HEB 10:23: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.
verses.HEB 10:24: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,
verses.HEB 10:25: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
verses.HEB 10:32: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:
verses.HEB 10:33: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.
verses.HEB 10:34: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.
verses.HEB 10:35: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.
verses.HEB 10:36: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
verses.HEB 10:37: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.
verses.HEB 10:38: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
verses.HEB 10:39: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
verses.HEB 11:1: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
verses.HEB 11:2: For by this, the elders obtained approval.
verses.HEB 11:8: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.
verses.HEB 11:9: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.
verses.HEB 11:10: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
verses.HEB 11:11: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.
verses.HEB 11:12: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.
verses.HEB 11:13: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
verses.HEB 11:14: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.
verses.HEB 11:15: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.
verses.HEB 11:16: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.
verses.HEB 11:17: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,
verses.HEB 11:18: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”
verses.HEB 11:19: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.
verses.HEB 11:3: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.
verses.HEB 11:4: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.
verses.HEB 11:5: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.
verses.HEB 11:6: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.
verses.HEB 11:7: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
verses.HEB 11:32: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—
verses.HEB 11:33: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
verses.HEB 11:34: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.
verses.HEB 11:35: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.
verses.HEB 11:36: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.
verses.HEB 11:37: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—
verses.HEB 11:38: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.
verses.HEB 11:39: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,
verses.HEB 11:40: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.
verses.HEB 12:1: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
verses.HEB 12:2: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.HEB 12:3: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.
verses.HEB 12:4: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.
verses.HEB 12:18: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
verses.HEB 12:19: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,
verses.HEB 12:21: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
verses.HEB 12:22: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,
verses.HEB 12:23: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
verses.HEB 12:24: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.
verses.HEB 12:5: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;
verses.HEB 12:6: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”
verses.HEB 12:7: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?
verses.HEB 12:11: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
verses.HEB 12:12: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
verses.HEB 12:13: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
verses.HEB 12:14: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
verses.HEB 12:15: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,
verses.HEB 13:2: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.
verses.HEB 13:3: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.
verses.HEB 13:4: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
verses.HEB 13:5: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
verses.HEB 13:6: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
verses.HEB 13:7: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.
verses.HEB 13:8: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
verses.HEB 13:15: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
verses.HEB 13:16: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
verses.HEB 13:17: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.
verses.HEB 13:20: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,
verses.HEB 13:21: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.HEB 1:1: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,
verses.HEB 1:2: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.
verses.HEB 1:3: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,
verses.HEB 1:4: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.
verses.HEB 1:5: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?”
verses.HEB 1:6: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”
verses.HEB 2:14: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,
verses.HEB 2:15: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
verses.HEB 2:16: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.
verses.HEB 2:17: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.
verses.HEB 2:18: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
verses.HEB 2:5: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.
verses.HEB 2:6: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?
verses.HEB 2:7: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.
verses.HEB 2:8: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.
verses.HEB 2:9: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.
verses.HEB 2:10: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
verses.HEB 2:11: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,
verses.HEB 2:12: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”
verses.HEB 3:7: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
verses.HEB 3:8: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
verses.HEB 3:9: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.
verses.HEB 3:10: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’
verses.HEB 3:11: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”
verses.HEB 3:12: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;
verses.HEB 3:13: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.HEB 3:14: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,
verses.HEB 4:1: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.
verses.HEB 4:2: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.
verses.HEB 4:3: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.HEB 4:4: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”
verses.HEB 4:5: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”
verses.HEB 4:11: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.
verses.HEB 4:12: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
verses.HEB 4:13: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.
verses.HEB 4:14: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.
verses.HEB 4:15: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
verses.HEB 4:16: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
verses.HEB 5:7: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,
verses.HEB 5:8: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.
verses.HEB 5:9: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,
verses.HEB 5:1: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.
verses.HEB 5:2: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.
verses.HEB 5:3: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.
verses.HEB 5:4: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.
verses.HEB 5:5: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”
verses.HEB 5:6: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”
verses.HEB 5:10: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.HEB 6:10: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.
verses.HEB 6:11: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,
verses.HEB 6:12: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.
verses.HEB 6:13: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,
verses.HEB 6:14: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”
verses.HEB 6:15: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
verses.HEB 6:16: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.
verses.HEB 6:17: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,
verses.HEB 6:18: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.
verses.HEB 6:19: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,
verses.HEB 6:20: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.HEB 7:1: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
verses.HEB 7:2: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,
verses.HEB 7:3: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.
verses.HEB 7:15: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,
verses.HEB 7:16: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;
verses.HEB 7:17: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
verses.HEB 7:23: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.
verses.HEB 7:24: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.
verses.HEB 7:25: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
verses.HEB 7:26: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
verses.HEB 7:27: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.
verses.HEB 7:28: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.
verses.HEB 8:1: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
verses.HEB 8:2: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.
verses.HEB 8:3: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.
verses.HEB 8:4: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,
verses.HEB 8:5: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.”
verses.HEB 8:6: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.
verses.HEB 8:7: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.
verses.HEB 8:8: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days are coming”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;
verses.HEB 8:9: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.
verses.HEB 8:10: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
verses.HEB 8:11: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.
verses.HEB 8:12: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”
verses.HEB 8:13: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.
verses.HEB 9:11: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,
verses.HEB 9:12: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.
verses.HEB 9:13: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,
verses.HEB 9:14: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
verses.HEB 9:15: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.
verses.HEB 9:24: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;
verses.HEB 9:25: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,
verses.HEB 9:26: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
verses.HEB 9:27: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,
verses.HEB 9:28: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.
verses.HEB 9:2: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.

verses.HAG 1:1: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,
verses.HAG 1:2: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for the LORD’s house to be built.’”
verses.HAG 1:3: Then the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.HAG 1:4: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?
verses.HAG 1:5: Now therefore this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.
verses.HAG 1:6: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.’
verses.HAG 1:7: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.
verses.HAG 1:8: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says the LORD.
verses.HAG 2:1: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.HAG 2:2: “Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
verses.HAG 2:3: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?
verses.HAG 2:4: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says the LORD. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says the LORD, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says the LORD of Armies.
verses.HAG 2:5: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’
verses.HAG 2:6: For this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;
verses.HAG 2:7: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Armies.
verses.HAG 2:8: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says the LORD of Armies.
verses.HAG 2:9: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says the LORD of Armies.”
verses.HOS 10:1: Israel is a luxuriant vine that produces his fruit. According to the abundance of his fruit he has multiplied his altars. As their land has prospered, they have adorned their sacred stones.
verses.HOS 10:2: Their heart is divided. Now they will be found guilty. He will demolish their altars. He will destroy their sacred stones.
verses.HOS 10:3: Surely now they will say, “We have no king; for we don’t fear the LORD; and the king, what can he do for us?”
verses.HOS 10:7: Samaria and her king float away like a twig on the water.
verses.HOS 10:8: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed. The thorn and the thistle will come up on their altars. They will tell the mountains, “Cover us!” and the hills, “Fall on us!”
verses.HOS 10:12: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground, for it is time to seek the LORD, until he comes and rains righteousness on you.
verses.HOS 11:1: “When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
verses.HOS 11:3: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by their arms, but they didn’t know that I healed them.
verses.HOS 11:4: I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.
verses.HOS 11:8: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.
verses.HOS 11:9: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim, for I am God, and not man—the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.
verses.HOS 11:2: They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.
verses.HOS 14:1: Israel, return to the LORD your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.
verses.HOS 14:2: Take words with you, and return to the LORD. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good; so we offer bulls as we vowed of our lips.
verses.HOS 14:3: Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for in you the fatherless finds mercy.”
verses.HOS 14:4: “I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from them.
verses.HOS 14:5: I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.
verses.HOS 14:6: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
verses.HOS 14:7: Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon.
verses.HOS 14:8: Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green cypress tree; from me your fruit is found.”
verses.HOS 14:9: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.
verses.HOS 2:14: “Therefore behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.
verses.HOS 2:15: I will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will respond there as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.HOS 2:19: I will betroth you to me forever. Yes, I will betroth you to me in righteousness, in justice, in loving kindness, and in compassion.
verses.HOS 2:20: I will even betroth you to me in faithfulness; and you shall know the LORD.
verses.HOS 2:16: It will be in that day,” says the LORD, “that you will call me ‘my husband,’ and no longer call me ‘my master.’
verses.HOS 6:1: “Come! Let’s return to the LORD; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds.
verses.HOS 6:2: After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him.
verses.HOS 6:3: Let’s acknowledge the LORD. Let’s press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, the LORD will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”
verses.HOS 6:4: “Ephraim, what shall I do to you? Judah, what shall I do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew that disappears early.
verses.HOS 6:5: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are like a flash of lightning.
verses.HOS 6:6: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
verses.HOS 8:4: They have set up kings, but not by me. They have made princes, and I didn’t approve. Of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols, that they may be cut off.
verses.HOS 8:5: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity?
verses.HOS 8:6: For this is even from Israel! The workman made it, and it is no God; indeed, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
verses.HOS 8:7: For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. He has no standing grain. The stalk will yield no head. If it does yield, strangers will swallow it up.
verses.HOS 8:11: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they became for him altars for sinning.
verses.HOS 8:12: I wrote for him the many things of my law, but they were regarded as a strange thing.
verses.HOS 8:13: As for the sacrifices of my offerings, they sacrifice meat and eat it, but the LORD doesn’t accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish their sins. They will return to Egypt.
verses.ISA 10:5: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!
verses.ISA 10:6: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
verses.ISA 10:7: However, he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.
verses.ISA 10:13: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding. I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.
verses.ISA 10:14: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”
verses.ISA 10:15: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.
verses.ISA 10:16: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.
verses.ISA 11:1: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.
verses.ISA 11:2: The LORD’s Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD.
verses.ISA 11:3: His delight will be in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears;
verses.ISA 11:4: but he will judge the poor with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.
verses.ISA 11:5: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, and faithfulness the belt around his waist.
verses.ISA 11:6: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.
verses.ISA 11:7: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.
verses.ISA 11:8: The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.
verses.ISA 11:9: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.ISA 11:10: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.
verses.ISA 12:2: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”
verses.ISA 12:3: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.
verses.ISA 12:4: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Declare his doings among the peoples! Proclaim that his name is exalted!
verses.ISA 12:5: Sing to the LORD, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
verses.ISA 12:6: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”
verses.ISA 1:10: Hear the LORD’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
verses.ISA 1:16: Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
verses.ISA 1:17: Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Defend the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”
verses.ISA 1:18: “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says the LORD: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
verses.ISA 1:19: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land;
verses.ISA 1:20: but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for the LORD’s mouth has spoken it.”
verses.ISA 1:11: “What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says the LORD. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fed animals. I don’t delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of male goats.
verses.ISA 1:12: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to trample my courts?
verses.ISA 1:13: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me. New moons, Sabbaths, and convocations— I can’t stand evil assemblies.
verses.ISA 1:14: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They are a burden to me. I am weary of bearing them.
verses.ISA 1:15: When you spread out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you. Yes, when you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.
verses.ISA 22:19: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.
verses.ISA 22:20: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,
verses.ISA 22:21: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
verses.ISA 22:22: I will lay the key of David’s house on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.
verses.ISA 22:23: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.
verses.ISA 25:6: In this mountain, the LORD of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.
verses.ISA 25:7: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
verses.ISA 25:8: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for the LORD has spoken it.
verses.ISA 25:9: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is the LORD! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”
verses.ISA 25:10: For the LORD’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.
verses.ISA 26:1: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.
verses.ISA 26:2: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
verses.ISA 26:3: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
verses.ISA 26:4: Trust in the LORD forever; for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting Rock.
verses.ISA 26:5: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.
verses.ISA 26:6: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy.”
verses.ISA 26:7: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.
verses.ISA 26:8: Yes, in the way of your judgments, LORD, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.
verses.ISA 26:9: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are on the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
verses.ISA 26:12: LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
verses.ISA 26:16: LORD, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
verses.ISA 26:17: Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs, so we have been before you, LORD.
verses.ISA 26:18: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance on the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.ISA 26:19: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.
verses.ISA 29:17: Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?
verses.ISA 29:18: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.
verses.ISA 29:19: The humble also will increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ISA 29:20: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—
verses.ISA 29:21: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for one who reproves in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.
verses.ISA 29:22: Therefore the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, says concerning the house of Jacob: “Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.
verses.ISA 29:23: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the middle of him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
verses.ISA 29:24: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction.”
verses.ISA 2:1: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.ISA 2:2: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of the LORD’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.
verses.ISA 2:3: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law shall go out of Zion, and the LORD’s word from Jerusalem.
verses.ISA 2:4: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples. They shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.ISA 2:5: House of Jacob, come, and let’s walk in the light of the LORD.
verses.ISA 30:19: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.
verses.ISA 30:20: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden any more, but your eyes will see your teachers;
verses.ISA 30:21: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”
verses.ISA 30:23: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.
verses.ISA 30:24: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory feed, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.
verses.ISA 30:25: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
verses.ISA 30:26: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.
verses.ISA 33:22: For the LORD is our judge. The LORD is our lawgiver. The LORD is our king. He will save us.
verses.ISA 35:1: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
verses.ISA 35:2: It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory will be given to it, the excellence of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the LORD’s glory, the excellence of our God.
verses.ISA 35:3: Strengthen the weak hands, and make the feeble knees firm.
verses.ISA 35:4: Tell those who have a fearful heart, “Be strong! Don’t be afraid! Behold, your God will come with vengeance, God’s retribution. He will come and save you.
verses.ISA 35:5: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.
verses.ISA 35:6: Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.
verses.ISA 35:7: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in the habitation of jackals, where they lay.
verses.ISA 35:8: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called “The Holy Way”. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked fools shall not go there.
verses.ISA 35:9: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.
verses.ISA 35:10: Then the LORD’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”
verses.ISA 38:1: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Set your house in order, for you will die, and not live.’”
verses.ISA 38:2: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD,
verses.ISA 38:3: and said, “Remember now, LORD, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” Then Hezekiah wept bitterly.
verses.ISA 38:4: Then the LORD’s word came to Isaiah, saying,
verses.ISA 38:5: “Go, and tell Hezekiah, ‘The LORD, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.
verses.ISA 38:6: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria, and I will defend this city.
verses.ISA 38:21: Now Isaiah had said, “Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover.”
verses.ISA 38:22: Hezekiah also had said, “What is the sign that I will go up to the LORD’s house?”
verses.ISA 38:7: This shall be the sign to you from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing that he has spoken.
verses.ISA 38:8: Behold, I will cause the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down on the sundial of Ahaz with the sun, to return backward ten steps.”’” So the sun returned ten steps on the sundial on which it had gone down.
verses.ISA 38:10: I said, “In the middle of my life I go into the gates of Sheol. I am deprived of the residue of my years.”
verses.ISA 38:11: I said, “I won’t see the LORD, the LORD in the land of the living. I will see man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
verses.ISA 38:12: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me.
verses.ISA 38:16: Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them. You restore me, and cause me to live.
verses.ISA 40:1: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.
verses.ISA 40:2: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem, and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of the LORD’s hand double for all her sins.”
verses.ISA 40:3: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of the LORD in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.
verses.ISA 40:4: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain.
verses.ISA 40:5: The LORD’s glory shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of the LORD has spoken it.”
verses.ISA 40:6: The voice of one saying, “Cry out!” One said, “What shall I cry?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field.
verses.ISA 40:7: The grass withers, the flower fades, because the LORD’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.
verses.ISA 40:8: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”
verses.ISA 40:9: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength! Lift it up! Don’t be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”
verses.ISA 40:10: Behold, the Lord GOD will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.
verses.ISA 40:11: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.
verses.ISA 40:25: “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.
verses.ISA 40:26: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by name. By the greatness of his might, and because he is strong in power, not one is lacking.
verses.ISA 40:27: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from the LORD, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God”?
verses.ISA 40:28: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.
verses.ISA 40:29: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
verses.ISA 40:30: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;
verses.ISA 40:31: but those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
verses.ISA 41:13: For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
verses.ISA 41:14: Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says the LORD. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
