verses.ISA 41:15: Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and will make the hills like chaff.
verses.ISA 41:16: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in the LORD. You will glory in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.ISA 41:17: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
verses.ISA 41:18: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the middle of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
verses.ISA 41:19: I will put cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will set cypress trees, pine, and box trees together in the desert;
verses.ISA 41:20: that they may see, know, consider, and understand together, that the LORD’s hand has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.
verses.ISA 42:1: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations.
verses.ISA 42:2: He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street.
verses.ISA 42:3: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.
verses.ISA 42:4: He will not fail nor be discouraged, until he has set justice on the earth, and the islands wait for his law.”
verses.ISA 42:6: “I, the LORD, have called you in righteousness. I will hold your hand. I will keep you, and make you a covenant for the people, as a light for the nations,
verses.ISA 42:7: to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison.
verses.ISA 42:5: God the LORD, he who created the heavens and stretched them out, he who spread out the earth and that which comes out of it, he who gives breath to its people and spirit to those who walk in it, says:
verses.ISA 43:16: The LORD, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters,
verses.ISA 43:17: who brings out the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched like a wick) says:
verses.ISA 43:18: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.
verses.ISA 43:19: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verses.ISA 43:20: The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me, because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,
verses.ISA 43:21: the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.
verses.ISA 43:22: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; but you have been weary of me, Israel.
verses.ISA 43:24: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices, but you have burdened me with your sins. You have wearied me with your iniquities.
verses.ISA 43:25: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
verses.ISA 45:1: The LORD says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have held to subdue nations before him and strip kings of their armor, to open the doors before him, and the gates shall not be shut:
verses.ISA 45:4: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel my chosen, I have called you by your name. I have given you a title, though you have not known me.
verses.ISA 45:5: I am the LORD, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me,
verses.ISA 45:6: that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is no one besides me. I am the LORD, and there is no one else.
verses.ISA 45:7: I form the light and create darkness. I make peace and create calamity. I am the LORD, who does all these things.
verses.ISA 45:8: Rain, you heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open, that it may produce salvation, and let it cause righteousness to spring up with it. I, the LORD, have created it.
verses.ISA 45:18: For the LORD who created the heavens, the God who formed the earth and made it, who established it and didn’t create it a waste, who formed it to be inhabited says: “I am the LORD. There is no other.
verses.ISA 45:21: Declare and present it. Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has shown this from ancient time? Who has declared it of old? Haven’t I, the LORD? There is no other God besides me, a just God and a Savior. There is no one besides me.
verses.ISA 45:22: “Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
verses.ISA 45:23: I have sworn by myself. The word has gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and will not be revoked, that to me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall take an oath.
verses.ISA 45:24: They will say of me, ‘There is righteousness and strength only in the LORD.’” Even to him will men come. All those who raged against him will be disappointed.
verses.ISA 45:25: All the offspring of Israel will be justified in the LORD, and will rejoice!
verses.ISA 48:17: The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.
verses.ISA 48:18: Oh that you had listened to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.
verses.ISA 48:19: Your offspring also would have been as the sand and the descendants of your body like its grains. His name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me.”
verses.ISA 49:1: Listen, islands, to me. Listen, you peoples, from afar: the LORD has called me from the womb; from the inside of my mother, he has mentioned my name.
verses.ISA 49:2: He has made my mouth like a sharp sword. He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand. He has made me a polished shaft. He has kept me close in his quiver.
verses.ISA 49:3: He said to me, “You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified.”
verses.ISA 49:4: But I said, “I have labored in vain. I have spent my strength in vain for nothing; yet surely the justice due to me is with the LORD, and my reward with my God.”
verses.ISA 49:5: Now the LORD, he who formed me from the womb to be his servant, says to bring Jacob again to him, and to gather Israel to him, for I am honorable in the LORD’s eyes, and my God has become my strength.
verses.ISA 49:6: Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel. I will also give you as a light to the nations, that you may be my salvation to the end of the earth.”
verses.ISA 49:14: But Zion said, “The LORD has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me.”
verses.ISA 49:15: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!
verses.ISA 49:8: The LORD says, “I have answered you in an acceptable time. I have helped you in a day of salvation. I will preserve you and give you for a covenant of the people, to raise up the land, to make them inherit the desolate heritage,
verses.ISA 49:9: saying to those who are bound, ‘Come out!’; to those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves!’ “They shall feed along the paths, and their pasture shall be on all treeless heights.
verses.ISA 49:10: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them, for he who has mercy on them will lead them. He will guide them by springs of water.
verses.ISA 49:11: I will make all my mountains a road, and my highways shall be exalted.
verses.ISA 49:12: Behold, these shall come from afar, and behold, these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Sinim.”
verses.ISA 49:13: Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains! For the LORD has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted.
verses.ISA 4:2: In that day, the LORD’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel.
verses.ISA 4:3: It will happen that he who is left in Zion and he who remains in Jerusalem shall be called holy, even everyone who is written among the living in Jerusalem,
verses.ISA 4:4: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from within it, by the spirit of justice and by the spirit of burning.
verses.ISA 4:5: The LORD will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all the glory will be a canopy.
verses.ISA 4:6: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.
verses.ISA 50:4: The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is weary. He awakens morning by morning, he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught.
verses.ISA 50:5: The Lord GOD has opened my ear. I was not rebellious. I have not turned back.
verses.ISA 50:6: I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame and spitting.
verses.ISA 50:7: For the Lord GOD will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I won’t be disappointed.
verses.ISA 50:8: He who justifies me is near. Who will bring charges against me? Let us stand up together. Who is my adversary? Let him come near to me.
verses.ISA 50:9: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me! Who is he who will condemn me? Behold, they will all grow old like a garment. The moths will eat them up.
verses.ISA 52:13: Behold, my servant will deal wisely. He will be exalted and lifted up, and will be very high.
verses.ISA 52:14: Just as many were astonished at you— his appearance was marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men—
verses.ISA 52:15: so he will cleanse many nations. Kings will shut their mouths at him; for they will see that which had not been told them, and they will understand that which they had not heard.
verses.ISA 53:1: Who has believed our message? To whom has the LORD’s arm been revealed?
verses.ISA 53:2: For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. He has no good looks or majesty. When we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
verses.ISA 53:3: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn’t respect him.
verses.ISA 53:4: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.
verses.ISA 53:5: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.
verses.ISA 53:6: All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verses.ISA 53:7: He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he didn’t open his mouth.
verses.ISA 53:8: He was taken away by oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living and stricken for the disobedience of my people?
verses.ISA 53:9: They made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.
verses.ISA 53:10: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will see his offspring. He will prolong his days and the LORD’s pleasure will prosper in his hand.
verses.ISA 53:11: After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself; and he will bear their iniquities.
verses.ISA 53:12: Therefore I will give him a portion with the great. He will divide the plunder with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was counted with the transgressors; yet he bore the sins of many and made intercession for the transgressors.
verses.ISA 52:7: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news, who proclaims salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!”
verses.ISA 52:8: Your watchmen lift up their voice. Together they sing; for they shall see eye to eye when the LORD returns to Zion.
verses.ISA 52:9: Break out into joy! Sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem; for the LORD has comforted his people. He has redeemed Jerusalem.
verses.ISA 52:10: The LORD has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.ISA 54:1: “Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth! Break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn’t travail with child! For more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife,” says the LORD.
verses.ISA 54:2: “Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don’t spare; lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes.
verses.ISA 54:3: For you will spread out on the right hand and on the left; and your offspring will possess the nations and settle in desolate cities.
verses.ISA 54:4: “Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed. Don’t be confounded, for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget the shame of your youth. You will remember the reproach of your widowhood no more.
verses.ISA 54:5: For your Maker is your husband; the LORD of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be called the God of the whole earth.
verses.ISA 54:6: For the LORD has called you as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off,” says your God.
verses.ISA 54:7: “For a small moment I have forsaken you, but I will gather you with great mercies.
verses.ISA 54:8: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting loving kindness I will have mercy on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.
verses.ISA 54:9: “For this is like the waters of Noah to me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah will no more go over the earth, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you, nor rebuke you.
verses.ISA 54:10: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says the LORD who has mercy on you.
verses.ISA 54:11: “You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your foundations with sapphires.
verses.ISA 54:12: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
verses.ISA 54:13: All your children will be taught by the LORD, and your children’s peace will be great.
verses.ISA 54:14: You will be established in righteousness. You will be far from oppression, for you will not be afraid, and far from terror, for it shall not come near you.
verses.ISA 55:1: “Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
verses.ISA 55:2: Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? Listen diligently to me, and eat that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in richness.
verses.ISA 55:3: Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.
verses.ISA 55:4: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander to the peoples.
verses.ISA 55:5: Behold, you shall call a nation that you don’t know; and a nation that didn’t know you shall run to you, because of the LORD your God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he has glorified you.”
verses.ISA 55:6: Seek the LORD while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
verses.ISA 55:7: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to the LORD, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.
verses.ISA 55:8: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says the LORD.
verses.ISA 55:9: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
verses.ISA 55:10: For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky, and doesn’t return there, but waters the earth, and makes it grow and bud, and gives seed to the sower and bread to the eater;
verses.ISA 55:11: so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.
verses.ISA 56:1: The LORD says: “Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is near and my righteousness will soon be revealed.
verses.ISA 56:6: Also the foreigners who join themselves to the LORD to serve him, and to love the LORD’s name, to be his servants, everyone who keeps the Sabbath from profaning it, and holds fast my covenant,
verses.ISA 56:7: I will bring these to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples.”
verses.ISA 56:2: Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast; who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.”
verses.ISA 56:3: Let no foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD speak, saying, “The LORD will surely separate me from his people.” Do not let the eunuch say, “Behold, I am a dry tree.”
verses.ISA 56:8: The Lord GOD, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says, “I will yet gather others to him, in addition to his own who are gathered.”
verses.ISA 58:1: “Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house of Jacob their sins.
verses.ISA 58:2: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways. As a nation that did righteousness, and didn’t forsake the ordinance of their God, they ask of me righteous judgments. They delight to draw near to God.
verses.ISA 58:3: ‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and you don’t notice?’ “Behold, in the day of your fast you find pleasure, and oppress all your laborers.
verses.ISA 58:4: Behold, you fast for strife and contention, and to strike with the fist of wickedness. You don’t fast today so as to make your voice to be heard on high.
verses.ISA 58:5: Is this the fast that I have chosen? A day for a man to humble his soul? Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under himself? Will you call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?
verses.ISA 58:6: “Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to release the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke?
verses.ISA 58:7: Isn’t it to distribute your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor who are cast out to your house? When you see the naked, that you cover him; and that you not hide yourself from your own flesh?
verses.ISA 58:8: Then your light will break out as the morning, and your healing will appear quickly; then your righteousness shall go before you, and the LORD’s glory will be your rear guard.
verses.ISA 58:9: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer. You will cry for help, and he will say, ‘Here I am.’ “If you take away from among you the yoke, finger pointing, and speaking wickedly;
verses.ISA 58:10: and if you pour out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will rise in darkness, and your obscurity will be as the noonday;
verses.ISA 58:11: and the LORD will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.
verses.ISA 58:12: Those who will be of you will build the old waste places. You will raise up the foundations of many generations. You will be called Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of Paths with Dwellings.
verses.ISA 58:13: “If you turn away your foot from the Sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day, and call the Sabbath a delight, and the holy of the LORD honorable, and honor it, not doing your own ways, nor finding your own pleasure, nor speaking your own words,
verses.ISA 58:14: then you will delight yourself in the LORD, and I will make you to ride on the high places of the earth, and I will feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father;” for the LORD’s mouth has spoken it.
verses.ISA 5:1: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.
verses.ISA 5:2: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.
verses.ISA 5:3: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.
verses.ISA 5:4: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?
verses.ISA 5:5: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.
verses.ISA 5:6: I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.”
verses.ISA 5:7: For the vineyard of the LORD of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression, for righteousness, but behold, a cry of distress.
verses.ISA 60:1: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and the LORD’s glory has risen on you!
verses.ISA 60:2: For behold, darkness will cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but the LORD will arise on you, and his glory shall be seen on you.
verses.ISA 60:3: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.
verses.ISA 60:4: “Lift up your eyes all around, and see: they all gather themselves together. They come to you. Your sons will come from far away, and your daughters will be carried in arms.
verses.ISA 60:5: Then you shall see and be radiant, and your heart will thrill and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea will be turned to you. The wealth of the nations will come to you.
verses.ISA 60:6: A multitude of camels will cover you, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah. All from Sheba will come. They will bring gold and frankincense, and will proclaim the praises of the LORD.
verses.ISA 61:1: The Lord GOD’s Spirit is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound,
verses.ISA 61:2: to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,
verses.ISA 61:10: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
verses.ISA 61:11: For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.
verses.ISA 61:3: to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he may be glorified.
verses.ISA 61:6: But you will be called the LORD’s priests. Men will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations. You will boast in their glory.
verses.ISA 61:8: “For I, the LORD, love justice. I hate robbery and iniquity. I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.ISA 61:9: Their offspring will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge them, that they are the offspring which the LORD has blessed.”
verses.ISA 62:1: For Zion’s sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her righteousness shines out like the dawn, and her salvation like a burning lamp.
verses.ISA 62:2: The nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name, which the LORD’s mouth will name.
verses.ISA 62:3: You will also be a crown of beauty in the LORD’s hand, and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.
verses.ISA 62:4: You will not be called Forsaken any more, nor will your land be called Desolate any more; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD delights in you, and your land will be married.
verses.ISA 62:5: For as a young man marries a virgin, so your sons will marry you. As a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.
verses.ISA 63:16: For you are our Father, though Abraham doesn’t know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, LORD, are our Father. Our Redeemer from everlasting is your name.
verses.ISA 63:17: O LORD, why do you make us wander from your ways, and harden our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’ sake, the tribes of your inheritance.
verses.ISA 64:1: Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence—
verses.ISA 64:3: When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.
verses.ISA 64:4: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.
verses.ISA 64:5: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?
verses.ISA 64:6: For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.
verses.ISA 64:7: There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.
verses.ISA 64:8: But now, LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.
verses.ISA 65:17: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.
verses.ISA 65:18: But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem to be a delight, and her people a joy.
verses.ISA 65:19: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard in her no more.
verses.ISA 65:20: “No more will there be an infant who only lives a few days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child will die one hundred years old, and the sinner being one hundred years old will be accursed.
verses.ISA 65:21: They will build houses and inhabit them. They will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
verses.ISA 66:1: The LORD says: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build to me? Where will I rest?
verses.ISA 66:10: “Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her. Rejoice for joy with her, all you who mourn over her;
verses.ISA 66:11: that you may nurse and be satisfied at the comforting breasts; that you may drink deeply, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.”
verses.ISA 66:12: For the LORD says, “Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream, and you will nurse. You will be carried on her side, and will be dandled on her knees.
verses.ISA 66:13: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”
verses.ISA 66:14: You will see it, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones will flourish like the tender grass. The LORD’s hand will be known among his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.
verses.ISA 66:18: “For I know their works and their thoughts. The time comes that I will gather all nations and languages, and they will come, and will see my glory.
verses.ISA 66:19: “I will set a sign among them, and I will send those who escape of them to the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, who draw the bow, to Tubal and Javan, to far-away islands, who have not heard my fame, nor have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the nations.
verses.ISA 66:20: They shall bring all your brothers out of all the nations for an offering to the LORD, on horses, in chariots, in litters, on mules, and on camels, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, says the LORD, as the children of Israel bring their offering in a clean vessel into the LORD’s house.
verses.ISA 66:21: Of them I will also select priests and Levites,” says the LORD.
verses.ISA 6:1: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.
verses.ISA 6:2: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.
verses.ISA 6:3: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
verses.ISA 6:4: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.
verses.ISA 6:5: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of Armies!”
verses.ISA 6:6: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.
verses.ISA 6:7: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”
verses.ISA 6:8: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”
verses.ISA 7:1: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
verses.ISA 7:2: David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.
verses.ISA 7:3: Then the LORD said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.
verses.ISA 7:4: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
verses.ISA 7:5: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,
verses.ISA 7:6: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel.”
verses.ISA 7:7: This is what the Lord GOD says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”
verses.ISA 7:8: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people.
verses.ISA 7:9: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”
verses.ISA 7:10: The LORD spoke again to Ahaz, saying,
verses.ISA 7:11: “Ask a sign of the LORD your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”
verses.ISA 7:12: But Ahaz said, “I won’t ask. I won’t tempt the LORD.”
verses.ISA 7:13: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?
verses.ISA 7:14: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
verses.ISA 8:10: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”
verses.ISA 9:1: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
verses.ISA 9:2: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.
verses.ISA 9:3: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.
verses.ISA 9:4: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.
verses.ISA 9:6: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
verses.ISA 9:7: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.
verses.JAM 1:1: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.
verses.JAM 1:2: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,
verses.JAM 1:3: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
verses.JAM 1:4: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
verses.JAM 1:5: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
verses.JAM 1:6: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.
verses.JAM 1:7: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
verses.JAM 1:8: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
verses.JAM 1:9: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;
verses.JAM 1:10: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.
verses.JAM 1:11: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.
verses.JAM 1:12: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.
verses.JAM 1:13: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.
verses.JAM 1:14: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
verses.JAM 1:15: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
verses.JAM 1:16: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.
verses.JAM 1:17: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.
verses.JAM 1:18: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
verses.JAM 1:21: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
verses.JAM 1:22: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
verses.JAM 1:27: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
verses.JAM 1:19: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
verses.JAM 1:20: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
verses.JAM 1:23: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;
verses.JAM 1:24: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.
verses.JAM 1:25: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.
verses.JAM 1:26: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.
verses.JAM 2:1: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.
verses.JAM 2:2: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,
verses.JAM 2:3: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”
verses.JAM 2:4: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
verses.JAM 2:5: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?
verses.JAM 2:6: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?
verses.JAM 2:7: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?
verses.JAM 2:8: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.
verses.JAM 2:9: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.
verses.JAM 2:14: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
verses.JAM 2:15: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,
verses.JAM 2:16: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?
verses.JAM 2:17: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.
verses.JAM 2:18: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.
verses.JAM 2:19: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.
verses.JAM 2:20: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?
verses.JAM 2:21: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?
verses.JAM 2:22: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.
verses.JAM 2:23: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he was called the friend of God.
verses.JAM 2:24: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.
verses.JAM 2:26: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.
verses.JAM 3:1: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.
verses.JAM 3:2: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.
verses.JAM 3:3: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.
verses.JAM 3:4: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.
verses.JAM 3:5: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
verses.JAM 3:6: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.
verses.JAM 3:7: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;
verses.JAM 3:8: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
verses.JAM 3:9: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.
verses.JAM 3:10: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
verses.JAM 3:13: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.
verses.JAM 3:14: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.
verses.JAM 3:15: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.
verses.JAM 3:16: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.
verses.JAM 3:17: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
verses.JAM 3:18: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
verses.JAM 4:1: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
verses.JAM 4:2: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.
verses.JAM 4:3: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.
verses.JAM 4:4: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
verses.JAM 4:5: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
verses.JAM 4:6: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
verses.JAM 4:7: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.JAM 4:8: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
verses.JAM 4:9: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.
verses.JAM 4:10: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
verses.JAM 4:13: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”
verses.JAM 4:14: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.
verses.JAM 4:15: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”
verses.JAM 4:16: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.
verses.JAM 4:17: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.
verses.JAM 5:1: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.
verses.JAM 5:2: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.
verses.JAM 5:3: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.
verses.JAM 5:4: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.
verses.JAM 5:5: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.
verses.JAM 5:6: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.
verses.JAM 5:13: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
verses.JAM 5:14: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;
verses.JAM 5:15: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.
verses.JAM 5:16: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.
verses.JAM 5:17: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.
verses.JAM 5:18: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.
verses.JAM 5:19: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,
verses.JAM 5:20: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
verses.JAM 5:7: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.
verses.JAM 5:8: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
verses.JAM 5:9: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.
verses.JAM 5:10: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
verses.JAM 5:11: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
verses.JAM 5:12: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.
verses.JOB 19:21: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.
verses.JOB 19:22: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.JOB 19:23: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
verses.JOB 19:24: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
verses.JOB 19:25: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
verses.JOB 19:26: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,
verses.JOB 19:27: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.
verses.JOB 1:6: Now on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan also came among them.
verses.JOB 1:7: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”
verses.JOB 1:8: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant, Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil.”
verses.JOB 1:9: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Does Job fear God for nothing?
verses.JOB 1:10: Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.
verses.JOB 1:11: But stretch out your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will renounce you to your face.”
verses.JOB 1:12: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don’t stretch out your hand.” So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD.
verses.JOB 1:13: It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
verses.JOB 1:14: that a messenger came to Job, and said, “The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them,
verses.JOB 1:15: and the Sabeans attacked, and took them away. Yes, they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”
verses.JOB 1:16: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The fire of God has fallen from the sky, and has burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”
verses.JOB 1:17: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The Chaldeans made three bands, and swept down on the camels, and have taken them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you.”
verses.JOB 1:18: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
verses.JOB 1:19: and behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young men, and they are dead. I alone have escaped to tell you.”
verses.JOB 1:20: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.
verses.JOB 1:21: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the LORD’s name.”
verses.JOB 1:22: In all this, Job didn’t sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.
verses.JOB 38:1: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind,
verses.JOB 38:12: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,
verses.JOB 38:13: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?
verses.JOB 38:14: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.
verses.JOB 38:15: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
verses.JOB 38:16: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?
verses.JOB 38:17: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
verses.JOB 38:18: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.
verses.JOB 38:19: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,
verses.JOB 38:20: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?
verses.JOB 38:21: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
verses.JOB 40:4: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
verses.JOB 38:8: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
verses.JOB 38:9: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,
verses.JOB 38:10: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
verses.JOB 38:11: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?
verses.JOB 3:1: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.
verses.JOB 3:3: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’
verses.JOB 3:4: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.
verses.JOB 3:11: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?
verses.JOB 3:12: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?
verses.JOB 3:13: For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,
verses.JOB 3:14: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;
verses.JOB 3:15: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;
verses.JOB 3:16: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.
verses.JOB 3:17: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.
verses.JOB 3:20: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,
verses.JOB 3:21: who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,
verses.JOB 3:22: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
verses.JOB 3:23: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
verses.JOB 42:2: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.
verses.JOB 42:3: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.
verses.JOB 42:5: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.
verses.JOB 42:6: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”
verses.JOB 42:12: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.
verses.JOB 42:13: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
verses.JOB 42:14: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.
verses.JOB 42:15: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.
verses.JOB 42:16: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.
verses.JOB 42:17: So Job died, being old and full of days.
verses.JOB 7:1: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?
verses.JOB 7:2: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,
verses.JOB 7:3: so I am made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.
verses.JOB 7:4: When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.
verses.JOB 7:6: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
verses.JOB 7:7: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.
verses.JOB 9:2: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?
verses.JOB 9:3: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.
verses.JOB 9:4: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
verses.JOB 9:5: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.
verses.JOB 9:6: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.
verses.JOB 9:7: He commands the sun and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.
verses.JOB 9:8: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.
verses.JOB 9:9: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.
verses.JOB 9:10: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.
verses.JOB 9:11: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.
verses.JOB 9:12: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’
verses.JOB 9:14: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him?
verses.JOB 9:15: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.
verses.JOB 9:16: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.
verses.JDT 13:18: Ozias said to her, “Blessed are you, daughter, in the sight of the Most High God, above all the women upon the earth; and blessed is the Lord God, who created the heavens and the earth, who directed you to cut off the head of the prince of our enemies.
verses.JDT 13:19: For your hope will not depart from the heart of men that remember the strength of God forever.
verses.JDT 13:20: May God turn these things to you for a perpetual praise, to visit you with good things, because you didn’t spare your life by reason of the affliction of our race, but prevented our ruin, walking a straight way before our God.” And all the people said, “Amen! Amen!”
verses.JDT 8:2: Her husband was Manasses, of her tribe and of her family. He died in the days of barley harvest.
verses.JDT 8:3: For he stood over those who bound sheaves in the field, and was overcome by the burning heat, and he fell on his bed, and died in his city Bethulia. So they buried him with his fathers in the field which is between Dothaim and Balamon.
verses.JDT 8:4: Judith was a widow in her house three years and four months.
verses.JDT 8:5: She made herself a tent upon the roof of her house, and put on sackcloth upon her loins. The garments of her widowhood were upon her.
verses.JDT 8:6: And she fasted all the days of her widowhood, except the eves of the Sabbaths, the Sabbaths, the eves of the new moons, the new moons, and the feasts and joyful days of the house of Israel.
verses.JDT 8:7: She was beautiful in appearance, and lovely to behold. Her husband Manasses had left her gold, silver, menservants, maidservants, cattle, and lands. She remained on those lands.
verses.JDT 8:8: No one said anything evil about her, for she feared God exceedingly.
verses.JER 11:18: The LORD gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it. Then you showed me their doings.
verses.JER 11:19: But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter. I didn’t know that they had devised plans against me, saying, “Let’s destroy the tree with its fruit, and let’s cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.”
verses.JER 11:20: But, LORD of Armies, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, I will see your vengeance on them; for to you I have revealed my cause.
verses.JER 13:1: The LORD said to me, “Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don’t put it in water.”
verses.JER 13:2: So I bought a belt according to the LORD’s word, and put it on my waist.
verses.JER 13:3: The LORD’s word came to me the second time, saying,
verses.JER 13:4: “Take the belt that you have bought, which is on your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.”
verses.JER 13:5: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.
verses.JER 13:6: After many days, the LORD said to me, “Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the belt from there, which I commanded you to hide there.”
verses.JER 13:7: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and took the belt from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the belt was ruined. It was profitable for nothing.
verses.JER 13:8: Then the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.JER 13:9: “The LORD says, ‘In this way I will ruin the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
verses.JER 13:10: This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and have gone after other gods to serve them and to worship them, will even be as this belt, which is profitable for nothing.
verses.JER 13:11: For as the belt clings to the waist of a man, so I have caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to me,’ says the LORD; ‘that they may be to me for a people, for a name, for praise, and for glory; but they would not hear.’
verses.JER 14:17: “You shall say this word to them: “‘Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease; for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous wound.
verses.JER 14:18: If I go out into the field, then behold, the slain with the sword! If I enter into the city, then behold, those who are sick with famine! For both the prophet and the priest go about in the land, and have no knowledge.’”
verses.JER 14:19: Have you utterly rejected Judah? Has your soul loathed Zion? Why have you struck us, and there is no healing for us? We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!
verses.JER 14:20: We acknowledge, LORD, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against you.
verses.JER 14:21: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake. Do not disgrace the throne of your glory. Remember, and don’t break your covenant with us.
verses.JER 14:22: Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? Or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, the LORD our God? Therefore we will wait for you; for you have made all these things.
verses.JER 15:10: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife, and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not lent, neither have men lent to me; yet every one of them curses me.
verses.JER 15:16: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by your name, LORD, God of Armies.
verses.JER 15:17: I didn’t sit in the assembly of those who make merry and rejoice. I sat alone because of your hand, for you have filled me with indignation.
verses.JER 15:18: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful brook, like waters that fail?
verses.JER 15:19: Therefore the LORD says, “If you return, then I will bring you again, that you may stand before me; and if you take out the precious from the vile, you will be as my mouth. They will return to you, but you will not return to them.
verses.JER 15:20: I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall. They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you to save you and to deliver you,” says the LORD.
verses.JER 15:21: “I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible.”
verses.JER 17:5: The LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in man, relies on strength of flesh, and whose heart departs from the LORD.
verses.JER 17:6: For he will be like a bush in the desert, and will not see when good comes, but will inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, an uninhabited salt land.
verses.JER 17:7: “Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, and whose confidence is in the LORD.
verses.JER 17:8: For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat comes, but its leaf will be green, and will not be concerned in the year of drought. It won’t cease from yielding fruit.
verses.JER 17:9: The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?
verses.JER 17:10: “I, the LORD, search the mind. I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.”
verses.JER 18:1: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.JER 18:2: “Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear my words.”
verses.JER 18:3: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was making something on the wheels.
verses.JER 18:4: When the vessel that he made of the clay was marred in the hand of the potter, he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
verses.JER 18:5: Then the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.JER 18:6: “House of Israel, can’t I do with you as this potter?” says the LORD. “Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, house of Israel.
verses.JER 18:18: Then they said, “Come! Let’s devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law won’t perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let’s strike him with the tongue, and let’s not give heed to any of his words.”
verses.JER 18:19: Give heed to me, LORD, and listen to the voice of those who contend with me.
verses.JER 18:20: Should evil be recompensed for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from them.
verses.JER 1:1: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.
verses.JER 1:4: Now the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.JER 1:5: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”
verses.JER 1:6: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”
verses.JER 1:7: But the LORD said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.
verses.JER 1:8: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says the LORD.
verses.JER 1:9: Then the LORD stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then the LORD said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.
verses.JER 1:10: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”
verses.JER 1:17: “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.
verses.JER 1:18: For behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.
verses.JER 1:19: They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you”, says the LORD, “to rescue you.”
verses.JER 20:10: For I have heard the defaming of many: “Terror on every side! Denounce, and we will denounce him!” say all my familiar friends, those who watch for my fall. “Perhaps he will be persuaded, and we will prevail against him, and we will take our revenge on him.”
verses.JER 20:11: But the LORD is with me as an awesome mighty one. Therefore my persecutors will stumble, and they won’t prevail. They will be utterly disappointed because they have not dealt wisely, even with an everlasting dishonor which will never be forgotten.
verses.JER 20:12: But the LORD of Armies, who tests the righteous, who sees the heart and the mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for I have revealed my cause to you.
verses.JER 20:13: Sing to the LORD! Praise the LORD, for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers.
verses.JER 20:7: LORD, you have persuaded me, and I was persuaded. You are stronger than I, and have prevailed. I have become a laughingstock all day. Everyone mocks me.
verses.JER 20:8: For as often as I speak, I cry out; I cry, “Violence and destruction!” because the LORD’s word has been made a reproach to me, and a derision, all day.
verses.JER 20:9: If I say that I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones. I am weary with holding it in. I can’t.
verses.JER 23:1: “Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!” says the LORD.
verses.JER 23:2: Therefore the LORD, the God of Israel, says against the shepherds who feed my people: “You have scattered my flock, driven them away, and have not visited them. Behold, I will visit on you the evil of your doings,” says the LORD.
verses.JER 23:3: “I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they will be fruitful and multiply.
verses.JER 23:4: I will set up shepherds over them who will feed them. They will no longer be afraid or dismayed, neither will any be lacking,” says the LORD.
verses.JER 23:5: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will raise to David a righteous Branch; and he will reign as king and deal wisely, and will execute justice and righteousness in the land.
verses.JER 23:6: In his days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell safely. This is his name by which he will be called: The LORD our righteousness.
verses.JER 23:7: “Therefore, behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that they will no more say, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’
verses.JER 23:8: but, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up and who led the offspring of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all the countries where I had driven them.’ Then they will dwell in their own land.”
verses.JER 26:1: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from the LORD:
verses.JER 26:2: “The LORD says: ‘Stand in the court of the LORD’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah which come to worship in the LORD’s house, all the words that I command you to speak to them. Don’t omit a word.
verses.JER 26:3: It may be they will listen, and every man turn from his evil way, that I may relent from the evil which I intend to do to them because of the evil of their doings.’”
verses.JER 26:4: You shall tell them, “The LORD says: ‘If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law which I have set before you,
verses.JER 26:5: to listen to the words of my servants the prophets whom I send to you, even rising up early and sending them—but you have not listened—
verses.JER 26:6: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.’”
verses.JER 26:7: The priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the LORD’s house.
verses.JER 26:8: When Jeremiah had finished speaking all that the LORD had commanded him to speak to all the people, the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him, saying, “You shall surely die!
verses.JER 26:9: Why have you prophesied in the LORD’s name, saying, ‘This house will be like Shiloh, and this city will be desolate, without inhabitant’?” All the people were crowded around Jeremiah in the LORD’s house.
verses.JER 26:11: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the princes and to all the people, saying, “This man is worthy of death, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.”
verses.JER 26:12: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the princes and to all the people, saying, “The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.
verses.JER 26:13: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey the LORD your God’s voice; then the LORD will relent from the evil that he has pronounced against you.
verses.JER 26:14: But as for me, behold, I am in your hand. Do with me what is good and right in your eyes.
verses.JER 26:15: Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood on yourselves, on this city, and on its inhabitants; for in truth the LORD has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.”
verses.JER 26:16: Then the princes and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets: “This man is not worthy of death; for he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.”
verses.JER 26:24: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that they didn’t give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
verses.JER 28:1: That same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spoke to me in the LORD’s house, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
verses.JER 28:2: “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.JER 28:3: Within two full years I will bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD’s house that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place and carried to Babylon.
verses.JER 28:4: I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, who went to Babylon,’ says the LORD; ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’”
verses.JER 28:5: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people who stood in the LORD’s house,
verses.JER 28:6: even the prophet Jeremiah said, “Amen! May the LORD do so. May the LORD perform your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD’s house, and all those who are captives, from Babylon to this place.
verses.JER 28:7: Nevertheless listen now to this word that I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people:
verses.JER 28:8: The prophets who have been before me and before you of old prophesied against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, of evil, and of pestilence.
verses.JER 28:9: As for the prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet happens, then the prophet will be known, that the LORD has truly sent him.”
verses.JER 28:10: Then Hananiah the prophet took the bar from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and broke it.
verses.JER 28:11: Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, “The LORD says: ‘Even so I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from off the neck of all the nations within two full years.’” Then the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
verses.JER 28:12: Then the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the bar from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
verses.JER 28:13: “Go, and tell Hananiah, saying, ‘The LORD says, “You have broken the bars of wood, but you have made in their place bars of iron.”
verses.JER 28:14: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they will serve him. I have also given him the animals of the field.”’”
verses.JER 28:15: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, “Listen, Hananiah! The LORD has not sent you, but you make this people trust in a lie.
verses.JER 28:16: Therefore the LORD says, ‘Behold, I will send you away from off the surface of the earth. This year you will die, because you have spoken rebellion against the LORD.’”
verses.JER 28:17: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
verses.JER 2:1: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
verses.JER 2:2: “Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, ‘The LORD says, “I remember for you the kindness of your youth, your love as a bride, how you went after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.
verses.JER 2:3: Israel was holiness to the LORD, the first fruits of his increase. All who devour him will be held guilty. Evil will come on them,”’ says the LORD.”
verses.JER 2:7: I brought you into a plentiful land to eat its fruit and its goodness; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.
verses.JER 2:8: The priests didn’t say, ‘Where is the LORD?’ and those who handle the law didn’t know me. The rulers also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed things that do not profit.
verses.JER 2:12: “Be astonished, you heavens, at this and be horribly afraid. Be very desolate,” says the LORD.
verses.JER 2:13: “For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and cut out cisterns for themselves: broken cisterns that can’t hold water.
verses.JER 30:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.JER 30:2: “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.
verses.JER 30:12: For the LORD says, “Your hurt is incurable. Your wound is grievous.
verses.JER 30:13: There is no one to plead your cause, that you may be bound up. You have no healing medicines.
verses.JER 30:14: All your lovers have forgotten you. They don’t seek you. For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins were increased.
verses.JER 30:15: Why do you cry over your injury? Your pain is incurable. For the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins have increased, I have done these things to you.
verses.JER 30:18: The LORD says: “Behold, I will reverse the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have compassion on his dwelling places. The city will be built on its own hill, and the palace will be inhabited in its own place.
verses.JER 30:19: Thanksgiving will proceed out of them with the voice of those who make merry. I will multiply them, and they will not be few; I will also glorify them, and they will not be small.
verses.JER 30:20: Their children also will be as before, and their congregation will be established before me. I will punish all who oppress them.
verses.JER 30:21: Their prince will be one of them, and their ruler will proceed from among them. I will cause him to draw near, and he will approach me; for who is he who has had boldness to approach me?” says the LORD.
verses.JER 30:22: “You shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.JER 31:1: “At that time,” says the LORD, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.”
verses.JER 31:2: The LORD says, “The people who survive the sword found favor in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.”
verses.JER 31:3: The LORD appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.
verses.JER 31:4: I will build you again, and you will be built, O virgin of Israel. You will again be adorned with your tambourines, and will go out in the dances of those who make merry.
verses.JER 31:5: Again you will plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria. The planters will plant, and will enjoy its fruit.
verses.JER 31:6: For there will be a day that the watchmen on the hills of Ephraim cry, ‘Arise! Let’s go up to Zion to the LORD our God.’”
verses.JER 31:7: For the LORD says, “Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout for the chief of the nations. Publish, praise, and say, ‘LORD, save your people, the remnant of Israel!’
verses.JER 31:10: “Hear the LORD’s word, you nations, and declare it in the distant islands. Say, ‘He who scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd does his flock.’
verses.JER 31:11: For the LORD has ransomed Jacob, and redeemed him from the hand of him who was stronger than he.
verses.JER 31:12: They will come and sing in the height of Zion, and will flow to the goodness of the LORD, to the grain, to the new wine, to the oil, and to the young of the flock and of the herd. Their soul will be as a watered garden. They will not sorrow any more at all.
verses.JER 31:13: Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance, the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
verses.JER 31:31: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah,
