verses.JER 31:32: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt, which covenant of mine they broke, although I was a husband to them,” says the LORD.
verses.JER 31:33: “But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the LORD: “I will put my law in their inward parts, and I will write it in their heart. I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.JER 31:34: They will no longer each teach his neighbor, and every man teach his brother, saying, ‘Know the LORD;’ for they will all know me, from their least to their greatest,” says the LORD, “for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.”
verses.JER 31:8: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the uttermost parts of the earth, along with the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her who travails with child together. They will return as a great company.
verses.JER 31:9: They will come with weeping. I will lead them with petitions. I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters, in a straight way in which they won’t stumble; for I am a father to Israel. Ephraim is my firstborn.
verses.JER 33:14: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will perform that good word which I have spoken concerning the house of Israel and concerning the house of Judah.
verses.JER 33:15: “In those days and at that time, I will cause a Branch of righteousness to grow up to David. He will execute justice and righteousness in the land.
verses.JER 33:16: In those days Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will dwell safely. This is the name by which she will be called: The LORD our righteousness.”
verses.JER 38:4: Then the princes said to the king, “Please let this man be put to death, because he weakens the hands of the men of war who remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words to them; for this man doesn’t seek the welfare of this people, but harm.”
verses.JER 38:5: Zedekiah the king said, “Behold, he is in your hand; for the king can’t do anything to oppose you.”
verses.JER 38:6: Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard. They let down Jeremiah with cords. In the dungeon there was no water, but mire; and Jeremiah sank in the mire.
verses.JER 38:8: Ebedmelech went out of the king’s house, and spoke to the king, saying,
verses.JER 38:9: “My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon. He is likely to die in the place where he is, because of the famine; for there is no more bread in the city.”
verses.JER 38:10: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, “Take from here thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he dies.”
verses.JER 3:14: “Return, backsliding children,” says the LORD, “for I am a husband to you. I will take one of you from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.
verses.JER 3:15: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
verses.JER 3:16: It will come to pass, when you are multiplied and increased in the land in those days,” says the LORD, “they will no longer say, ‘the ark of the LORD’s covenant!’ It will not come to mind. They won’t remember it. They won’t miss it, nor will another be made.
verses.JER 3:17: At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘The LORD’s Throne;’ and all the nations will be gathered to it, to the LORD’s name, to Jerusalem. They will no longer walk after the stubbornness of their evil heart.
verses.JER 7:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.JER 7:2: “Stand in the gate of the LORD’s house, and proclaim this word there, and say, ‘Hear the LORD’s word, all you of Judah, who enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.’”
verses.JER 7:3: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.JER 7:4: Don’t trust in lying words, saying, ‘The LORD’s temple, the LORD’s temple, the LORD’s temple, are these.’
verses.JER 7:5: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;
verses.JER 7:6: if you don’t oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and don’t shed innocent blood in this place, and don’t walk after other gods to your own hurt,
verses.JER 7:7: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old even forever more.
verses.JER 7:8: Behold, you trust in lying words that can’t profit.
verses.JER 7:9: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have not known,
verses.JER 7:10: then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, ‘We are delivered,’ that you may do all these abominations?
verses.JER 7:11: Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it,” says the LORD.
verses.JER 7:23: but this thing I commanded them, saying, ‘Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people. Walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.’
verses.JER 7:24: But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
verses.JER 7:25: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt to this day, I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them.
verses.JER 7:26: Yet they didn’t listen to me or incline their ear, but made their neck stiff. They did worse than their fathers.
verses.JER 7:27: “You shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you. You shall also call to them, but they will not answer you.
verses.JER 7:28: You shall tell them, ‘This is the nation that has not listened to the LORD their God’s voice, nor received instruction. Truth has perished, and is cut off from their mouth.’
verses.JDG 11:29: Then the LORD’s Spirit came on Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpah of Gilead, and from Mizpah of Gilead he passed over to the children of Ammon.
verses.JDG 11:30: Jephthah vowed a vow to the LORD, and said, “If you will indeed deliver the children of Ammon into my hand,
verses.JDG 11:31: then it shall be, that whatever comes out of the doors of my house to meet me when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, it shall be the LORD’s, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.”
verses.JDG 11:32: So Jephthah passed over to the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hand.
verses.JDG 11:33: He struck them from Aroer until you come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and to Abelcheramim, with a very great slaughter. So the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
verses.JDG 11:34: Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house; and behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances. She was his only child. Besides her he had neither son nor daughter.
verses.JDG 11:35: When he saw her, he tore his clothes, and said, “Alas, my daughter! You have brought me very low, and you are one of those who trouble me; for I have opened my mouth to the LORD, and I can’t go back.”
verses.JDG 11:36: She said to him, “My father, you have opened your mouth to the LORD; do to me according to that which has proceeded out of your mouth, because the LORD has taken vengeance for you on your enemies, even on the children of Ammon.”
verses.JDG 11:37: Then she said to her father, “Let this thing be done for me. Leave me alone two months, that I may depart and go down on the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my companions.”
verses.JDG 11:38: He said, “Go.” He sent her away for two months; and she departed, she and her companions, and mourned her virginity on the mountains.
verses.JDG 11:39: At the end of two months, she returned to her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed. She was a virgin. It became a custom in Israel
verses.JDG 13:2: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and childless.
verses.JDG 13:3: The LORD’s angel appeared to the woman, and said to her, “See now, you are barren and childless; but you shall conceive and bear a son.
verses.JDG 13:4: Now therefore please beware and drink no wine nor strong drink, and don’t eat any unclean thing;
verses.JDG 13:5: for, behold, you shall conceive and give birth to a son. No razor shall come on his head, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb. He shall begin to save Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.”
verses.JDG 13:6: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, “A man of God came to me, and his face was like the face of the angel of God, very awesome. I didn’t ask him where he was from, neither did he tell me his name;
verses.JDG 13:7: but he said to me, ‘Behold, you shall conceive and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink. Don’t eat any unclean thing, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death.’”
verses.JDG 13:24: The woman bore a son and named him Samson. The child grew, and the LORD blessed him.
verses.JDG 13:25: The LORD’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
verses.JDG 2:11: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals.
verses.JDG 2:12: They abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed themselves down to them; and they provoked the LORD to anger.
verses.JDG 2:13: They abandoned the LORD, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.
verses.JDG 2:14: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.
verses.JDG 2:15: Wherever they went out, the LORD’s hand was against them for evil, as the LORD had spoken, and as the LORD had sworn to them; and they were very distressed.
verses.JDG 2:16: The LORD raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.
verses.JDG 2:17: Yet they didn’t listen to their judges; for they prostituted themselves to other gods, and bowed themselves down to them. They quickly turned away from the way in which their fathers walked, obeying the LORD’s commandments. They didn’t do so.
verses.JDG 2:18: When the LORD raised up judges for them, then the LORD was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for it grieved the LORD because of their groaning by reason of those who oppressed them and troubled them.
verses.JDG 2:19: But when the judge was dead, they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods to serve them and to bow down to them. They didn’t cease what they were doing, or give up their stubborn ways.
verses.JDG 6:11: The LORD’s angel came and sat under the oak which was in Ophrah, that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was beating out wheat in the wine press, to hide it from the Midianites.
verses.JDG 6:12: The LORD’s angel appeared to him, and said to him, “The LORD is with you, you mighty man of valor!”
verses.JDG 6:13: Gideon said to him, “Oh, my lord, if the LORD is with us, why then has all this happened to us? Where are all his wondrous works which our fathers told us of, saying, ‘Didn’t the LORD bring us up from Egypt?’ But now the LORD has cast us off, and delivered us into the hand of Midian.”
verses.JDG 6:14: The LORD looked at him, and said, “Go in this your might, and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Haven’t I sent you?”
verses.JDG 6:15: He said to him, “O Lord, how shall I save Israel? Behold, my family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.”
verses.JDG 6:16: The LORD said to him, “Surely I will be with you, and you shall strike the Midianites as one man.”
verses.JDG 6:17: He said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, then show me a sign that it is you who talk with me.
verses.JDG 6:18: Please don’t go away until I come to you, and bring out my present, and lay it before you.” He said, “I will wait until you come back.”
verses.JDG 6:19: Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened cakes of an ephah of meal. He put the meat in a basket and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out to him under the oak, and presented it.
verses.JDG 6:20: The angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened cakes, and lay them on this rock, and pour out the broth.” He did so.
verses.JDG 6:21: Then the LORD’s angel stretched out the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the meat and the unleavened cakes; and fire went up out of the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened cakes. Then the LORD’s angel departed out of his sight.
verses.JDG 6:22: Gideon saw that he was the LORD’s angel; and Gideon said, “Alas, Lord GOD! Because I have seen the LORD’s angel face to face!”
verses.JDG 6:23: The LORD said to him, “Peace be to you! Don’t be afraid. You shall not die.”
verses.JDG 6:24: Then Gideon built an altar there to the LORD, and called it “The LORD is Peace.” To this day it is still in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.JDG 9:6: All the men of Shechem assembled themselves together with all the house of Millo, and went and made Abimelech king by the oak of the pillar that was in Shechem.
verses.JDG 9:7: When they told it to Jotham, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and lifted up his voice, cried out, and said to them, “Listen to me, you men of Shechem, that God may listen to you.
verses.JDG 9:8: The trees set out to anoint a king over themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’
verses.JDG 9:9: “But the olive tree said to them, ‘Should I stop producing my oil, with which they honor God and man by me, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’
verses.JDG 9:10: “The trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and reign over us.’
verses.JDG 9:11: “But the fig tree said to them, ‘Should I leave my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’
verses.JDG 9:12: “The trees said to the vine, ‘Come and reign over us.’
verses.JDG 9:13: “The vine said to them, ‘Should I leave my new wine, which cheers God and man, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’
verses.JDG 9:14: “Then all the trees said to the bramble, ‘Come and reign over us.’
verses.JDG 9:15: “The bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade; and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.’
verses.JOE 1:13: Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests! Wail, you ministers of the altar. Come, lie all night in sackcloth, you ministers of my God, for the meal offering and the drink offering are withheld from your God’s house.
verses.JOE 1:14: Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of the LORD, your God, and cry to the LORD.
verses.JOE 1:15: Alas for the day! For the day of the LORD is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
verses.JOE 2:1: Blow the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, for the day of the LORD comes, for it is close at hand:
verses.JOE 2:2: A day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness. As the dawn spreading on the mountains, a great and strong people; there has never been the like, neither will there be any more after them, even to the years of many generations.
verses.JOE 2:12: “Yet even now,” says the LORD, “turn to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning.”
verses.JOE 2:13: Tear your heart and not your garments, and turn to the LORD, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.
verses.JOE 2:14: Who knows? He may turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him, even a meal offering and a drink offering to the LORD, your God.
verses.JOE 2:15: Blow the trumpet in Zion! Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly.
verses.JOE 2:16: Gather the people. Sanctify the assembly. Assemble the elders. Gather the children, and those who nurse from breasts. Let the bridegroom go out of his room, and the bride out of her chamber.
verses.JOE 2:17: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, “Spare your people, LORD, and don’t give your heritage to reproach, that the nations should rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’”
verses.JOE 2:18: Then the LORD was jealous for his land, and had pity on his people.
verses.JOE 2:28: “It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your old men will dream dreams. Your young men will see visions.
verses.JOE 2:29: And also on the servants and on the handmaids in those days, I will pour out my Spirit.
verses.JOE 2:30: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth: blood, fire, and pillars of smoke.
verses.JOE 2:31: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of the LORD comes.
verses.JOE 2:32: It will happen that whoever will call on the LORD’s name shall be saved; for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be those who escape, as the LORD has said, and among the remnant, those whom the LORD calls.
verses.JOE 3:12: “Let the nations arouse themselves, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.
verses.JOE 3:13: Put in the sickle; for the harvest is ripe. Come, tread, for the wine press is full, the vats overflow, for their wickedness is great.”
verses.JOE 3:14: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
verses.JOE 3:15: The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
verses.JOE 3:16: The LORD will roar from Zion, and thunder from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth will shake; but the LORD will be a refuge to his people, and a stronghold to the children of Israel.
verses.JOE 3:17: “So you will know that I am the LORD, your God, dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain. Then Jerusalem will be holy, and no strangers will pass through her any more.
verses.JOE 3:18: It will happen in that day, that the mountains will drop down sweet wine, the hills will flow with milk, all the brooks of Judah will flow with waters; and a fountain will flow out from the LORD’s house, and will water the valley of Shittim.
verses.JOE 3:19: Egypt will be a desolation and Edom will be a desolate wilderness, for the violence done to the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
verses.JOE 3:20: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
verses.JOE 3:21: I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed, for the LORD dwells in Zion.”
verses.JOH 10:1: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.
verses.JOH 10:2: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.JOH 10:3: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
verses.JOH 10:4: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
verses.JOH 10:5: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”
verses.JOH 10:6: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.
verses.JOH 10:7: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.
verses.JOH 10:8: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.
verses.JOH 10:9: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.
verses.JOH 10:10: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
verses.JOH 10:11: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
verses.JOH 10:12: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.
verses.JOH 10:13: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.
verses.JOH 10:16: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.
verses.JOH 10:17: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.
verses.JOH 10:18: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”
verses.JOH 10:22: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.
verses.JOH 10:23: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.
verses.JOH 10:24: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
verses.JOH 10:25: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.
verses.JOH 10:26: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.
verses.JOH 10:27: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
verses.JOH 10:28: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
verses.JOH 10:29: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
verses.JOH 10:30: I and the Father are one.”
verses.JOH 10:31: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
verses.JOH 10:32: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”
verses.JOH 10:33: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”
verses.JOH 10:34: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?
verses.JOH 10:35: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),
verses.JOH 10:36: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?
verses.JOH 10:37: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.
verses.JOH 10:38: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”
verses.JOH 10:39: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
verses.JOH 10:40: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.
verses.JOH 10:41: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”
verses.JOH 11:1: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.
verses.JOH 11:2: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
verses.JOH 11:3: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”
verses.JOH 11:4: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”
verses.JOH 11:5: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
verses.JOH 11:6: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.
verses.JOH 11:7: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”
verses.JOH 11:8: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”
verses.JOH 11:9: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
verses.JOH 11:10: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”
verses.JOH 11:11: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”
verses.JOH 11:12: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”
verses.JOH 11:13: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.
verses.JOH 11:14: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.
verses.JOH 11:15: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”
verses.JOH 11:16: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”
verses.JOH 11:17: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.
verses.JOH 11:18: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.
verses.JOH 11:19: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.
verses.JOH 11:20: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.
verses.JOH 11:21: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.
verses.JOH 11:22: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”
verses.JOH 11:23: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”
verses.JOH 11:24: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
verses.JOH 11:25: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
verses.JOH 11:26: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
verses.JOH 11:27: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”
verses.JOH 11:28: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”
verses.JOH 11:29: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.
verses.JOH 11:30: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.
verses.JOH 11:31: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”
verses.JOH 11:32: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”
verses.JOH 11:33: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,
verses.JOH 11:34: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”
verses.JOH 11:36: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”
verses.JOH 11:37: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”
verses.JOH 11:38: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
verses.JOH 11:39: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”
verses.JOH 11:40: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”
verses.JOH 11:41: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.
verses.JOH 11:42: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”
verses.JOH 11:43: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
verses.JOH 11:44: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”
verses.JOH 11:45: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.
verses.JOH 11:46: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.
verses.JOH 11:47: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.
verses.JOH 11:48: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
verses.JOH 11:49: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,
verses.JOH 11:50: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”
verses.JOH 11:51: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,
verses.JOH 11:52: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.
verses.JOH 11:53: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.
verses.JOH 11:54: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.
verses.JOH 11:55: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.
verses.JOH 11:56: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”
verses.JOH 11:57: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.
verses.JOH 12:1: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
verses.JOH 12:2: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.
verses.JOH 12:3: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
verses.JOH 12:4: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,
verses.JOH 12:5: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”
verses.JOH 12:6: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.
verses.JOH 12:7: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.
verses.JOH 12:8: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”
verses.JOH 12:9: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
verses.JOH 12:10: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
verses.JOH 12:11: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
verses.JOH 12:12: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.JOH 12:13: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”
verses.JOH 12:14: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,
verses.JOH 12:15: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”
verses.JOH 12:16: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.
verses.JOH 12:20: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.
verses.JOH 12:21: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
verses.JOH 12:22: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.
verses.JOH 12:23: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
verses.JOH 12:24: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
verses.JOH 12:25: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
verses.JOH 12:26: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
verses.JOH 12:27: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.
verses.JOH 12:28: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”
verses.JOH 12:29: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”
verses.JOH 12:30: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.
verses.JOH 12:31: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.
verses.JOH 12:32: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
verses.JOH 12:33: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
verses.JOH 12:44: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.
verses.JOH 12:45: He who sees me sees him who sent me.
verses.JOH 12:46: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
verses.JOH 12:47: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.JOH 12:48: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.
verses.JOH 12:49: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.
verses.JOH 12:50: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”
verses.JOH 13:1: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
verses.JOH 13:2: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,
verses.JOH 13:3: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,
verses.JOH 13:4: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.
verses.JOH 13:5: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
verses.JOH 13:6: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
verses.JOH 13:7: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
verses.JOH 13:8: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”
verses.JOH 13:9: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”
verses.JOH 13:10: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”
verses.JOH 13:11: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”
verses.JOH 13:12: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?
verses.JOH 13:13: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
verses.JOH 13:14: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
verses.JOH 13:15: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.
verses.JOH 13:16: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.
verses.JOH 13:17: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
verses.JOH 13:18: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’
verses.JOH 13:19: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.
verses.JOH 13:20: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”
verses.JOH 13:21: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
verses.JOH 13:22: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.
verses.JOH 13:23: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.
verses.JOH 13:24: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”
verses.JOH 13:25: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”
verses.JOH 13:26: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
verses.JOH 13:27: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”
verses.JOH 13:28: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.
verses.JOH 13:29: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.
verses.JOH 13:30: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.
verses.JOH 13:31: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
verses.JOH 13:32: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
verses.JOH 13:33: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.
verses.JOH 13:36: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”
verses.JOH 13:37: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
verses.JOH 13:38: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.
verses.JOH 13:34: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
verses.JOH 13:35: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
verses.JOH 14:1: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
verses.JOH 14:2: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
verses.JOH 14:3: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
verses.JOH 14:4: You know where I go, and you know the way.”
verses.JOH 14:5: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
verses.JOH 14:6: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
verses.JOH 14:7: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”
verses.JOH 14:8: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
verses.JOH 14:9: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
verses.JOH 14:10: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
verses.JOH 14:11: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
verses.JOH 14:12: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.
verses.JOH 14:15: If you love me, keep my commandments.
verses.JOH 14:16: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:
verses.JOH 14:23: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.
verses.JOH 14:24: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
verses.JOH 14:25: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.
verses.JOH 14:26: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
verses.JOH 14:17: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.
verses.JOH 14:18: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
verses.JOH 14:19: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
verses.JOH 14:20: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
verses.JOH 14:21: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”
verses.JOH 16:22: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
verses.JOH 14:22: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”
verses.JOH 14:27: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
verses.JOH 14:28: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
verses.JOH 14:29: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.
verses.JOH 14:30: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
verses.JOH 14:31: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.
verses.JOH 14:13: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.JOH 14:14: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
verses.JOH 15:1: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
verses.JOH 15:2: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
verses.JOH 15:3: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
verses.JOH 15:4: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
verses.JOH 15:5: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
verses.JOH 15:6: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.JOH 15:7: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
verses.JOH 15:8: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
verses.JOH 15:12: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
verses.JOH 15:13: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
verses.JOH 15:14: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.
verses.JOH 15:15: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
verses.JOH 15:17: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
verses.JOH 15:18: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
verses.JOH 15:19: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
verses.JOH 15:20: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
verses.JOH 15:21: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
verses.JOH 15:26: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
verses.JOH 15:27: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
verses.JOH 16:1: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
verses.JOH 16:2: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
verses.JOH 16:3: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.
verses.JOH 16:4: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.JOH 16:12: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
verses.JOH 16:13: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
verses.JOH 16:14: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.
verses.JOH 16:15: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.
verses.JOH 15:9: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
verses.JOH 15:10: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
verses.JOH 15:11: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
verses.JOH 16:16: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
verses.JOH 16:17: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”
verses.JOH 16:18: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”
verses.JOH 16:19: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?
verses.JOH 16:20: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
verses.JOH 16:21: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
verses.JOH 16:23: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
verses.JOH 16:24: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
verses.JOH 16:25: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
verses.JOH 16:26: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,
verses.JOH 16:27: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
verses.JOH 16:28: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”
verses.JOH 16:29: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.
verses.JOH 16:30: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”
verses.JOH 16:31: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
verses.JOH 16:32: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
verses.JOH 16:33: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
verses.JOH 16:5: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
verses.JOH 16:6: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
verses.JOH 16:7: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
verses.JOH 16:8: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
verses.JOH 16:9: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;
verses.JOH 16:10: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;
verses.JOH 16:11: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
verses.JOH 17:1: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;
verses.JOH 17:2: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
verses.JOH 17:3: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
verses.JOH 17:4: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
verses.JOH 17:5: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.
verses.JOH 17:6: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.
verses.JOH 17:7: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
verses.JOH 17:8: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.
verses.JOH 17:9: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
verses.JOH 17:10: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
verses.JOH 17:11: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
verses.JOH 17:12: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
verses.JOH 17:13: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
verses.JOH 17:14: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.JOH 17:15: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
verses.JOH 17:16: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.JOH 17:18: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.
verses.JOH 17:19: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
verses.JOH 17:20: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,
verses.JOH 17:21: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.
verses.JOH 17:22: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,
verses.JOH 17:23: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.
verses.JOH 17:24: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
verses.JOH 17:25: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.
verses.JOH 17:26: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
verses.JOH 18:1: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.
verses.JOH 18:2: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
verses.JOH 18:3: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
verses.JOH 18:4: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”
verses.JOH 18:5: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
verses.JOH 18:6: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.
verses.JOH 18:7: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
verses.JOH 18:8: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”
verses.JOH 18:9: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”
verses.JOH 18:10: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
verses.JOH 18:11: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”
verses.JOH 18:12: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,
verses.JOH 18:13: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
verses.JOH 18:14: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.
verses.JOH 18:15: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;
verses.JOH 18:16: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.
verses.JOH 18:17: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”
verses.JOH 18:18: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.
verses.JOH 18:19: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.
verses.JOH 18:20: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.
verses.JOH 18:21: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”
verses.JOH 18:22: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”
verses.JOH 18:23: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”
verses.JOH 18:24: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.
verses.JOH 18:25: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
verses.JOH 18:26: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”
verses.JOH 18:27: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.
verses.JOH 18:28: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.
verses.JOH 18:29: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
verses.JOH 18:30: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”
verses.JOH 18:31: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”
verses.JOH 18:32: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
verses.JOH 18:33: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
verses.JOH 18:34: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”
verses.JOH 18:35: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”
verses.JOH 18:36: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”
verses.JOH 18:37: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”
verses.JOH 18:38: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.
verses.JOH 18:39: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
verses.JOH 18:40: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.JOH 19:1: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.
verses.JOH 19:2: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.
verses.JOH 19:3: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.
verses.JOH 19:4: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”
verses.JOH 19:5: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”
verses.JOH 19:6: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”
verses.JOH 19:7: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”
verses.JOH 19:8: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.
verses.JOH 19:9: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.JOH 19:10: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”
verses.JOH 19:11: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”
verses.JOH 19:12: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”
verses.JOH 19:13: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”
verses.JOH 19:14: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”
verses.JOH 19:15: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”
verses.JOH 19:16: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.
verses.JOH 19:17: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,
verses.JOH 19:18: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.
verses.JOH 19:19: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
verses.JOH 19:20: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.
verses.JOH 19:21: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”
verses.JOH 19:22: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
verses.JOH 19:23: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
verses.JOH 19:24: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.
verses.JOH 19:25: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.JOH 19:26: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”
verses.JOH 19:27: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.
verses.JOH 19:28: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”
verses.JOH 19:29: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.
verses.JOH 19:30: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
verses.JOH 19:31: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.
verses.JOH 19:32: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;
verses.JOH 19:33: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.
verses.JOH 19:34: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
verses.JOH 19:35: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
verses.JOH 19:36: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”
verses.JOH 19:37: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”
verses.JOH 19:38: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.
verses.JOH 19:39: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.
verses.JOH 19:40: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
verses.JOH 19:41: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.
verses.JOH 19:42: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.
verses.JOH 1:1: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.JOH 1:2: The same was in the beginning with God.
verses.JOH 1:3: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.
verses.JOH 1:4: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
verses.JOH 1:5: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
verses.JOH 1:6: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.JOH 1:8: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.
verses.JOH 1:9: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
verses.JOH 1:10: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.
verses.JOH 1:11: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
verses.JOH 1:12: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
verses.JOH 1:13: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.JOH 1:14: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
verses.JOH 1:15: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”
verses.JOH 1:16: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
verses.JOH 1:17: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
verses.JOH 1:18: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
verses.JOH 1:19: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
verses.JOH 1:20: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”
verses.JOH 1:21: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”
verses.JOH 1:22: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
verses.JOH 1:23: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”
verses.JOH 1:24: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
verses.JOH 1:25: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
verses.JOH 1:26: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.
verses.JOH 1:27: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
verses.JOH 1:28: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.JOH 1:29: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
verses.JOH 1:30: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’
verses.JOH 1:31: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”
verses.JOH 1:32: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
verses.JOH 1:33: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
verses.JOH 1:34: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
verses.JOH 1:35: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
verses.JOH 1:36: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”
verses.JOH 1:37: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.JOH 1:38: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”
verses.JOH 1:39: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
verses.JOH 1:40: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
verses.JOH 1:41: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).
verses.JOH 1:42: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).
verses.JOH 1:43: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
verses.JOH 1:44: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.JOH 1:45: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
verses.JOH 1:46: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
verses.JOH 1:47: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
verses.JOH 1:48: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
verses.JOH 1:49: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”
verses.JOH 1:50: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”
verses.JOH 1:51: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
verses.JOH 20:1: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
verses.JOH 20:11: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,
verses.JOH 20:12: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
verses.JOH 20:13: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”
verses.JOH 20:14: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.
verses.JOH 20:15: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”
verses.JOH 20:16: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”
verses.JOH 20:17: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”
verses.JOH 20:18: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.
verses.JOH 20:2: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”
verses.JOH 20:3: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.
verses.JOH 20:4: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.
verses.JOH 20:5: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.
verses.JOH 20:6: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,
verses.JOH 20:7: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.
verses.JOH 20:8: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.
verses.JOH 20:9: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.
verses.JOH 20:19: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
verses.JOH 20:20: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.
verses.JOH 20:21: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”
verses.JOH 20:22: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!
verses.JOH 20:23: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”
verses.JOH 20:24: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.
verses.JOH 20:25: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”
verses.JOH 20:26: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”
verses.JOH 20:27: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”
verses.JOH 20:28: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
verses.JOH 20:29: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”
verses.JOH 20:30: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;
verses.JOH 20:31: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
verses.JOH 21:1: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.
verses.JOH 21:2: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
verses.JOH 21:3: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.
verses.JOH 21:4: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
verses.JOH 21:5: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”
verses.JOH 21:6: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.
verses.JOH 21:7: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.
verses.JOH 21:8: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.
verses.JOH 21:9: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
verses.JOH 21:10: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
verses.JOH 21:11: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
verses.JOH 21:12: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.JOH 21:13: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
verses.JOH 21:14: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
verses.JOH 21:15: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”
verses.JOH 21:16: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
verses.JOH 21:17: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
verses.JOH 21:18: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”
