verses.JOH 21:19: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”
verses.JOH 21:20: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
verses.JOH 21:21: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
verses.JOH 21:22: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
verses.JOH 21:23: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”
verses.JOH 21:24: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.
verses.JOH 21:25: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
verses.JOH 2:1: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.
verses.JOH 2:2: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.
verses.JOH 2:3: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”
verses.JOH 2:4: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
verses.JOH 2:5: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
verses.JOH 2:6: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.
verses.JOH 2:7: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.
verses.JOH 2:8: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.
verses.JOH 2:9: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom
verses.JOH 2:10: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”
verses.JOH 2:11: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
verses.JOH 2:12: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.
verses.JOH 2:13: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.JOH 2:14: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
verses.JOH 2:15: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.
verses.JOH 2:16: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”
verses.JOH 2:17: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”
verses.JOH 2:18: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”
verses.JOH 2:19: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”
verses.JOH 2:20: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”
verses.JOH 2:21: But he spoke of the temple of his body.
verses.JOH 2:22: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.
verses.JOH 2:23: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.
verses.JOH 2:24: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,
verses.JOH 2:25: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
verses.JOH 3:1: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
verses.JOH 3:2: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”
verses.JOH 3:3: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
verses.JOH 3:4: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”
verses.JOH 3:5: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
verses.JOH 3:6: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.JOH 3:7: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’
verses.JOH 3:8: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”
verses.JOH 3:13: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
verses.JOH 3:14: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
verses.JOH 3:15: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.JOH 3:16: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.JOH 3:17: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
verses.JOH 3:18: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.
verses.JOH 3:19: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.
verses.JOH 3:20: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
verses.JOH 3:21: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”
verses.JOH 3:22: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.
verses.JOH 3:23: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;
verses.JOH 3:24: for John was not yet thrown into prison.
verses.JOH 3:25: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.
verses.JOH 3:26: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”
verses.JOH 3:27: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.
verses.JOH 3:28: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
verses.JOH 3:29: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.
verses.JOH 3:30: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.JOH 3:31: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
verses.JOH 3:32: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
verses.JOH 3:33: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
verses.JOH 3:34: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
verses.JOH 3:35: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
verses.JOH 3:36: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
verses.JOH 3:9: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”
verses.JOH 3:10: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
verses.JOH 3:11: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.
verses.JOH 3:12: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
verses.JOH 4:19: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
verses.JOH 4:20: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”
verses.JOH 4:21: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.
verses.JOH 4:22: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
verses.JOH 4:23: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
verses.JOH 4:24: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
verses.JOH 4:42: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”
verses.JOH 4:15: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”
verses.JOH 4:43: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.
verses.JOH 4:44: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
verses.JOH 4:45: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.
verses.JOH 4:46: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.JOH 4:47: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
verses.JOH 4:48: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”
verses.JOH 4:49: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
verses.JOH 4:50: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
verses.JOH 4:51: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”
verses.JOH 4:52: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
verses.JOH 4:53: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.
verses.JOH 4:54: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
verses.JOH 4:5: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
verses.JOH 4:6: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
verses.JOH 4:7: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”
verses.JOH 4:8: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
verses.JOH 4:9: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
verses.JOH 4:10: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”
verses.JOH 4:11: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?
verses.JOH 4:12: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”
verses.JOH 4:13: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,
verses.JOH 4:14: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
verses.JOH 4:25: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”
verses.JOH 4:26: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”
verses.JOH 4:39: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”
verses.JOH 4:40: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.
verses.JOH 4:41: Many more believed because of his word.
verses.JOH 4:16: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”
verses.JOH 4:17: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’
verses.JOH 4:18: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”
verses.JOH 4:27: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”
verses.JOH 4:28: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,
verses.JOH 4:29: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”
verses.JOH 4:30: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.
verses.JOH 4:31: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
verses.JOH 4:32: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”
verses.JOH 4:33: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”
verses.JOH 4:34: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
verses.JOH 4:35: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.
verses.JOH 4:36: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
verses.JOH 4:37: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
verses.JOH 4:38: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”
verses.JOH 5:1: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.JOH 5:2: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.
verses.JOH 5:3: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;
verses.JOH 5:5: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
verses.JOH 5:6: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”
verses.JOH 5:7: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”
verses.JOH 5:8: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
verses.JOH 5:9: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.
verses.JOH 5:10: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”
verses.JOH 5:11: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”
verses.JOH 5:12: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”
verses.JOH 5:13: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.
verses.JOH 5:14: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”
verses.JOH 5:15: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
verses.JOH 5:16: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
verses.JOH 5:17: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”
verses.JOH 5:18: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
verses.JOH 5:19: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.
verses.JOH 5:20: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
verses.JOH 5:21: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.
verses.JOH 5:22: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
verses.JOH 5:23: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.
verses.JOH 5:24: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
verses.JOH 5:25: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.
verses.JOH 5:26: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.
verses.JOH 5:27: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
verses.JOH 5:28: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice
verses.JOH 5:29: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
verses.JOH 5:30: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.
verses.JOH 5:31: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.
verses.JOH 5:32: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.
verses.JOH 5:33: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
verses.JOH 5:34: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.
verses.JOH 5:35: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
verses.JOH 5:36: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
verses.JOH 5:37: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
verses.JOH 5:38: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.
verses.JOH 5:39: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.
verses.JOH 5:40: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
verses.JOH 5:41: I don’t receive glory from men.
verses.JOH 5:42: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.
verses.JOH 5:43: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
verses.JOH 5:44: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
verses.JOH 5:45: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
verses.JOH 5:46: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
verses.JOH 5:47: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
verses.JOH 6:1: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.
verses.JOH 6:2: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.
verses.JOH 6:3: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.
verses.JOH 6:4: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
verses.JOH 6:5: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”
verses.JOH 6:6: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.JOH 6:7: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”
verses.JOH 6:8: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
verses.JOH 6:9: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”
verses.JOH 6:10: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.JOH 6:11: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.
verses.JOH 6:12: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
verses.JOH 6:13: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.
verses.JOH 6:14: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”
verses.JOH 6:15: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
verses.JOH 6:16: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.
verses.JOH 6:17: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
verses.JOH 6:18: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
verses.JOH 6:19: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.
verses.JOH 6:20: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
verses.JOH 6:21: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
verses.JOH 6:22: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.
verses.JOH 6:23: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
verses.JOH 6:24: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
verses.JOH 6:25: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”
verses.JOH 6:26: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.
verses.JOH 6:27: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”
verses.JOH 6:28: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”
verses.JOH 6:29: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
verses.JOH 6:30: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?
verses.JOH 6:31: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”
verses.JOH 6:32: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.
verses.JOH 6:33: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”
verses.JOH 6:34: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”
verses.JOH 6:35: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
verses.JOH 6:36: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.
verses.JOH 6:37: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
verses.JOH 6:38: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
verses.JOH 6:39: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.
verses.JOH 6:40: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”
verses.JOH 6:41: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”
verses.JOH 6:42: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”
verses.JOH 6:43: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.
verses.JOH 6:44: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.
verses.JOH 6:45: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.
verses.JOH 6:46: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.
verses.JOH 6:47: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.
verses.JOH 6:48: I am the bread of life.
verses.JOH 6:49: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.
verses.JOH 6:50: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.
verses.JOH 6:51: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
verses.JOH 6:52: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
verses.JOH 6:53: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.
verses.JOH 6:54: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.JOH 6:55: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.JOH 6:56: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
verses.JOH 6:57: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.
verses.JOH 6:58: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”
verses.JOH 6:59: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.JOH 6:60: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
verses.JOH 6:61: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?
verses.JOH 6:62: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
verses.JOH 6:63: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
verses.JOH 6:64: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.
verses.JOH 6:65: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
verses.JOH 6:66: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.
verses.JOH 6:67: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”
verses.JOH 6:69: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
verses.JOH 7:1: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
verses.JOH 7:2: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.
verses.JOH 7:10: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
verses.JOH 7:25: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?
verses.JOH 7:26: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?
verses.JOH 7:27: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”
verses.JOH 7:28: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.
verses.JOH 7:29: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”
verses.JOH 7:30: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
verses.JOH 7:37: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!
verses.JOH 7:38: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
verses.JOH 7:39: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.
verses.JOH 7:40: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”
verses.JOH 7:41: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?
verses.JOH 7:42: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”
verses.JOH 7:43: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.
verses.JOH 7:44: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.
verses.JOH 7:45: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”
verses.JOH 7:46: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
verses.JOH 7:47: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?
verses.JOH 7:48: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?
verses.JOH 7:49: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”
verses.JOH 7:50: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,
verses.JOH 7:51: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”
verses.JOH 7:52: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”
verses.JOH 7:53: Everyone went to his own house,
verses.JOH 8:1: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
verses.JOH 8:2: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.
verses.JOH 8:3: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,
verses.JOH 8:4: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.
verses.JOH 8:5: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”
verses.JOH 8:6: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
verses.JOH 8:7: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”
verses.JOH 8:8: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
verses.JOH 8:9: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.
verses.JOH 8:10: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”
verses.JOH 8:11: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”
verses.JOH 8:13: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”
verses.JOH 8:14: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.
verses.JOH 8:15: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.
verses.JOH 8:16: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.
verses.JOH 8:17: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
verses.JOH 8:18: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”
verses.JOH 8:19: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”
verses.JOH 8:20: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
verses.JOH 8:21: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”
verses.JOH 8:22: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”
verses.JOH 8:23: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.
verses.JOH 8:24: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”
verses.JOH 8:25: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.
verses.JOH 8:26: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”
verses.JOH 8:27: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.
verses.JOH 8:28: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.
verses.JOH 8:29: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”
verses.JOH 8:30: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.
verses.JOH 8:31: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
verses.JOH 8:32: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
verses.JOH 8:33: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”
verses.JOH 8:34: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.
verses.JOH 8:35: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
verses.JOH 8:36: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
verses.JOH 8:37: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
verses.JOH 8:38: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”
verses.JOH 8:39: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.
verses.JOH 8:40: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
verses.JOH 8:41: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”
verses.JOH 8:42: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.
verses.JOH 8:51: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”
verses.JOH 8:52: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’
verses.JOH 8:53: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”
verses.JOH 8:54: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.
verses.JOH 8:55: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.
verses.JOH 8:56: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”
verses.JOH 8:57: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”
verses.JOH 8:58: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”
verses.JOH 8:59: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.
verses.JOH 9:1: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
verses.JOH 9:6: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,
verses.JOH 9:7: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.
verses.JOH 9:8: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”
verses.JOH 9:9: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”
verses.JOH 9:13: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.
verses.JOH 9:14: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
verses.JOH 9:15: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”
verses.JOH 9:16: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.
verses.JOH 9:17: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”
verses.JOH 9:34: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.
verses.JOH 9:35: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”
verses.JOH 9:36: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”
verses.JOH 9:37: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”
verses.JOH 9:38: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.
verses.JOH 9:2: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
verses.JOH 9:3: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.
verses.JOH 9:4: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
verses.JOH 9:5: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
verses.JOH 9:10: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”
verses.JOH 9:11: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”
verses.JOH 9:12: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”
verses.JOH 9:18: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,
verses.JOH 9:19: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”
verses.JOH 9:20: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
verses.JOH 9:21: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”
verses.JOH 9:22: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.
verses.JOH 9:23: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”
verses.JOH 9:24: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”
verses.JOH 9:25: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”
verses.JOH 9:26: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
verses.JOH 9:27: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”
verses.JOH 9:28: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
verses.JOH 9:29: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”
verses.JOH 9:30: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
verses.JOH 9:31: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.
verses.JOH 9:32: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.
verses.JOH 9:33: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”
verses.JOH 9:39: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”
verses.JOH 9:40: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”
verses.JOH 9:41: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
verses.JON 1:1: Now the LORD’s word came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
verses.JON 1:2: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach against it, for their wickedness has come up before me.”
verses.JON 1:3: But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.
verses.JON 1:4: But the LORD sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty storm on the sea, so that the ship was likely to break up.
verses.JON 1:5: Then the mariners were afraid, and every man cried to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone down into the innermost parts of the ship and he was laying down, and was fast asleep.
verses.JON 1:6: So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God will notice us, so that we won’t perish.”
verses.JON 1:7: They all said to each other, “Come! Let’s cast lots, that we may know who is responsible for this evil that is on us.” So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.
verses.JON 1:8: Then they asked him, “Tell us, please, for whose cause this evil is on us. What is your occupation? Where do you come from? What is your country? Of what people are you?”
verses.JON 1:9: He said to them, “I am a Hebrew, and I fear the LORD, the God of heaven, who has made the sea and the dry land.”
verses.JON 1:10: Then the men were exceedingly afraid, and said to him, “What have you done?” For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of the LORD, because he had told them.
verses.JON 1:11: Then they said to him, “What shall we do to you, that the sea may be calm to us?” For the sea grew more and more stormy.
verses.JON 1:12: He said to them, “Take me up, and throw me into the sea. Then the sea will be calm for you; for I know that because of me this great storm is on you.”
verses.JON 1:13: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not, for the sea grew more and more stormy against them.
verses.JON 1:14: Therefore they cried to the LORD, and said, “We beg you, LORD, we beg you, don’t let us die for this man’s life, and don’t lay on us innocent blood; for you, LORD, have done as it pleased you.”
verses.JON 1:15: So they took up Jonah and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging.
verses.JON 1:16: Then the men feared the LORD exceedingly; and they offered a sacrifice to the LORD and made vows.
verses.JON 1:17: The LORD prepared a huge fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
verses.JON 2:2: He said, “I called because of my affliction to the LORD. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.
verses.JON 2:3: For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.
verses.JON 2:4: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’
verses.JON 2:7: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.
verses.JON 3:1: The LORD’s word came to Jonah the second time, saying,
verses.JON 3:2: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”
verses.JON 3:3: So Jonah arose, and went to Nineveh, according to the LORD’s word. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, three days’ journey across.
verses.JON 3:4: Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried out, and said, “In forty days, Nineveh will be overthrown!”
verses.JON 3:5: The people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth, from their greatest even to their least.
verses.JON 3:6: The news reached the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, took off his royal robe, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
verses.JON 3:7: He made a proclamation and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, “Let neither man nor animal, herd nor flock, taste anything; let them not feed, nor drink water;
verses.JON 3:8: but let them be covered with sackcloth, both man and animal, and let them cry mightily to God. Yes, let them turn everyone from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands.
verses.JON 3:9: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we might not perish?”
verses.JON 3:10: God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way. God relented of the disaster which he said he would do to them, and he didn’t do it.
verses.JON 4:1: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.
verses.JON 4:2: He prayed to the LORD, and said, “Please, LORD, wasn’t this what I said when I was still in my own country? Therefore I hurried to flee to Tarshish, for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and you relent of doing harm.
verses.JON 4:3: Therefore now, LORD, take, I beg you, my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.”
verses.JON 4:4: The LORD said, “Is it right for you to be angry?”
verses.JON 4:5: Then Jonah went out of the city and sat on the east side of the city, and there made himself a booth and sat under it in the shade, until he might see what would become of the city.
verses.JON 4:6: The LORD God prepared a vine and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head to deliver him from his discomfort. So Jonah was exceedingly glad because of the vine.
verses.JON 4:7: But God prepared a worm at dawn the next day, and it chewed on the vine so that it withered.
verses.JON 4:8: When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he was faint and requested for himself that he might die. He said, “It is better for me to die than to live.”
verses.JON 4:9: God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?” He said, “I am right to be angry, even to death.”
verses.JON 4:10: The LORD said, “You have been concerned for the vine, for which you have not labored, neither made it grow; which came up in a night and perished in a night.
verses.JON 4:11: Shouldn’t I be concerned for Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than one hundred twenty thousand persons who can’t discern between their right hand and their left hand, and also many animals?”
verses.JOS 24:1: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, for their heads, for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.
verses.JOS 24:2: Joshua said to all the people, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Your fathers lived of old time beyond the River, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor. They served other gods.
verses.JOS 24:3: I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his offspring, and gave him Isaac.
verses.JOS 24:4: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
verses.JOS 24:5: “‘I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
verses.JOS 24:6: I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea. The Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and with horsemen to the Red Sea.
verses.JOS 24:7: When they cried out to the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. You lived in the wilderness many days.
verses.JOS 24:8: “‘I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that lived beyond the Jordan. They fought with you, and I gave them into your hand. You possessed their land, and I destroyed them from before you.
verses.JOS 24:9: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,
verses.JOS 24:10: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.
verses.JOS 24:11: “‘You went over the Jordan, and came to Jericho. The men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.
verses.JOS 24:12: I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with your sword, nor with your bow.
verses.JOS 24:13: I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of vineyards and olive groves which you didn’t plant.’
verses.JOS 24:15: If it seems evil to you to serve the LORD, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.”
verses.JOS 24:16: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;
verses.JOS 24:17: for it is the LORD our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.
verses.JOS 24:18: The LORD drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve the LORD; for he is our God.”
verses.JOS 24:14: “Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve the LORD.
verses.JOS 24:19: Joshua said to the people, “You can’t serve the LORD, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins.
verses.JOS 24:20: If you forsake the LORD, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after he has done you good.”
verses.JOS 24:21: The people said to Joshua, “No, but we will serve the LORD.”
verses.JOS 24:22: Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the LORD yourselves, to serve him.” They said, “We are witnesses.”
verses.JOS 24:23: “Now therefore put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to the LORD, the God of Israel.”
verses.JOS 24:24: The people said to Joshua, “We will serve the LORD our God, and we will listen to his voice.”
verses.JOS 24:25: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
verses.JOS 24:26: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of the LORD.
verses.JOS 24:27: Joshua said to all the people, “Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, for it has heard all the LORD’s words which he spoke to us. It shall be therefore a witness against you, lest you deny your God.”
verses.JOS 24:28: So Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.
verses.JOS 24:29: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being one hundred ten years old.
verses.JOS 3:7: The LORD said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.
verses.JOS 3:8: You shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘When you come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.’”
verses.JOS 3:9: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “Come here, and hear the words of the LORD your God.”
verses.JOS 3:10: Joshua said, “By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, and the Jebusite out from before you.
verses.JOS 3:11: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passes over before you into the Jordan.
verses.JOS 3:13: It shall be that when the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of GOD, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, that the waters of the Jordan will be cut off. The waters that come down from above shall stand in one heap.”
verses.JOS 3:14: When the people moved from their tents to pass over the Jordan, the priests who bore the ark of the covenant being before the people,
verses.JOS 3:15: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),
verses.JOS 3:16: the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan; and those that went down toward the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, were wholly cut off. Then the people passed over near Jericho.
verses.JOS 3:17: The priests who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan.
verses.JOS 5:9: The LORD said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.” Therefore the name of that place was called Gilgal to this day.
verses.JOS 5:10: The children of Israel encamped in Gilgal. They kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening in the plains of Jericho.
verses.JOS 5:11: They ate unleavened cakes and parched grain of the produce of the land on the next day after the Passover, in the same day.
verses.JOS 5:12: The manna ceased on the next day, after they had eaten of the produce of the land. The children of Israel didn’t have manna any more, but they ate of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.
verses.JUD 1:17: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.JUD 1:20: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
verses.JUD 1:21: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
verses.JUD 1:22: On some have compassion, making a distinction,
verses.JUD 1:23: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
verses.JUD 1:24: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,
verses.JUD 1:25: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
verses.LAM 2:2: The Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob without pity. He has thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Judah. He has brought them down to the ground. He has profaned the kingdom and its princes.
verses.LAM 2:10: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground. They keep silence. They have cast up dust on their heads. They have clothed themselves with sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
verses.LAM 2:11: My eyes fail with tears. My heart is troubled. My bile is poured on the earth, because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, because the young children and the infants swoon in the streets of the city.
verses.LAM 2:12: They ask their mothers, “Where is grain and wine?” when they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul is poured out into their mothers’ bosom.
verses.LAM 2:13: What shall I testify to you? What shall I liken to you, daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to you, that I may comfort you, virgin daughter of Zion? For your breach is as big as the sea. Who can heal you?
verses.LAM 2:14: Your prophets have seen false and foolish visions for you. They have not uncovered your iniquity, to reverse your captivity, but have seen for you false revelations and causes of banishment.
verses.LAM 2:18: Their heart cried to the Lord. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief. Don’t let your eyes rest.
verses.LAM 2:19: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, who faint for hunger at the head of every street.
verses.LAM 3:17: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.
verses.LAM 3:18: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from the LORD.”
verses.LAM 3:19: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
verses.LAM 3:20: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
verses.LAM 3:21: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
verses.LAM 3:22: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.
verses.LAM 3:23: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
verses.LAM 3:24: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
verses.LAM 3:25: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
verses.LAM 3:26: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
verses.LUK 10:1: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.
verses.LUK 10:2: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.
verses.LUK 10:3: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
verses.LUK 10:4: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.
verses.LUK 10:5: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
verses.LUK 10:6: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
