verses.MAR 9:17: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;
verses.MAR 9:18: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”
verses.MAR 9:19: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”
verses.MAR 9:20: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.
verses.MAR 9:21: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.
verses.MAR 9:22: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”
verses.MAR 9:23: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
verses.MAR 9:24: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
verses.MAR 9:25: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”
verses.MAR 9:26: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”
verses.MAR 9:27: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.
verses.MAR 9:28: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”
verses.MAR 9:29: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.”
verses.MAR 9:2: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.
verses.MAR 9:3: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
verses.MAR 9:4: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.
verses.MAR 9:5: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
verses.MAR 9:6: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.
verses.MAR 9:7: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”
verses.MAR 9:8: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.
verses.MAR 9:9: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
verses.MAR 9:10: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.
verses.MAR 9:11: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
verses.MAR 9:12: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?
verses.MAR 9:13: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”
verses.MAR 9:30: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,
verses.MAR 9:31: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”
verses.MAR 9:32: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.
verses.MAR 9:33: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”
verses.MAR 9:34: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.
verses.MAR 9:35: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”
verses.MAR 9:36: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,
verses.MAR 9:37: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”
verses.MAR 9:38: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”
verses.MAR 9:39: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.
verses.MAR 9:40: For whoever is not against us is on our side.
verses.MAR 9:41: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.
verses.MAR 9:42: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.
verses.MAR 9:43: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,
verses.MAR 9:44: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
verses.MAR 9:45: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—
verses.MAR 9:46: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
verses.MAR 9:47: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,
verses.MAR 9:48: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
verses.MAR 9:49: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.
verses.MAR 9:50: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”
verses.MAT 10:1: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.
verses.MAT 10:2: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;
verses.MAT 10:3: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;
verses.MAT 10:4: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
verses.MAT 10:5: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.
verses.MAT 10:6: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.MAT 10:7: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’
verses.MAT 10:16: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.
verses.MAT 10:17: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
verses.MAT 10:18: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
verses.MAT 10:19: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.
verses.MAT 10:20: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.
verses.MAT 10:21: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.
verses.MAT 10:22: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.MAT 10:23: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.
verses.MAT 10:24: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.
verses.MAT 10:25: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!
verses.MAT 10:26: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.
verses.MAT 10:27: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
verses.MAT 10:28: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.
verses.MAT 10:29: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.
verses.MAT 10:30: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
verses.MAT 10:31: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.MAT 10:32: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.
verses.MAT 10:33: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.
verses.MAT 10:34: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.
verses.MAT 10:35: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
verses.MAT 10:36: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.
verses.MAT 10:37: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.
verses.MAT 10:38: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.
verses.MAT 10:39: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.
verses.MAT 10:40: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.
verses.MAT 10:41: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.
verses.MAT 10:42: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”
verses.MAT 11:1: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.
verses.MAT 10:8: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.
verses.MAT 10:9: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.
verses.MAT 10:10: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
verses.MAT 10:11: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.
verses.MAT 10:12: As you enter into the household, greet it.
verses.MAT 10:13: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.
verses.MAT 10:14: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.
verses.MAT 10:15: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.
verses.MAT 11:11: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.
verses.MAT 11:12: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.
verses.MAT 11:13: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
verses.MAT 11:14: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.
verses.MAT 11:15: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.MAT 11:16: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions
verses.MAT 11:17: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’
verses.MAT 11:18: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’
verses.MAT 11:19: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”
verses.MAT 11:2: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples
verses.MAT 11:3: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”
verses.MAT 11:4: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:
verses.MAT 11:5: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
verses.MAT 11:6: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
verses.MAT 11:7: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
verses.MAT 11:8: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.
verses.MAT 11:9: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
verses.MAT 11:10: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
verses.MAT 11:20: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.
verses.MAT 11:21: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.MAT 11:22: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
verses.MAT 11:23: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.
verses.MAT 11:24: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”
verses.MAT 11:26: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.
verses.MAT 11:27: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.
verses.MAT 11:28: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
verses.MAT 11:29: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
verses.MAT 11:30: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
verses.MAT 12:1: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.
verses.MAT 12:2: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”
verses.MAT 12:3: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:
verses.MAT 12:4: how he entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?
verses.MAT 12:5: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?
verses.MAT 12:6: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.
verses.MAT 12:7: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.
verses.MAT 12:8: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
verses.MAT 12:14: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.MAT 12:15: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,
verses.MAT 12:16: and commanded them that they should not make him known,
verses.MAT 12:17: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
verses.MAT 12:18: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.
verses.MAT 12:19: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.
verses.MAT 12:20: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.
verses.MAT 12:21: In his name, the nations will hope.”
verses.MAT 12:38: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”
verses.MAT 12:39: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
verses.MAT 12:40: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verses.MAT 12:41: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.
verses.MAT 12:42: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.
verses.MAT 12:46: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.
verses.MAT 12:47: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”
verses.MAT 12:48: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”
verses.MAT 12:49: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
verses.MAT 12:50: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”
verses.MAT 13:1: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.
verses.MAT 13:2: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.
verses.MAT 13:3: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.
verses.MAT 13:4: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.
verses.MAT 13:5: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.
verses.MAT 13:6: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.
verses.MAT 13:7: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.
verses.MAT 13:8: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.
verses.MAT 13:9: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
verses.MAT 13:10: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”
verses.MAT 13:11: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
verses.MAT 13:12: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.
verses.MAT 13:13: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.
verses.MAT 13:14: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive;
verses.MAT 13:15: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’
verses.MAT 13:16: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.
verses.MAT 13:17: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.
verses.MAT 13:18: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.
verses.MAT 13:19: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.
verses.MAT 13:20: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;
verses.MAT 13:21: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.
verses.MAT 13:22: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.
verses.MAT 13:23: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”
verses.MAT 13:24: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,
verses.MAT 13:25: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.
verses.MAT 13:26: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.
verses.MAT 13:27: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’
verses.MAT 13:28: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’
verses.MAT 13:29: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.
verses.MAT 13:30: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”
verses.MAT 13:31: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,
verses.MAT 13:32: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”
verses.MAT 13:33: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”
verses.MAT 13:34: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,
verses.MAT 13:35: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”
verses.MAT 13:36: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”
verses.MAT 13:37: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,
verses.MAT 13:38: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.
verses.MAT 13:39: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.
verses.MAT 13:40: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.
verses.MAT 13:41: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,
verses.MAT 13:42: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.MAT 13:43: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.MAT 13:44: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.
verses.MAT 13:45: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,
verses.MAT 13:46: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.
verses.MAT 13:47: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,
verses.MAT 13:48: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.
verses.MAT 13:49: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,
verses.MAT 13:50: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
verses.MAT 13:51: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”
verses.MAT 13:52: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”
verses.MAT 13:53: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.
verses.MAT 13:54: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?
verses.MAT 13:55: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?
verses.MAT 13:56: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”
verses.MAT 13:57: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”
verses.MAT 13:58: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
verses.MAT 14:1: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,
verses.MAT 14:2: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”
verses.MAT 14:3: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
verses.MAT 14:4: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
verses.MAT 14:5: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
verses.MAT 14:6: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.
verses.MAT 14:7: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.
verses.MAT 14:8: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”
verses.MAT 14:9: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,
verses.MAT 14:10: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.
verses.MAT 14:11: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.
verses.MAT 14:12: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.
verses.MAT 14:13: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.
verses.MAT 14:14: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.
verses.MAT 14:15: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”
verses.MAT 14:16: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”
verses.MAT 14:17: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”
verses.MAT 14:18: He said, “Bring them here to me.”
verses.MAT 14:19: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.
verses.MAT 14:20: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.
verses.MAT 14:21: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.
verses.MAT 14:22: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
verses.MAT 14:23: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.
verses.MAT 14:24: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.
verses.MAT 14:25: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.
verses.MAT 14:26: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.
verses.MAT 14:27: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
verses.MAT 14:28: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”
verses.MAT 14:29: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.
verses.MAT 14:30: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
verses.MAT 14:31: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”
verses.MAT 14:32: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.
verses.MAT 14:33: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”
verses.MAT 14:34: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.
verses.MAT 14:35: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;
verses.MAT 14:36: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.
verses.MAT 15:21: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.
verses.MAT 15:22: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”
verses.MAT 15:23: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”
verses.MAT 15:24: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
verses.MAT 15:25: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”
verses.MAT 15:26: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
verses.MAT 15:27: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”
verses.MAT 15:28: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.
verses.MAT 15:29: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.
verses.MAT 15:30: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,
verses.MAT 15:31: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.
verses.MAT 15:32: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”
verses.MAT 15:33: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”
verses.MAT 15:34: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”
verses.MAT 15:35: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;
verses.MAT 15:36: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.
verses.MAT 15:37: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.
verses.MAT 16:13: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”
verses.MAT 16:14: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
verses.MAT 16:15: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”
verses.MAT 16:16: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
verses.MAT 16:17: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.
verses.MAT 16:18: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
verses.MAT 16:19: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”
verses.MAT 16:20: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.
verses.MAT 16:21: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.
verses.MAT 16:22: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”
verses.MAT 16:23: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”
verses.MAT 16:24: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.MAT 16:25: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.
verses.MAT 16:26: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?
verses.MAT 16:27: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will give to everyone according to his deeds.
verses.MAT 16:28: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”
verses.MAT 17:1: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.
verses.MAT 17:2: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.
verses.MAT 17:3: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.
verses.MAT 17:4: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
verses.MAT 17:5: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”
verses.MAT 17:6: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.
verses.MAT 17:7: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”
verses.MAT 17:8: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.
verses.MAT 17:9: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”
verses.MAT 17:10: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
verses.MAT 17:11: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things;
verses.MAT 17:12: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”
verses.MAT 17:13: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.
verses.MAT 17:14: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,
verses.MAT 17:15: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.
verses.MAT 17:16: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”
verses.MAT 17:17: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”
verses.MAT 17:18: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.
verses.MAT 17:19: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”
verses.MAT 17:20: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.
verses.MAT 17:22: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,
verses.MAT 17:23: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.
verses.MAT 17:24: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”
verses.MAT 17:25: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”
verses.MAT 17:26: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.
verses.MAT 17:27: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”
verses.MAT 18:1: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”
verses.MAT 18:2: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them
verses.MAT 18:3: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.MAT 18:4: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.MAT 18:5: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,
verses.MAT 18:10: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.
verses.MAT 18:11: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.
verses.MAT 18:12: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?
verses.MAT 18:13: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.
verses.MAT 18:14: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.
verses.MAT 18:15: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.
verses.MAT 18:16: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
verses.MAT 18:17: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.
verses.MAT 18:18: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.
verses.MAT 18:19: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.
verses.MAT 18:20: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
verses.MAT 18:21: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”
verses.MAT 18:22: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.
verses.MAT 18:23: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
verses.MAT 18:24: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.
verses.MAT 18:25: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
verses.MAT 18:26: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’
verses.MAT 18:27: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.
verses.MAT 18:28: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’
verses.MAT 18:29: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’
verses.MAT 18:30: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.
verses.MAT 18:31: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.
verses.MAT 18:32: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.
verses.MAT 18:33: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’
verses.MAT 18:34: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.
verses.MAT 18:35: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”
verses.MAT 19:1: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.
verses.MAT 19:13: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.
verses.MAT 19:14: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”
verses.MAT 19:15: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.
verses.MAT 19:16: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”
verses.MAT 19:17: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”
verses.MAT 19:18: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’
verses.MAT 19:19: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”
verses.MAT 19:20: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”
verses.MAT 19:21: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”
verses.MAT 19:22: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.
verses.MAT 19:23: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.
verses.MAT 19:24: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
verses.MAT 19:25: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”
verses.MAT 19:26: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
verses.MAT 19:27: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything and followed you. What then will we have?”
verses.MAT 19:28: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.MAT 19:29: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.
verses.MAT 19:30: But many will be last who are first, and first who are last.
verses.MAT 19:3: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
verses.MAT 19:4: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,
verses.MAT 19:5: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?
verses.MAT 19:6: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”
verses.MAT 19:7: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”
verses.MAT 19:8: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.
verses.MAT 19:9: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”
verses.MAT 19:10: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”
verses.MAT 19:11: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.
verses.MAT 19:12: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”
verses.MAT 1:1: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
verses.MAT 1:2: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.
verses.MAT 1:3: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.
verses.MAT 1:4: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.
verses.MAT 1:5: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.
verses.MAT 1:6: Jesse became the father of King David. David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.
verses.MAT 1:7: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.
verses.MAT 1:8: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.
verses.MAT 1:9: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.
verses.MAT 1:10: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.
verses.MAT 1:11: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.
verses.MAT 1:12: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.
verses.MAT 1:13: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.
verses.MAT 1:14: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.
verses.MAT 1:15: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.
verses.MAT 1:16: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
verses.MAT 1:18: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
verses.MAT 1:19: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.
verses.MAT 1:20: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.
verses.MAT 1:21: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”
verses.MAT 1:22: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,
verses.MAT 1:23: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel,” which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”
verses.MAT 1:17: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.
verses.MAT 1:24: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;
verses.MAT 1:25: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.
verses.MAT 20:1: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.
verses.MAT 20:2: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
verses.MAT 20:3: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.
verses.MAT 20:4: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.
verses.MAT 20:5: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.
verses.MAT 20:6: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’
verses.MAT 20:7: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’
verses.MAT 20:8: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’
verses.MAT 20:9: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.
verses.MAT 20:10: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.
verses.MAT 20:11: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,
verses.MAT 20:12: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’
verses.MAT 20:13: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?
verses.MAT 20:14: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.
verses.MAT 20:15: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’
verses.MAT 20:16: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”
verses.MAT 20:17: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,
verses.MAT 20:18: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,
verses.MAT 20:19: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”
verses.MAT 20:20: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.
verses.MAT 20:21: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”
verses.MAT 20:22: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”
verses.MAT 20:23: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”
verses.MAT 20:24: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.
verses.MAT 20:25: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
verses.MAT 20:26: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.
verses.MAT 20:27: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,
verses.MAT 20:28: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
verses.MAT 21:1: When they came near to Jerusalem and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,
verses.MAT 21:2: saying to them, “Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.
verses.MAT 21:3: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”
verses.MAT 21:4: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,
verses.MAT 21:5: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”
verses.MAT 21:6: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,
verses.MAT 21:7: and brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.
verses.MAT 21:8: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
verses.MAT 21:9: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
verses.MAT 21:10: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”
verses.MAT 21:11: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”
verses.MAT 21:23: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
verses.MAT 21:24: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.MAT 21:25: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
verses.MAT 21:26: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”
verses.MAT 21:27: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.MAT 21:28: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’
verses.MAT 21:29: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.
verses.MAT 21:30: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.
verses.MAT 21:31: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.
verses.MAT 21:32: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.
verses.MAT 21:33: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.
verses.MAT 21:34: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.
verses.MAT 21:35: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
verses.MAT 21:36: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.
verses.MAT 21:37: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
verses.MAT 21:38: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’
verses.MAT 21:39: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.
verses.MAT 21:40: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”
verses.MAT 21:41: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”
verses.MAT 21:42: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?
verses.MAT 21:43: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.
verses.MAT 21:45: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.
verses.MAT 21:46: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.
verses.MAT 22:1: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,
verses.MAT 22:2: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,
verses.MAT 22:3: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.
verses.MAT 22:4: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’
verses.MAT 22:5: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;
verses.MAT 22:6: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.
verses.MAT 22:7: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
verses.MAT 22:8: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.
verses.MAT 22:9: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’
verses.MAT 22:10: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.
verses.MAT 22:11: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,
verses.MAT 22:12: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.
verses.MAT 22:13: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’
verses.MAT 22:14: For many are called, but few chosen.”
verses.MAT 22:15: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.
verses.MAT 22:16: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.
verses.MAT 22:17: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”
verses.MAT 22:18: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?
verses.MAT 22:19: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.
verses.MAT 22:20: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”
verses.MAT 22:21: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
verses.MAT 22:34: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.
verses.MAT 22:35: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.
verses.MAT 22:36: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”
verses.MAT 22:37: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
verses.MAT 22:38: This is the first and great commandment.
verses.MAT 22:39: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
verses.MAT 22:40: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”
verses.MAT 23:1: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,
verses.MAT 23:2: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.
verses.MAT 23:3: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.
verses.MAT 23:4: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.
verses.MAT 23:5: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,
verses.MAT 23:6: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,
verses.MAT 23:7: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.
verses.MAT 23:8: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.
verses.MAT 23:9: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.
verses.MAT 23:10: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.
verses.MAT 23:11: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.
verses.MAT 23:12: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
verses.MAT 23:13: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.
verses.MAT 23:14: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.
verses.MAT 23:15: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.
verses.MAT 23:16: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’
verses.MAT 23:17: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
verses.MAT 23:18: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’
verses.MAT 23:19: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
verses.MAT 23:20: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.
verses.MAT 23:21: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.
verses.MAT 23:22: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.
verses.MAT 23:23: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
verses.MAT 23:24: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!
verses.MAT 23:25: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.
verses.MAT 23:26: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.
verses.MAT 23:27: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.
verses.MAT 23:28: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
verses.MAT 23:29: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,
verses.MAT 23:30: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’
verses.MAT 23:31: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.
verses.MAT 23:32: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.
verses.MAT 24:37: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
verses.MAT 24:38: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,
verses.MAT 24:39: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
verses.MAT 24:40: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.
verses.MAT 24:41: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.
verses.MAT 24:42: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.
verses.MAT 24:43: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.
verses.MAT 24:44: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.
verses.MAT 24:4: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
verses.MAT 24:5: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.
verses.MAT 24:6: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.
verses.MAT 24:7: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.
verses.MAT 24:8: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.
verses.MAT 24:9: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.
verses.MAT 24:10: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.
verses.MAT 24:11: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.
verses.MAT 24:12: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.
verses.MAT 24:13: But he who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.MAT 24:45: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?
verses.MAT 24:46: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.
verses.MAT 24:47: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.
verses.MAT 24:48: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’
verses.MAT 24:49: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,
verses.MAT 24:50: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,
verses.MAT 24:51: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.
verses.MAT 25:1: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
verses.MAT 25:2: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
verses.MAT 25:3: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,
verses.MAT 25:4: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
verses.MAT 25:5: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.
verses.MAT 25:6: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’
verses.MAT 25:7: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
verses.MAT 25:8: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’
verses.MAT 25:9: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’
verses.MAT 25:10: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.
verses.MAT 25:11: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’
verses.MAT 25:12: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’
verses.MAT 25:13: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.
verses.MAT 25:14: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.
verses.MAT 25:15: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.
verses.MAT 25:19: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.
verses.MAT 25:20: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’
verses.MAT 25:16: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.
verses.MAT 25:17: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.
verses.MAT 25:18: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.
verses.MAT 25:21: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
verses.MAT 25:22: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’
verses.MAT 25:23: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
verses.MAT 25:24: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.
verses.MAT 25:25: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’
verses.MAT 25:26: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.
verses.MAT 25:27: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.
verses.MAT 25:28: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.
verses.MAT 25:29: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.
verses.MAT 25:30: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
verses.MAT 25:31: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.
verses.MAT 25:32: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
verses.MAT 25:33: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
verses.MAT 25:34: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;
verses.MAT 25:35: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in.
verses.MAT 25:36: I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.’
verses.MAT 25:37: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?
verses.MAT 25:38: When did we see you as a stranger and take you in, or naked and clothe you?
verses.MAT 25:39: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’
verses.MAT 25:40: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’
verses.MAT 25:41: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;
verses.MAT 25:42: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;
verses.MAT 25:43: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’
verses.MAT 25:44: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’
verses.MAT 25:45: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’
verses.MAT 25:46: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
verses.MAT 26:14: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests
verses.MAT 26:15: and said, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him to you?” So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.
verses.MAT 26:16: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
verses.MAT 26:17: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”
verses.MAT 26:18: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”
verses.MAT 26:19: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.
verses.MAT 26:20: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.
verses.MAT 26:21: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
verses.MAT 26:22: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”
verses.MAT 26:23: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.
verses.MAT 26:24: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”
verses.MAT 26:25: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”
verses.MAT 26:26: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”
verses.MAT 26:27: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,
verses.MAT 26:28: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.
verses.MAT 26:29: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”
verses.MAT 26:30: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
verses.MAT 26:31: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
verses.MAT 26:32: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
verses.MAT 26:33: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”
verses.MAT 26:34: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”
verses.MAT 26:35: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.
verses.MAT 26:36: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”
verses.MAT 26:37: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.
verses.MAT 26:38: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”
verses.MAT 26:39: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
verses.MAT 26:40: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?
verses.MAT 26:41: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
verses.MAT 26:42: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”
verses.MAT 26:43: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
verses.MAT 26:44: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.
verses.MAT 26:45: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.MAT 26:46: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
verses.MAT 26:47: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
verses.MAT 26:48: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”
verses.MAT 26:49: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.
verses.MAT 26:50: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
