verses.MAT 26:51: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
verses.MAT 26:52: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.
verses.MAT 26:53: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.MAT 26:54: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”
verses.MAT 26:55: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.
verses.MAT 26:56: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.
verses.MAT 26:57: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.
verses.MAT 26:58: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.
verses.MAT 26:59: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,
verses.MAT 26:60: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward
verses.MAT 26:61: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”
verses.MAT 26:62: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”
verses.MAT 26:63: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”
verses.MAT 26:64: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”
verses.MAT 26:65: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.
verses.MAT 26:66: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”
verses.MAT 26:67: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,
verses.MAT 26:68: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”
verses.MAT 26:69: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”
verses.MAT 26:70: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”
verses.MAT 26:71: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
verses.MAT 26:72: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”
verses.MAT 26:73: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”
verses.MAT 26:74: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.
verses.MAT 26:75: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.
verses.MAT 27:1: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.
verses.MAT 27:2: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.
verses.MAT 27:3: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
verses.MAT 27:4: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”
verses.MAT 27:5: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.
verses.MAT 27:6: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”
verses.MAT 27:7: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.
verses.MAT 27:8: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.
verses.MAT 27:9: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,
verses.MAT 27:10: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”
verses.MAT 27:11: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”
verses.MAT 27:12: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
verses.MAT 27:13: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”
verses.MAT 27:14: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.
verses.MAT 27:15: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.
verses.MAT 27:16: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.
verses.MAT 27:17: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”
verses.MAT 27:18: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.
verses.MAT 27:19: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”
verses.MAT 27:20: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.
verses.MAT 27:21: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”
verses.MAT 27:22: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”
verses.MAT 27:23: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”
verses.MAT 27:24: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”
verses.MAT 27:25: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”
verses.MAT 27:26: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.
verses.MAT 27:27: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.
verses.MAT 27:28: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.
verses.MAT 27:29: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
verses.MAT 27:30: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
verses.MAT 27:31: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.
verses.MAT 27:32: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.
verses.MAT 27:33: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”
verses.MAT 27:34: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.
verses.MAT 27:35: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,
verses.MAT 27:36: and they sat and watched him there.
verses.MAT 27:37: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
verses.MAT 27:38: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.
verses.MAT 27:39: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads
verses.MAT 27:40: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”
verses.MAT 27:41: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,
verses.MAT 27:42: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.
verses.MAT 27:43: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”
verses.MAT 27:44: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.
verses.MAT 27:45: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
verses.MAT 27:46: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
verses.MAT 27:47: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”
verses.MAT 27:48: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.
verses.MAT 27:49: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”
verses.MAT 27:50: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.
verses.MAT 27:51: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
verses.MAT 27:52: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;
verses.MAT 27:53: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.
verses.MAT 27:54: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”
verses.MAT 27:55: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.
verses.MAT 27:56: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
verses.MAT 27:57: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.
verses.MAT 27:58: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.
verses.MAT 27:59: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth
verses.MAT 27:60: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.
verses.MAT 27:61: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.
verses.MAT 27:62: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,
verses.MAT 27:63: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’
verses.MAT 27:64: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”
verses.MAT 27:65: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”
verses.MAT 27:66: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.
verses.MAT 28:1: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.
verses.MAT 28:2: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.
verses.MAT 28:3: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.
verses.MAT 28:4: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.
verses.MAT 28:5: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.
verses.MAT 28:6: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.
verses.MAT 28:7: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”
verses.MAT 28:8: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.
verses.MAT 28:9: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.
verses.MAT 28:10: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”
verses.MAT 28:16: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.
verses.MAT 28:17: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.
verses.MAT 28:18: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
verses.MAT 28:19: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
verses.MAT 28:20: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
verses.MAT 28:11: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.
verses.MAT 28:12: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,
verses.MAT 28:13: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.
verses.MAT 28:14: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”
verses.MAT 28:15: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.
verses.MAT 2:1: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,
verses.MAT 2:2: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”
verses.MAT 2:3: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
verses.MAT 2:4: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.
verses.MAT 2:5: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,
verses.MAT 2:6: ‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah; for out of you shall come a governor who shall shepherd my people, Israel.’”
verses.MAT 2:7: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.
verses.MAT 2:8: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”
verses.MAT 2:9: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.
verses.MAT 2:10: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.
verses.MAT 2:11: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
verses.MAT 2:12: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.
verses.MAT 2:13: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”
verses.MAT 2:14: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt,
verses.MAT 2:15: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”
verses.MAT 2:19: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,
verses.MAT 2:20: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”
verses.MAT 2:21: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
verses.MAT 2:22: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,
verses.MAT 2:23: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.
verses.MAT 2:16: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.
verses.MAT 2:17: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,
verses.MAT 2:18: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”
verses.MAT 3:1: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,
verses.MAT 3:2: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”
verses.MAT 3:3: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”
verses.MAT 3:4: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
verses.MAT 3:5: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.
verses.MAT 3:6: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.MAT 3:7: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.MAT 3:8: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!
verses.MAT 3:9: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.
verses.MAT 3:10: Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.
verses.MAT 3:11: “I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.
verses.MAT 3:12: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”
verses.MAT 3:13: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.
verses.MAT 3:14: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”
verses.MAT 3:15: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.
verses.MAT 3:16: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.
verses.MAT 3:17: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
verses.MAT 4:1: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
verses.MAT 4:2: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.
verses.MAT 4:3: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”
verses.MAT 4:4: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”
verses.MAT 4:5: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,
verses.MAT 4:6: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”
verses.MAT 4:7: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”
verses.MAT 4:8: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
verses.MAT 4:9: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”
verses.MAT 4:10: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”
verses.MAT 4:11: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.
verses.MAT 4:12: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.
verses.MAT 4:13: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
verses.MAT 4:14: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
verses.MAT 4:15: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,
verses.MAT 4:16: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”
verses.MAT 4:17: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”
verses.MAT 4:23: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
verses.MAT 4:24: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.
verses.MAT 4:25: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
verses.MAT 4:18: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
verses.MAT 4:19: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”
verses.MAT 4:20: They immediately left their nets and followed him.
verses.MAT 4:21: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.
verses.MAT 4:22: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.
verses.MAT 5:1: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.
verses.MAT 5:2: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
verses.MAT 5:3: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.MAT 5:4: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
verses.MAT 5:5: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.MAT 5:6: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.
verses.MAT 5:7: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.MAT 5:8: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
verses.MAT 5:9: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
verses.MAT 5:10: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.MAT 5:11: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
verses.MAT 5:12: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
verses.MAT 5:13: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.
verses.MAT 5:14: “You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.
verses.MAT 5:15: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.
verses.MAT 5:16: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
verses.MAT 5:17: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
verses.MAT 5:18: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.
verses.MAT 5:19: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.MAT 5:20: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
verses.MAT 5:21: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’
verses.MAT 5:22: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.
verses.MAT 5:23: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,
verses.MAT 5:24: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
verses.MAT 5:25: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.
verses.MAT 5:26: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny.
verses.MAT 5:27: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’
verses.MAT 5:28: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
verses.MAT 5:29: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
verses.MAT 5:30: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
verses.MAT 5:31: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’
verses.MAT 5:32: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.
verses.MAT 5:33: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’
verses.MAT 5:34: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;
verses.MAT 5:35: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
verses.MAT 5:36: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.
verses.MAT 5:37: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.
verses.MAT 5:38: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’
verses.MAT 5:39: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
verses.MAT 5:40: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.
verses.MAT 5:41: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.
verses.MAT 5:42: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
verses.MAT 5:43: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
verses.MAT 5:44: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
verses.MAT 5:45: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.
verses.MAT 5:46: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
verses.MAT 5:47: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
verses.MAT 5:48: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
verses.MAT 6:1: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
verses.MAT 6:2: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
verses.MAT 6:3: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,
verses.MAT 6:4: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
verses.MAT 6:5: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.
verses.MAT 6:6: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
verses.MAT 6:16: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
verses.MAT 6:17: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
verses.MAT 6:18: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.
verses.MAT 6:19: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;
verses.MAT 6:20: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;
verses.MAT 6:21: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
verses.MAT 6:22: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
verses.MAT 6:23: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
verses.MAT 6:24: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.
verses.MAT 6:25: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
verses.MAT 6:26: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?
verses.MAT 6:27: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
verses.MAT 6:28: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,
verses.MAT 6:29: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.
verses.MAT 6:30: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?
verses.MAT 6:31: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’
verses.MAT 6:32: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
verses.MAT 6:33: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
verses.MAT 6:34: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
verses.MAT 6:7: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.
verses.MAT 6:8: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.
verses.MAT 6:9: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
verses.MAT 6:10: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
verses.MAT 6:11: Give us today our daily bread.
verses.MAT 6:12: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.
verses.MAT 6:13: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’
verses.MAT 6:14: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
verses.MAT 6:15: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
verses.MAT 7:1: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.
verses.MAT 7:2: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
verses.MAT 7:3: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
verses.MAT 7:4: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?
verses.MAT 7:5: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.
verses.MAT 7:15: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
verses.MAT 7:16: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?
verses.MAT 7:17: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.
verses.MAT 7:18: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.
verses.MAT 7:19: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
verses.MAT 7:20: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.
verses.MAT 7:21: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.
verses.MAT 7:24: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.
verses.MAT 7:25: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.
verses.MAT 7:26: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.
verses.MAT 7:27: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”
verses.MAT 7:22: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’
verses.MAT 7:23: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
verses.MAT 7:28: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,
verses.MAT 7:29: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.
verses.MAT 7:6: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.
verses.MAT 7:12: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.MAT 7:13: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.
verses.MAT 7:14: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.
verses.MAT 7:7: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
verses.MAT 7:8: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
verses.MAT 7:9: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?
verses.MAT 7:10: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?
verses.MAT 7:11: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
verses.MAT 8:1: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
verses.MAT 8:2: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
verses.MAT 8:3: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
verses.MAT 8:4: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”
verses.MAT 8:17: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”
verses.MAT 8:18: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.
verses.MAT 8:19: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”
verses.MAT 8:20: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”
verses.MAT 8:21: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
verses.MAT 8:22: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”
verses.MAT 8:23: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.
verses.MAT 8:24: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.
verses.MAT 8:25: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”
verses.MAT 8:26: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.
verses.MAT 8:27: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
verses.MAT 8:28: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.
verses.MAT 8:29: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”
verses.MAT 8:30: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.
verses.MAT 8:31: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”
verses.MAT 8:32: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.
verses.MAT 8:33: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.
verses.MAT 8:34: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.
verses.MAT 8:5: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,
verses.MAT 8:6: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”
verses.MAT 8:7: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”
verses.MAT 8:8: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
verses.MAT 8:9: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
verses.MAT 8:10: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.
verses.MAT 8:11: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,
verses.MAT 8:12: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
verses.MAT 8:13: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.
verses.MAT 8:14: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.
verses.MAT 8:15: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.
verses.MAT 8:16: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,
verses.MAT 9:1: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.
verses.MAT 9:2: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”
verses.MAT 9:3: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”
verses.MAT 9:4: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?
verses.MAT 9:5: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?
verses.MAT 9:6: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”
verses.MAT 9:7: He arose and departed to his house.
verses.MAT 9:8: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
verses.MAT 9:14: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”
verses.MAT 9:15: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.
verses.MAT 9:16: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.
verses.MAT 9:17: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”
verses.MAT 9:18: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”
verses.MAT 9:19: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.
verses.MAT 9:20: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;
verses.MAT 9:21: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”
verses.MAT 9:22: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.
verses.MAT 9:23: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,
verses.MAT 9:24: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.
verses.MAT 9:25: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.
verses.MAT 9:26: The report of this went out into all that land.
verses.MAT 9:27: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”
verses.MAT 9:28: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”
verses.MAT 9:29: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”
verses.MAT 9:30: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”
verses.MAT 9:31: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.
verses.MAT 9:32: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.
verses.MAT 9:33: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
verses.MAT 9:34: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”
verses.MAT 9:35: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
verses.MAT 9:36: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.
verses.MAT 9:37: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.
verses.MAT 9:38: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
verses.MAT 9:9: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.
verses.MAT 9:10: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
verses.MAT 9:11: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
verses.MAT 9:12: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
verses.MAT 9:13: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
verses.NAH 1:15: Behold, on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, Judah! Perform your vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.
verses.NAH 2:2: For the LORD restores the excellency of Jacob as the excellency of Israel, for the destroyers have destroyed them and ruined their vine branches.
verses.NAH 3:1: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery—no end to the prey.
verses.NAH 3:2: The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots,
verses.NAH 3:3: the horseman charging, and the flashing sword, the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies. They stumble on their bodies
verses.NAH 3:6: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile, and will make you a spectacle.
verses.NAH 3:7: It will happen that all those who look at you will flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will mourn for her?’ Where will I seek comforters for you?”
verses.NEH 2:1: In the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, when wine was before him, I picked up the wine, and gave it to the king. Now I had not been sad before in his presence.
verses.NEH 2:2: The king said to me, “Why is your face sad, since you are not sick? This is nothing else but sorrow of heart.” Then I was very much afraid.
verses.NEH 2:3: I said to the king, “Let the king live forever! Why shouldn’t my face be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ tombs, lies waste, and its gates have been consumed with fire?”
verses.NEH 2:4: Then the king said to me, “What is your request?” So I prayed to the God of heaven.
verses.NEH 2:5: I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor in your sight, I ask that you would send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers’ tombs, that I may build it.”
verses.NEH 2:6: The king said to me (the queen was also sitting by him), “How long will your journey be? When will you return?” So it pleased the king to send me, and I set a time for him.
verses.NEH 2:7: Moreover I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the River, that they may let me pass through until I come to Judah;
verses.NEH 2:8: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple, for the wall of the city, and for the house that I will occupy.” The king granted my requests, because of the good hand of my God on me.
verses.NEH 8:1: All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the wide place that was in front of the water gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.
verses.NEH 8:2: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.
verses.NEH 8:3: He read from it before the wide place that was in front of the water gate from early morning until midday, in the presence of the men and the women, and of those who could understand. The ears of all the people were attentive to the book of the law.
verses.NEH 8:4: Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
verses.NEH 8:5: Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people (for he was above all the people), and when he opened it, all the people stood up.
verses.NEH 8:6: Then Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. All the people answered, “Amen, Amen,” with the lifting up of their hands. They bowed their heads, and worshiped the LORD with their faces to the ground.
verses.NEH 8:7: Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law; and the people stayed in their place.
verses.NEH 8:8: They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.
verses.NEH 8:9: Nehemiah, who was the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people said to all the people, “Today is holy to the LORD your God. Don’t mourn, nor weep.” For all the people wept when they heard the words of the law.
verses.NEH 8:10: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”
verses.NEH 8:11: So the Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Hold your peace, for the day is holy. Don’t be grieved.”
verses.NEH 8:12: All the people went their way to eat, to drink, to send portions, and to celebrate, because they had understood the words that were declared to them.
verses.NUM 11:25: The LORD came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.
verses.NUM 11:26: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on them. They were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.NUM 11:27: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”
verses.NUM 11:28: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”
verses.NUM 11:29: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets, that the LORD would put his Spirit on them!”
verses.NUM 11:4: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?
verses.NUM 11:5: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;
verses.NUM 11:6: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”
verses.NUM 11:7: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.
verses.NUM 11:8: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.
verses.NUM 11:9: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.
verses.NUM 11:10: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and the LORD’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.
verses.NUM 11:11: Moses said to the LORD, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?
verses.NUM 11:12: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers’?
verses.NUM 11:13: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’
verses.NUM 11:14: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
verses.NUM 11:15: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”
verses.NUM 12:1: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.
verses.NUM 12:2: They said, “Has the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And the LORD heard it.
verses.NUM 12:3: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.
verses.NUM 12:4: The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.
verses.NUM 12:5: The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.
verses.NUM 12:6: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.
verses.NUM 12:7: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.
verses.NUM 12:8: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see the LORD’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”
verses.NUM 12:9: The LORD’s anger burned against them; and he departed.
verses.NUM 12:10: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
verses.NUM 12:11: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.
verses.NUM 12:12: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
verses.NUM 12:13: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”
verses.NUM 13:1: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.NUM 13:2: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”
verses.NUM 13:25: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.
verses.NUM 13:26: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.
verses.NUM 13:27: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
verses.NUM 13:28: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.
verses.NUM 13:29: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”
verses.NUM 13:30: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”
verses.NUM 13:31: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”
verses.NUM 13:32: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.
verses.NUM 13:33: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”
verses.NUM 14:1: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.NUM 14:26: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.NUM 14:27: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.
verses.NUM 14:28: Tell them, ‘As I live, says the LORD, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.
verses.NUM 14:29: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me,
verses.NUM 14:30: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.NUM 14:34: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’
verses.NUM 14:35: I, the LORD, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”
verses.NUM 20:1: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.
verses.NUM 20:2: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
verses.NUM 20:3: The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before the LORD!
verses.NUM 20:4: Why have you brought the LORD’s assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?
verses.NUM 20:5: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”
verses.NUM 20:6: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces. The LORD’s glory appeared to them.
verses.NUM 20:7: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.NUM 20:8: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it pour out its water. You shall bring water to them out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”
verses.NUM 20:9: Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.
verses.NUM 20:10: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?”
verses.NUM 20:11: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly. The congregation and their livestock drank.
verses.NUM 20:12: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”
verses.NUM 20:13: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.
verses.NUM 21:4: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.
verses.NUM 21:5: The people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, there is no water, and our soul loathes this disgusting food!”
verses.NUM 21:6: The LORD sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.
verses.NUM 21:7: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against the LORD and against you. Pray to the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us.” Moses prayed for the people.
verses.NUM 21:8: The LORD said to Moses, “Make a venomous snake, and set it on a pole. It shall happen that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.”
verses.NUM 21:9: Moses made a serpent of bronze, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of bronze, he lived.
verses.NUM 24:2: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.
verses.NUM 24:3: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
verses.NUM 24:4: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
verses.NUM 24:5: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!
verses.NUM 24:6: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which the LORD has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.
verses.NUM 24:7: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.NUM 24:15: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
verses.NUM 24:16: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
verses.NUM 24:17: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.
verses.NUM 6:22: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.NUM 6:23: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,
verses.NUM 6:24: ‘The LORD bless you, and keep you.
verses.NUM 6:25: The LORD make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.
verses.NUM 6:26: The LORD lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’
verses.NUM 6:27: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”
verses.PHI 1:1: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
verses.PHI 1:2: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.PHI 1:3: I thank my God whenever I remember you,
verses.PHI 1:4: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,
verses.PHI 1:5: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;
verses.PHI 1:6: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
verses.PHI 1:7: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.
verses.PHI 1:8: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
verses.PHI 1:9: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
verses.PHI 1:10: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,
verses.PHI 1:11: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
verses.PHI 1:18: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.
verses.PHI 1:19: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
verses.PHI 1:20: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.
verses.PHI 1:21: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
verses.PHI 1:22: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.
verses.PHI 1:23: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
verses.PHI 1:24: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
verses.PHI 1:25: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
verses.PHI 1:26: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
verses.PHI 1:27: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;
verses.PHI 2:1: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,
verses.PHI 2:2: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
verses.PHI 2:3: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
verses.PHI 2:4: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
verses.PHI 2:5: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
verses.PHI 2:6: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
verses.PHI 2:7: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
verses.PHI 2:8: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.
verses.PHI 2:9: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,
verses.PHI 2:10: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
verses.PHI 2:11: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

verses.PSA 100:1: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!
verses.PSA 100:2: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
verses.PSA 100:3: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

verses.PSA 100:5: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

verses.PSA 101:5: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
verses.PSA 101:6: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

verses.PSA 111:4: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.
verses.PSA 111:5: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
verses.PSA 111:6: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
verses.PSA 111:7: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
verses.PSA 111:8: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.PSA 111:9: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
verses.PSA 111:10: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
verses.PSA 112:1: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.
verses.PSA 112:2: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
verses.PSA 112:3: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
verses.PSA 112:4: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
verses.PSA 112:5: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
verses.PSA 112:6: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
verses.PSA 112:7: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
verses.PSA 112:8: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
verses.PSA 112:9: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
verses.PSA 113:1: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.
verses.PSA 113:2: Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
verses.PSA 113:3: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.
verses.PSA 113:4: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
verses.PSA 113:5: Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,
verses.PSA 113:6: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?
verses.PSA 113:7: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,
verses.PSA 113:8: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
verses.PSA 114:1: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,
verses.PSA 114:2: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
verses.PSA 114:3: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
verses.PSA 114:4: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
verses.PSA 114:5: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?
verses.PSA 114:6: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?
verses.PSA 115:1: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
verses.PSA 115:2: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
verses.PSA 115:3: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
verses.PSA 115:4: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
verses.PSA 115:15: Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
verses.PSA 115:16: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
verses.PSA 115:5: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.
verses.PSA 115:6: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.
verses.PSA 115:7: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
verses.PSA 115:8: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
verses.PSA 115:9: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
verses.PSA 115:10: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
verses.PSA 116:1: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
verses.PSA 116:2: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
verses.PSA 116:3: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.PSA 116:4: Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
verses.PSA 116:5: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
verses.PSA 116:6: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
verses.PSA 116:8: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
verses.PSA 116:9: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.PSA 116:10: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
verses.PSA 116:15: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.
verses.PSA 116:16: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
verses.PSA 116:17: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.
verses.PSA 116:18: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people,
verses.PSA 116:19: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
verses.PSA 116:11: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”
verses.PSA 116:12: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
verses.PSA 116:13: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.
verses.PSA 116:14: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.
verses.PSA 117:1: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
verses.PSA 117:2: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!
verses.PSA 118:1: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.PSA 118:14: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
verses.PSA 118:15: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.
verses.PSA 118:16: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”
verses.PSA 118:18: The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
verses.PSA 118:19: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.
verses.PSA 118:20: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.
verses.PSA 118:21: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
verses.PSA 118:8: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.
verses.PSA 118:9: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.
verses.PSA 118:25: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.
verses.PSA 118:26: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.
verses.PSA 118:27: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
verses.PSA 118:22: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
verses.PSA 118:23: This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.PSA 118:28: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
verses.PSA 118:29: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.PSA 118:2: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.PSA 118:17: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.
verses.PSA 118:4: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.PSA 118:24: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
verses.PSA 118:3: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.PSA 118:13: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.
verses.PSA 119:1: ALEPH Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD’s law.
verses.PSA 119:2: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
verses.PSA 119:10: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
verses.PSA 119:11: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
verses.PSA 119:17: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.
verses.PSA 119:18: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
verses.PSA 119:27: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
verses.PSA 119:30: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
verses.PSA 119:34: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
verses.PSA 119:35: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
verses.PSA 119:44: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
verses.PSA 119:4: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
verses.PSA 119:5: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
verses.PSA 119:33: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
verses.PSA 119:7: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
verses.PSA 119:8: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH
verses.PSA 119:105: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
verses.PSA 119:12: Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.
verses.PSA 119:16: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL
verses.PSA 119:129: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
verses.PSA 119:130: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
verses.PSA 119:131: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
verses.PSA 119:132: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
verses.PSA 119:133: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.PSA 119:135: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
verses.PSA 119:14: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
verses.PSA 119:24: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH
verses.PSA 119:72: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH
verses.PSA 119:103: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
verses.PSA 119:111: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
verses.PSA 119:157: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.
verses.PSA 119:160: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN
verses.PSA 119:161: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
verses.PSA 119:165: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
