verses.PSA 119:166: I have hoped for your salvation, LORD. I have done your commandments.
verses.PSA 119:168: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV
verses.PSA 119:171: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
verses.PSA 119:172: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
verses.PSA 119:174: I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight.
verses.PSA 119:175: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.
verses.PSA 119:20: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
verses.PSA 119:40: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV
verses.PSA 119:23: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
verses.PSA 119:26: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
verses.PSA 119:29: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
verses.PSA 119:43: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.
verses.PSA 119:79: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.
verses.PSA 119:80: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF
verses.PSA 119:95: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.
verses.PSA 119:102: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
verses.PSA 119:89: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever.
verses.PSA 119:101: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
verses.PSA 119:104: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN
verses.PSA 119:163: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
verses.PSA 119:36: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
verses.PSA 119:37: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
verses.PSA 119:41: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your word.
verses.PSA 119:45: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.PSA 119:47: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
verses.PSA 119:48: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN
verses.PSA 119:53: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.
verses.PSA 119:61: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
verses.PSA 119:134: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
verses.PSA 119:150: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
verses.PSA 119:155: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.
verses.PSA 119:158: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.
verses.PSA 119:57: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
verses.PSA 119:76: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
verses.PSA 119:77: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
verses.PSA 119:127: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
verses.PSA 119:128: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE
verses.PSA 119:66: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
verses.PSA 119:68: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.
verses.PSA 119:93: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.
verses.PSA 119:94: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.PSA 119:71: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
verses.PSA 119:75: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
verses.PSA 119:91: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.
verses.PSA 119:125: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
verses.PSA 119:67: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.
verses.PSA 119:90: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
verses.PSA 119:9: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
verses.PSA 119:13: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
verses.PSA 119:97: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
verses.PSA 119:98: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
verses.PSA 119:99: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.PSA 119:100: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
verses.PSA 11:4: The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
verses.PSA 11:5: The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.
verses.PSA 11:7: For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
verses.PSA 121:1: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
verses.PSA 121:2: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
verses.PSA 121:3: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
verses.PSA 121:4: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.PSA 121:5: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.
verses.PSA 121:6: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.PSA 121:7: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
verses.PSA 121:8: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
verses.PSA 122:1: A Song of Ascents. By David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”
verses.PSA 122:2: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!
verses.PSA 122:3: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,
verses.PSA 122:4: where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.
verses.PSA 122:8: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
verses.PSA 122:9: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.
verses.PSA 122:5: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.
verses.PSA 122:6: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
verses.PSA 122:7: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
verses.PSA 123:1: A Song of Ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
verses.PSA 123:2: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.
verses.PSA 123:3: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
verses.PSA 123:4: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
verses.PSA 124:1: A Song of Ascents. By David. If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,
verses.PSA 124:2: if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,
verses.PSA 124:3: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,
verses.PSA 124:4: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.
verses.PSA 124:5: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
verses.PSA 124:6: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.PSA 124:7: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
verses.PSA 124:8: Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.
verses.PSA 126:1: A Song of Ascents. When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
verses.PSA 126:2: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
verses.PSA 126:3: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.
verses.PSA 126:4: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.
verses.PSA 126:5: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
verses.PSA 126:6: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
verses.PSA 128:1: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.
verses.PSA 128:2: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
verses.PSA 128:3: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.
verses.PSA 128:4: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.
verses.PSA 128:5: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
verses.PSA 128:6: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
verses.PSA 12:1: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David. Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.PSA 12:2: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
verses.PSA 12:3: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
verses.PSA 12:4: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”
verses.PSA 12:6: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
verses.PSA 12:7: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
verses.PSA 130:1: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.
verses.PSA 130:2: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
verses.PSA 130:3: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
verses.PSA 130:4: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
verses.PSA 130:5: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
verses.PSA 130:6: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
verses.PSA 130:7: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.
verses.PSA 130:8: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
verses.PSA 131:1: A Song of Ascents. By David. LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.
verses.PSA 131:2: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
verses.PSA 131:3: Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.
verses.PSA 132:1: A Song of Ascents. LORD, remember David and all his affliction,
verses.PSA 132:2: how he swore to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
verses.PSA 132:3: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.PSA 132:4: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,
verses.PSA 132:5: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
verses.PSA 132:11: The LORD has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
verses.PSA 132:12: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”
verses.PSA 132:13: For the LORD has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
verses.PSA 132:14: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.
verses.PSA 132:17: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
verses.PSA 132:18: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
verses.PSA 132:6: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.
verses.PSA 132:7: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”
verses.PSA 132:8: Arise, LORD, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.
verses.PSA 132:9: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!
verses.PSA 132:10: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.
verses.PSA 135:1: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,
verses.PSA 135:2: you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
verses.PSA 135:3: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
verses.PSA 135:4: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
verses.PSA 135:5: For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.PSA 135:6: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.
verses.PSA 136:1: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.PSA 136:23: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.PSA 136:24: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.PSA 136:10: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.PSA 136:11: and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.PSA 136:12: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.PSA 136:13: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.PSA 136:14: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.PSA 136:15: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.PSA 136:2: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.PSA 136:3: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.PSA 136:16: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.PSA 136:17: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.PSA 136:18: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.PSA 136:21: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.PSA 136:22: even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.PSA 137:1: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.PSA 137:2: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.
verses.PSA 137:3: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”
verses.PSA 137:4: How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?
verses.PSA 137:5: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.
verses.PSA 137:6: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.
verses.PSA 138:1: By David. I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
verses.PSA 138:2: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.
verses.PSA 138:3: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
verses.PSA 138:4: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
verses.PSA 138:5: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!
verses.PSA 138:7: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
verses.PSA 138:8: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
verses.PSA 138:6: For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
verses.PSA 139:1: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.
verses.PSA 139:2: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
verses.PSA 139:3: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
verses.PSA 139:13: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
verses.PSA 139:14: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
verses.PSA 139:15: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
verses.PSA 139:23: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
verses.PSA 139:24: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
verses.PSA 139:4: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether.
verses.PSA 139:5: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
verses.PSA 139:6: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
verses.PSA 139:7: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?
verses.PSA 139:8: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!
verses.PSA 139:9: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
verses.PSA 139:10: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
verses.PSA 139:11: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”
verses.PSA 139:12: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
verses.PSA 13:3: Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
verses.PSA 13:4: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
verses.PSA 13:5: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
verses.PSA 13:6: I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.
verses.PSA 141:1: A Psalm by David. LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
verses.PSA 141:2: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
verses.PSA 141:3: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
verses.PSA 141:8: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
verses.PSA 144:1: By David. Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—
verses.PSA 144:2: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.
verses.PSA 144:9: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.
verses.PSA 144:10: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
verses.PSA 144:3: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?
verses.PSA 144:4: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
verses.PSA 145:1: A praise psalm by David. I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
verses.PSA 145:9: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
verses.PSA 145:10: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.
verses.PSA 145:11: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,
verses.PSA 145:12: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
verses.PSA 145:13: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
verses.PSA 145:2: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
verses.PSA 145:8: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
verses.PSA 145:14: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
verses.PSA 145:21: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
verses.PSA 145:17: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
verses.PSA 145:18: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
verses.PSA 145:15: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
verses.PSA 145:16: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
verses.PSA 145:19: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.PSA 145:20: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.
verses.PSA 145:3: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
verses.PSA 145:4: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
verses.PSA 145:5: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
verses.PSA 145:6: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.
verses.PSA 145:7: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
verses.PSA 146:1: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.
verses.PSA 146:2: While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
verses.PSA 146:3: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
verses.PSA 146:4: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
verses.PSA 146:5: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,
verses.PSA 146:6: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
verses.PSA 146:7: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.
verses.PSA 146:8: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.
verses.PSA 146:9: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.
verses.PSA 146:10: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!
verses.PSA 147:1: Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
verses.PSA 147:2: The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.PSA 147:3: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
verses.PSA 147:4: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
verses.PSA 147:5: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
verses.PSA 147:6: The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
verses.PSA 147:12: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
verses.PSA 147:13: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.
verses.PSA 147:14: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.
verses.PSA 147:15: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
verses.PSA 147:19: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
verses.PSA 147:20: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!
verses.PSA 147:16: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.
verses.PSA 148:1: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
verses.PSA 148:2: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!
verses.PSA 148:11: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,
verses.PSA 148:12: both young men and maidens, old men and children.
verses.PSA 148:13: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
verses.PSA 148:14: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!
verses.PSA 149:1: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
verses.PSA 149:2: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.PSA 149:3: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
verses.PSA 149:4: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
verses.PSA 149:5: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
verses.PSA 149:6: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
verses.PSA 149:9: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!
verses.PSA 150:1: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
verses.PSA 150:2: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!
verses.PSA 150:3: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!
verses.PSA 150:4: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
verses.PSA 150:5: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!
verses.PSA 150:6: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
verses.PSA 15:2: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
verses.PSA 15:3: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;
verses.PSA 15:4: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;
verses.PSA 15:5: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
verses.PSA 16:1: A Poem by David. Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.
verses.PSA 16:2: My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
verses.PSA 16:5: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
verses.PSA 16:7: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
verses.PSA 16:8: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.PSA 16:11: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
verses.PSA 16:9: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
verses.PSA 16:10: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
verses.PSA 16:4: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.
verses.PSA 17:1: A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.
verses.PSA 17:2: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.
verses.PSA 17:3: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.
verses.PSA 17:6: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.
verses.PSA 17:7: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.
verses.PSA 17:8: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
verses.PSA 17:15: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
verses.PSA 17:5: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
verses.PSA 18:1: For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of the LORD, who spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, I love you, LORD, my strength.
verses.PSA 18:2: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
verses.PSA 18:3: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.
verses.PSA 18:46: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,
verses.PSA 18:50: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.
verses.PSA 18:4: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
verses.PSA 18:5: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.
verses.PSA 18:6: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.
verses.PSA 18:30: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
verses.PSA 18:49: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
verses.PSA 19:1: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
verses.PSA 19:2: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
verses.PSA 19:3: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.
verses.PSA 19:4: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
verses.PSA 19:7: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.PSA 19:8: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.PSA 19:9: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
verses.PSA 19:10: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
verses.PSA 19:14: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.
verses.PSA 19:11: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
verses.PSA 19:12: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
verses.PSA 19:13: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
verses.PSA 1:1: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
verses.PSA 1:2: but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
verses.PSA 1:3: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
verses.PSA 1:4: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
verses.PSA 1:6: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
verses.PSA 21:1: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
verses.PSA 21:2: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.PSA 21:3: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
verses.PSA 21:4: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
verses.PSA 21:5: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.
verses.PSA 21:6: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
verses.PSA 22:25: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.
verses.PSA 22:26: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.
verses.PSA 22:27: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
verses.PSA 22:29: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.
verses.PSA 22:30: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
verses.PSA 22:31: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.
verses.PSA 22:28: For the kingdom is the LORD’s. He is the ruler over the nations.
verses.PSA 22:7: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
verses.PSA 22:8: “He trusts in the LORD. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
verses.PSA 22:16: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
verses.PSA 22:17: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.
verses.PSA 22:18: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.
verses.PSA 22:19: But don’t be far off, LORD. You are my help. Hurry to help me!
verses.PSA 22:22: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.
verses.PSA 22:23: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!
verses.PSA 23:1: A Psalm by David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
verses.PSA 23:2: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
verses.PSA 23:3: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
verses.PSA 23:5: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
verses.PSA 23:6: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.
verses.PSA 23:4: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
verses.PSA 24:1: A Psalm by David. The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
verses.PSA 24:2: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
verses.PSA 24:3: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
verses.PSA 24:4: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
verses.PSA 24:5: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.PSA 24:6: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.
verses.PSA 24:7: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
verses.PSA 24:8: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
verses.PSA 24:9: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
verses.PSA 24:10: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.
verses.PSA 25:2: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
verses.PSA 25:3: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
verses.PSA 25:4: Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.
verses.PSA 25:5: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
verses.PSA 25:6: LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
verses.PSA 25:7: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.
verses.PSA 25:8: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
verses.PSA 25:9: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
verses.PSA 25:10: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.PSA 25:14: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
verses.PSA 26:2: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
verses.PSA 26:3: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
verses.PSA 26:9: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men
verses.PSA 26:10: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.PSA 26:11: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
verses.PSA 26:12: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.
verses.PSA 27:1: By David. The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.PSA 27:2: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
verses.PSA 27:3: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.
verses.PSA 27:13: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.PSA 27:14: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
verses.PSA 27:5: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.
verses.PSA 27:8: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”
verses.PSA 27:9: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.
verses.PSA 27:4: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.
verses.PSA 27:7: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.
verses.PSA 28:2: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
verses.PSA 28:7: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
verses.PSA 28:8: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
verses.PSA 28:9: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
verses.PSA 29:1: A Psalm by David. Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
verses.PSA 29:2: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.
verses.PSA 29:3: The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.
verses.PSA 29:4: The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.
verses.PSA 29:9: The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
verses.PSA 29:10: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.
verses.PSA 2:1: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
verses.PSA 2:2: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying,
verses.PSA 2:3: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”
verses.PSA 2:4: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.
verses.PSA 2:5: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:
verses.PSA 2:6: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
verses.PSA 2:7: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.
verses.PSA 2:8: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
verses.PSA 2:9: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
verses.PSA 2:10: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
verses.PSA 2:11: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.PSA 30:1: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David. I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.PSA 30:3: LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.PSA 30:4: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
verses.PSA 30:5: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
verses.PSA 30:10: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”
verses.PSA 30:11: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
verses.PSA 30:12: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
verses.PSA 31:1: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
verses.PSA 31:5: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.
verses.PSA 31:11: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.
verses.PSA 31:12: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.
verses.PSA 31:14: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”
verses.PSA 31:15: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
verses.PSA 31:16: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.
verses.PSA 31:24: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
verses.PSA 31:2: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.
verses.PSA 31:3: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
verses.PSA 31:4: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.
verses.PSA 31:19: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!
verses.PSA 31:20: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.
verses.PSA 31:23: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.
verses.PSA 31:21: Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.
verses.PSA 31:22: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
verses.PSA 31:6: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.
verses.PSA 31:7: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.
verses.PSA 31:13: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.
verses.PSA 32:1: By David. A contemplative psalm. Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.PSA 32:2: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
verses.PSA 32:5: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.PSA 32:11: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
verses.PSA 32:6: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.
verses.PSA 32:7: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.PSA 33:1: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
verses.PSA 33:12: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.PSA 33:18: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
verses.PSA 33:19: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
verses.PSA 33:20: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.
verses.PSA 33:22: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.
verses.PSA 33:2: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
verses.PSA 33:4: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
verses.PSA 33:5: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.
verses.PSA 33:10: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
verses.PSA 33:11: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.PSA 33:13: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
verses.PSA 33:14: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
verses.PSA 33:15: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
verses.PSA 33:21: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.PSA 33:3: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!
verses.PSA 33:6: By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
verses.PSA 33:7: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
verses.PSA 33:8: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.PSA 33:9: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
verses.PSA 34:1: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
verses.PSA 34:8: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
verses.PSA 34:16: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
verses.PSA 34:17: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
verses.PSA 34:18: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
verses.PSA 34:19: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.
verses.PSA 34:2: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
verses.PSA 34:15: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
verses.PSA 34:20: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
verses.PSA 34:21: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
verses.PSA 34:22: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
verses.PSA 34:3: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
verses.PSA 34:4: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.PSA 34:5: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
verses.PSA 34:6: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.PSA 34:7: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
verses.PSA 34:9: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
verses.PSA 34:10: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.
verses.PSA 34:11: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
verses.PSA 34:12: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
verses.PSA 34:13: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
verses.PSA 34:14: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.PSA 36:5: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
verses.PSA 36:6: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.
verses.PSA 36:7: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
verses.PSA 36:8: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
verses.PSA 36:9: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
verses.PSA 36:10: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.PSA 37:3: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
verses.PSA 37:4: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
verses.PSA 37:18: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
verses.PSA 37:23: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.
verses.PSA 37:27: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
verses.PSA 37:29: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
verses.PSA 37:19: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.PSA 37:28: For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.PSA 37:39: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
verses.PSA 37:40: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.
verses.PSA 37:5: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
verses.PSA 37:6: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
verses.PSA 37:24: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.
verses.PSA 37:30: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
verses.PSA 37:31: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
verses.PSA 3:1: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
verses.PSA 3:2: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.
verses.PSA 3:3: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
verses.PSA 3:4: I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.
verses.PSA 3:5: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.
verses.PSA 3:6: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
verses.PSA 3:7: Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
verses.PSA 40:1: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
verses.PSA 40:2: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
verses.PSA 40:3: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
verses.PSA 40:17: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
verses.PSA 40:6: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
verses.PSA 40:7: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.
verses.PSA 40:8: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
verses.PSA 40:9: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.
verses.PSA 40:10: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.
verses.PSA 40:4: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
verses.PSA 40:16: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”
verses.PSA 41:1: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.
verses.PSA 41:2: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.
verses.PSA 41:3: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
verses.PSA 41:4: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
verses.PSA 41:12: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
verses.PSA 41:13: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
verses.PSA 42:1: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
verses.PSA 42:2: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?
verses.PSA 42:4: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.
verses.PSA 43:3: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
verses.PSA 43:4: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
verses.PSA 43:1: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
verses.PSA 43:2: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.PSA 44:9: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
verses.PSA 44:10: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
verses.PSA 44:13: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
verses.PSA 44:14: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.PSA 44:23: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
verses.PSA 44:24: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
verses.PSA 45:10: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.
verses.PSA 45:11: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
verses.PSA 45:13: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
verses.PSA 45:14: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.
verses.PSA 45:15: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.
verses.PSA 45:16: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.
verses.PSA 45:9: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.
verses.PSA 46:1: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.PSA 46:2: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
verses.PSA 46:3: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
verses.PSA 46:4: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
verses.PSA 46:5: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
verses.PSA 46:7: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.PSA 46:8: Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.
verses.PSA 47:1: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
verses.PSA 47:2: For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
verses.PSA 47:3: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.
verses.PSA 47:4: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
verses.PSA 47:5: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.PSA 47:6: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
verses.PSA 47:7: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
verses.PSA 47:8: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
verses.PSA 47:9: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!
verses.PSA 48:1: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
verses.PSA 48:2: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
verses.PSA 48:3: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
verses.PSA 48:4: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.
verses.PSA 48:5: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.
verses.PSA 48:6: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.PSA 48:7: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
verses.PSA 48:8: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.
verses.PSA 48:9: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
verses.PSA 48:10: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.PSA 49:1: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
verses.PSA 49:2: both low and high, rich and poor together.
verses.PSA 49:5: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
verses.PSA 49:6: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
verses.PSA 49:7: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
verses.PSA 49:8: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,
verses.PSA 49:9: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.
verses.PSA 49:10: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
verses.PSA 49:13: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.
verses.PSA 49:14: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.
verses.PSA 49:15: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.
verses.PSA 49:16: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
verses.PSA 49:17: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.
verses.PSA 49:18: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—
verses.PSA 49:19: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.
verses.PSA 4:1: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David. Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
verses.PSA 4:6: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.
verses.PSA 4:8: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.
verses.PSA 4:2: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.
verses.PSA 4:3: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.
verses.PSA 4:4: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.
verses.PSA 4:7: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
verses.PSA 50:1: A Psalm by Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
verses.PSA 50:8: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.
verses.PSA 50:12: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.
verses.PSA 50:13: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
verses.PSA 50:14: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.
verses.PSA 50:15: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
verses.PSA 50:16: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,
verses.PSA 50:17: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?
verses.PSA 50:20: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.
verses.PSA 50:21: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.
verses.PSA 50:2: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.
verses.PSA 50:5: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”
verses.PSA 50:6: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.
verses.PSA 50:18: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
verses.PSA 50:19: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
verses.PSA 50:22: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
verses.PSA 50:23: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”
verses.PSA 50:7: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
verses.PSA 50:9: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.
verses.PSA 50:10: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.
verses.PSA 50:11: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.
verses.PSA 51:1: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.
verses.PSA 51:2: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.
verses.PSA 51:10: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
verses.PSA 51:11: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.
verses.PSA 51:12: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
verses.PSA 51:13: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.
verses.PSA 51:15: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.
verses.PSA 51:17: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
verses.PSA 51:16: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.
verses.PSA 51:18: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.PSA 51:19: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.
verses.PSA 51:3: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.
verses.PSA 51:4: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
verses.PSA 51:5: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.
verses.PSA 51:8: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
verses.PSA 51:9: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.
verses.PSA 51:14: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.
verses.PSA 51:6: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
verses.PSA 51:7: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
verses.PSA 52:8: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.
verses.PSA 52:9: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.
verses.PSA 54:1: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Isn’t David hiding himself among us?” Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.
verses.PSA 54:2: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
verses.PSA 54:3: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.
verses.PSA 54:4: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
verses.PSA 54:6: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.
verses.PSA 55:6: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.
verses.PSA 55:7: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.
verses.PSA 55:8: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”
verses.PSA 55:9: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.PSA 55:10: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.
verses.PSA 55:22: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
verses.PSA 56:1: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
verses.PSA 56:2: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
verses.PSA 56:8: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
verses.PSA 56:9: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.
verses.PSA 56:10: In God, I will praise his word. In the LORD, I will praise his word.
verses.PSA 56:11: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
verses.PSA 56:12: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
verses.PSA 56:13: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
verses.PSA 57:1: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave. Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.
verses.PSA 57:2: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.
verses.PSA 57:3: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.
verses.PSA 57:5: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!
verses.PSA 57:10: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.
verses.PSA 57:7: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.
verses.PSA 57:8: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
verses.PSA 57:9: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.
verses.PSA 57:11: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
verses.PSA 59:1: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.
verses.PSA 59:2: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.
verses.PSA 59:3: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, LORD.
verses.PSA 59:9: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.
verses.PSA 59:10: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
verses.PSA 59:16: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
verses.PSA 59:17: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
verses.PSA 5:1: For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David. Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.
verses.PSA 5:2: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.
verses.PSA 5:4: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.
verses.PSA 5:5: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.
verses.PSA 5:6: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
verses.PSA 5:7: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.
verses.PSA 5:11: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.
verses.PSA 60:1: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
verses.PSA 60:2: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.
verses.PSA 60:3: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.
verses.PSA 60:10: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.
verses.PSA 60:11: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.
verses.PSA 60:12: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
verses.PSA 62:1: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
verses.PSA 62:2: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
verses.PSA 62:5: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
verses.PSA 62:6: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
verses.PSA 62:7: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
verses.PSA 62:8: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
verses.PSA 63:1: A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah. God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
verses.PSA 63:2: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
verses.PSA 63:3: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
verses.PSA 63:4: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
verses.PSA 63:5: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
verses.PSA 63:6: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
verses.PSA 63:7: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
verses.PSA 63:8: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
verses.PSA 65:9: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.
verses.PSA 65:10: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.
verses.PSA 65:11: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
verses.PSA 65:12: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.
verses.PSA 65:13: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
verses.PSA 66:1: For the Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
verses.PSA 66:2: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!
verses.PSA 66:3: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
verses.PSA 66:4: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.
verses.PSA 66:5: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
verses.PSA 66:6: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
verses.PSA 66:7: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.
verses.PSA 66:16: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
verses.PSA 66:20: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
verses.PSA 66:8: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,
verses.PSA 66:17: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.
verses.PSA 66:9: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
verses.PSA 67:1: For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.
verses.PSA 67:2: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
verses.PSA 67:4: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.
verses.PSA 67:5: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
verses.PSA 67:7: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.PSA 67:6: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

verses.PSA 68:3: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

verses.PSA 71:3: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

verses.PSA 79:1: A Psalm by Asaph. God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

verses.ROM 15:20: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.
verses.ROM 15:21: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”
verses.ROM 15:4: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
verses.ROM 15:5: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,
verses.ROM 15:6: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ROM 15:7: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
verses.ROM 15:8: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,
verses.ROM 15:9: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.”
verses.ROM 14:24: Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages,
verses.ROM 14:25: but now is revealed, and by the Scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known for obedience of faith to all the nations;
verses.ROM 14:26: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever! Amen.
verses.ROM 16:3: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
verses.ROM 16:4: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.
verses.ROM 16:5: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
verses.ROM 16:6: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
verses.ROM 16:7: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.
verses.ROM 16:8: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
verses.ROM 16:9: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.
verses.ROM 16:16: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
verses.ROM 16:22: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.
verses.ROM 16:23: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.
verses.ROM 16:24: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.
verses.ROM 1:1: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,
verses.ROM 1:2: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,
