verses.ROM 1:3: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,
verses.ROM 1:4: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,
verses.ROM 1:5: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;
verses.ROM 1:6: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;
verses.ROM 1:7: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ROM 1:16: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.
verses.ROM 1:17: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”
verses.ROM 1:18: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,
verses.ROM 1:19: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.
verses.ROM 1:20: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.
verses.ROM 1:21: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.
verses.ROM 1:22: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
verses.ROM 1:23: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.
verses.ROM 1:24: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;
verses.ROM 1:25: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.
verses.ROM 2:1: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.
verses.ROM 2:2: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.
verses.ROM 2:3: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?
verses.ROM 2:4: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?
verses.ROM 2:5: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,
verses.ROM 2:6: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”
verses.ROM 2:7: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;
verses.ROM 2:8: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
verses.ROM 2:9: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.ROM 2:10: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.ROM 2:11: For there is no partiality with God.
verses.ROM 3:21: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;
verses.ROM 3:22: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,
verses.ROM 3:23: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
verses.ROM 3:24: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,
verses.ROM 3:25: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;
verses.ROM 3:28: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
verses.ROM 3:26: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.
verses.ROM 3:27: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
verses.ROM 3:29: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,
verses.ROM 3:30: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.
verses.ROM 4:1: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?
verses.ROM 4:2: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
verses.ROM 4:3: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
verses.ROM 4:4: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.
verses.ROM 4:5: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.
verses.ROM 4:6: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:
verses.ROM 4:7: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
verses.ROM 4:8: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”
verses.ROM 4:13: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.ROM 4:16: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.
verses.ROM 4:17: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.
verses.ROM 4:18: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”
verses.ROM 4:22: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”
verses.ROM 4:19: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.
verses.ROM 4:20: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,
verses.ROM 4:21: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.
verses.ROM 4:23: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,
verses.ROM 4:24: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,
verses.ROM 4:25: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.
verses.ROM 5:1: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.ROM 5:2: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
verses.ROM 5:5: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
verses.ROM 5:6: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
verses.ROM 5:7: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.
verses.ROM 5:8: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.ROM 5:3: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;
verses.ROM 5:4: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;
verses.ROM 5:12: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.
verses.ROM 5:15: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.
verses.ROM 5:17: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.
verses.ROM 5:18: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.
verses.ROM 5:19: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
verses.ROM 5:20: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,
verses.ROM 5:21: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.ROM 5:13: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.
verses.ROM 5:14: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.
verses.ROM 5:16: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.
verses.ROM 5:9: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.
verses.ROM 5:10: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.
verses.ROM 5:11: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
verses.ROM 6:12: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.
verses.ROM 6:13: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
verses.ROM 6:14: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.
verses.ROM 6:15: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!
verses.ROM 6:16: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?
verses.ROM 6:17: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.
verses.ROM 6:18: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.
verses.ROM 6:19: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.
verses.ROM 6:20: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.
verses.ROM 6:21: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
verses.ROM 6:22: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.
verses.ROM 6:23: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.ROM 6:3: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
verses.ROM 6:4: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.
verses.ROM 6:5: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;
verses.ROM 6:6: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.
verses.ROM 6:7: For he who has died has been freed from sin.
verses.ROM 6:8: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,
verses.ROM 6:9: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!
verses.ROM 6:10: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.
verses.ROM 6:11: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.ROM 7:18: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.
verses.ROM 7:19: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.
verses.ROM 7:20: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
verses.ROM 7:21: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.
verses.ROM 7:22: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,
verses.ROM 7:23: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.
verses.ROM 7:24: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?
verses.ROM 7:25: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.
verses.ROM 8:1: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
verses.ROM 8:2: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
verses.ROM 8:3: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,
verses.ROM 8:4: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
verses.ROM 8:5: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
verses.ROM 8:6: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;
verses.ROM 8:7: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
verses.ROM 8:8: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.
verses.ROM 8:9: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.
verses.ROM 8:10: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.
verses.ROM 8:11: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.
verses.ROM 8:12: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
verses.ROM 8:13: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
verses.ROM 8:14: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
verses.ROM 8:15: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
verses.ROM 8:16: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;
verses.ROM 8:17: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.
verses.ROM 8:18: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
verses.ROM 8:19: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.
verses.ROM 8:20: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
verses.ROM 8:21: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
verses.ROM 8:22: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
verses.ROM 8:23: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.
verses.ROM 8:24: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
verses.ROM 8:25: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
verses.ROM 8:26: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
verses.ROM 8:27: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.
verses.ROM 8:28: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
verses.ROM 8:29: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.
verses.ROM 8:30: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.
verses.ROM 8:31: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
verses.ROM 8:32: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
verses.ROM 8:33: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.
verses.ROM 8:34: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.
verses.ROM 8:35: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verses.ROM 8:36: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
verses.ROM 8:37: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
verses.ROM 8:38: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
verses.ROM 8:39: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.ROM 9:1: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit
verses.ROM 9:2: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.
verses.ROM 9:3: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh
verses.ROM 9:4: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;
verses.ROM 9:5: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.
verses.RUT 1:1: In the days when the judges judged, there was a famine in the land. A certain man of Bethlehem Judah went to live in the country of Moab with his wife and his two sons.
verses.RUT 1:3: Elimelech, Naomi’s husband, died; and she was left with her two sons.
verses.RUT 1:4: They took for themselves wives of the women of Moab. The name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other was Ruth. They lived there about ten years.
verses.RUT 1:5: Mahlon and Chilion both died, and the woman was bereaved of her two children and of her husband.
verses.RUT 1:6: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law, that she might return from the country of Moab; for she had heard in the country of Moab how the LORD had visited his people in giving them bread.
verses.RUT 1:14: They lifted up their voices and wept again; then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth stayed with her.
verses.RUT 1:15: She said, “Behold, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her god. Follow your sister-in-law.”
verses.RUT 1:16: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.
verses.RUT 1:22: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, with her, who returned out of the country of Moab. They came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.RUT 2:1: Naomi had a relative of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz.
verses.RUT 2:2: Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I find favor.” She said to her, “Go, my daughter.”
verses.RUT 2:3: She went, and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers; and she happened to come to the portion of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.
verses.RUT 2:8: Then Boaz said to Ruth, “Listen, my daughter. Don’t go to glean in another field, and don’t go from here, but stay here close to my maidens.
verses.RUT 2:9: Let your eyes be on the field that they reap, and go after them. Haven’t I commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn.”
verses.RUT 2:10: Then she fell on her face and bowed herself to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found favor in your sight, that you should take knowledge of me, since I am a foreigner?”
verses.RUT 2:11: Boaz answered her, “I have been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, and how you have left your father, your mother, and the land of your birth, and have come to a people that you didn’t know before.
verses.RUT 4:13: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife; and he went in to her, and the LORD enabled her to conceive, and she bore a son.
verses.RUT 4:14: The women said to Naomi, “Blessed be the LORD, who has not left you today without a near kinsman. Let his name be famous in Israel.
verses.RUT 4:15: He shall be to you a restorer of life and sustain you in your old age; for your daughter-in-law, who loves you, who is better to you than seven sons, has given birth to him.”
verses.RUT 4:16: Naomi took the child, laid him in her bosom, and became nurse to him.
verses.RUT 4:17: The women, her neighbors, gave him a name, saying, “A son is born to Naomi”. They named him Obed. He is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
verses.REV 10:8: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”
verses.REV 10:9: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”
verses.REV 10:10: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.
verses.REV 10:11: They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”
verses.REV 11:19: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.
verses.REV 12:1: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.
verses.REV 12:3: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.
verses.REV 12:4: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.
verses.REV 12:5: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God and to his throne.
verses.REV 12:6: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.
verses.REV 12:10: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.
verses.REV 12:2: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.
verses.REV 11:4: These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.
verses.REV 11:5: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.
verses.REV 11:6: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.
verses.REV 11:7: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.
verses.REV 11:8: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.
verses.REV 11:9: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations, people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.
verses.REV 11:10: Those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.
verses.REV 11:11: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.
verses.REV 11:12: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.
verses.REV 12:11: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.
verses.REV 12:12: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.”
verses.REV 12:7: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.
verses.REV 12:8: They didn’t prevail. No place was found for them any more in heaven.
verses.REV 12:9: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.
verses.REV 14:1: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.
verses.REV 14:2: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.
verses.REV 14:3: They sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.
verses.REV 14:4: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.
verses.REV 14:5: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.
verses.REV 14:14: I looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
verses.REV 14:15: Another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”
verses.REV 14:16: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.
verses.REV 14:17: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.
verses.REV 14:18: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”
verses.REV 14:19: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth and threw it into the great wine press of the wrath of God.
verses.REV 14:20: The wine press was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out of the wine press, up to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia.
verses.REV 15:1: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.
verses.REV 15:2: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.
verses.REV 15:3: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.
verses.REV 15:4: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”
verses.REV 18:1: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.
verses.REV 18:2: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hated bird!
verses.REV 18:21: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.
verses.REV 18:22: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman of whatever craft will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.
verses.REV 18:23: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you, for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.
verses.REV 19:1: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God;
verses.REV 19:2: for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”
verses.REV 19:3: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”
verses.REV 19:9: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”
verses.REV 19:5: A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”
verses.REV 19:6: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!
verses.REV 19:7: Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”
verses.REV 19:8: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.
verses.REV 1:1: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,
verses.REV 1:2: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.
verses.REV 1:3: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.
verses.REV 1:4: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;
verses.REV 2:1: “To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: “He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lamp stands says these things:
verses.REV 2:2: “I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.
verses.REV 2:3: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary.
verses.REV 2:4: But I have this against you, that you left your first love.
verses.REV 2:5: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly, and will move your lamp stand out of its place, unless you repent.
verses.REV 1:7: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.
verses.REV 1:9: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.REV 1:10: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet
verses.REV 1:11: saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”
verses.REV 1:12: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.
verses.REV 1:13: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.
verses.REV 1:17: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last,
verses.REV 1:18: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
verses.REV 1:19: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter.
verses.REV 20:1: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
verses.REV 20:2: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,
verses.REV 20:3: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.
verses.REV 20:4: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
verses.REV 20:11: I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the sky fled away. There was found no place for them.
verses.REV 20:12: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.
verses.REV 20:13: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.
verses.REV 20:14: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.
verses.REV 20:15: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.
verses.REV 21:1: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.
verses.REV 21:2: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.
verses.REV 21:3: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.
verses.REV 21:4: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”
verses.REV 21:5: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
verses.REV 21:10: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,
verses.REV 21:11: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
verses.REV 21:12: having a great and high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.
verses.REV 21:13: On the east were three gates, and on the north three gates, and on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.
verses.REV 21:14: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.
verses.REV 21:22: I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
verses.REV 21:23: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb.
verses.REV 21:6: He said to me, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.
verses.REV 21:7: He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.
verses.REV 21:9: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls which were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.”
verses.REV 22:1: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,
verses.REV 22:2: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
verses.REV 22:3: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.
verses.REV 22:4: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
verses.REV 22:5: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.
verses.REV 22:6: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”
verses.REV 22:7: “Behold, I am coming soon! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
verses.REV 22:12: “Behold, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
verses.REV 22:13: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
verses.REV 22:14: Blessed are those who do his commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.
verses.REV 22:16: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David, the Bright and Morning Star.”
verses.REV 22:17: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.
verses.REV 22:20: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!
verses.REV 2:10: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.
verses.REV 2:8: “To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these things:
verses.REV 2:9: “I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
verses.REV 2:11: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.
verses.REV 3:1: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.
verses.REV 3:2: Wake up and strengthen the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.
verses.REV 3:3: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.
verses.REV 3:4: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that didn’t defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.
verses.REV 3:5: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
verses.REV 3:6: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
verses.REV 3:14: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of God’s creation, says these things:
verses.REV 3:15: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.
verses.REV 3:16: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.
verses.REV 3:17: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing,’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;
verses.REV 3:18: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.
verses.REV 3:19: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
verses.REV 3:20: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.
verses.REV 3:21: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.
verses.REV 3:22: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”
verses.REV 4:1: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”
verses.REV 4:2: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne
verses.REV 4:3: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.
verses.REV 4:4: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.
verses.REV 4:5: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
verses.REV 4:6: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.
verses.REV 4:7: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
verses.REV 4:8: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”
verses.REV 4:9: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,
verses.REV 4:10: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,
verses.REV 4:11: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”
verses.REV 5:1: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.
verses.REV 5:2: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”
verses.REV 5:3: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.
verses.REV 5:4: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.
verses.REV 5:5: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”
verses.REV 5:6: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.
verses.REV 5:7: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.
verses.REV 5:8: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
verses.REV 5:9: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,
verses.REV 5:10: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”
verses.REV 5:11: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,
verses.REV 5:12: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”
verses.REV 5:13: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”
verses.REV 5:14: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.
verses.REV 7:2: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,
verses.REV 7:3: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”
verses.REV 7:4: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:
verses.REV 7:9: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.
verses.REV 7:10: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”
verses.REV 7:11: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,
verses.REV 7:12: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
verses.REV 7:13: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?”
verses.REV 7:14: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great suffering. They washed their robes and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.
verses.REV 7:15: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.
verses.REV 7:16: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;
verses.REV 7:17: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”
verses.SOL 2:8: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.
verses.SOL 2:9: My beloved is like a roe or a young deer. Behold, he stands behind our wall! He looks in at the windows. He glances through the lattice.
verses.SOL 2:10: My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.
verses.SOL 2:11: For behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone.
verses.SOL 2:12: The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.
verses.SOL 2:13: The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.”
verses.SOL 2:14: My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places of the mountainside, let me see your face. Let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet and your face is lovely.
verses.SOL 3:1: By night on my bed, I sought him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.
verses.SOL 3:2: I will get up now, and go about the city; in the streets and in the squares I will seek him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.
verses.SOL 3:3: The watchmen who go about the city found me; “Have you seen him whom my soul loves?”
verses.SOL 3:4: I had scarcely passed from them, when I found him whom my soul loves. I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother’s house, into the room of her who conceived me.
verses.SOL 8:6: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of the LORD.
verses.SOL 8:7: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.
verses.SIR 15:1: He who fears the Lord will do this. He who has possession of the law will obtain her.
verses.SIR 15:2: She will meet him like a mother, and receive him like a wife married in her virginity.
verses.SIR 15:3: She will feed him with bread of understanding and give him water of wisdom to drink.
verses.SIR 15:4: He will be stayed upon her, and will not be moved. He will rely upon her, and will not be confounded.
verses.SIR 15:5: She will exalt him above his neighbors. She will open his mouth in the midst of the congregation.
verses.SIR 15:6: He will inherit joy, a crown of gladness, and an everlasting name.
verses.SIR 15:15: If you choose, you can keep the commandments. To be faithful is a matter of your choice.
verses.SIR 15:16: He has set fire and water before you. You will stretch forth your hand to whichever you desire.
verses.SIR 15:17: Before man is life and death. Whichever he likes, it will be given to him.
verses.SIR 15:18: For the wisdom of the Lord is great. He is mighty in power, and sees all things.
verses.SIR 15:19: His eyes are upon those who fear him. He knows every act of man.
verses.SIR 15:20: He has not commanded any man to be ungodly. He has not given any man license to sin.
verses.SIR 17:1: The Lord created mankind out of earth, and turned them back to it again.
verses.SIR 17:2: He gave them days by number, and a set time, and gave them authority over the things that are on it.
verses.SIR 17:3: He endowed them with strength proper to them, and made them according to his own image.
verses.SIR 17:4: He put the fear of man upon all flesh, and gave him dominion over beasts and birds.
verses.SIR 17:6: He gave them counsel, tongue, eyes, ears, and heart to have understanding.
verses.SIR 17:7: He filled them with the knowledge of wisdom, and showed them good and evil.
verses.SIR 17:8: He set his eye upon their hearts, to show them the majesty of his works.
verses.SIR 17:10: And they will praise his holy name, that they may declare the majesty of his works.
verses.SIR 17:11: He added to them knowledge, and gave them a law of life for a heritage.
verses.SIR 17:12: He made an everlasting covenant with them, and showed them his decrees.
verses.SIR 17:13: Their eyes saw the majesty of his glory. Their ears heard the glory of his voice.
verses.SIR 17:14: He said to them, “Beware of all unrighteousness.” So he gave them commandment, each man concerning his neighbor.
verses.SIR 17:15: Their ways are ever before him. They will not be hidden from his eyes.
verses.SIR 17:20: Their iniquities are not hidden from him. All their sins are before the Lord.
verses.SIR 17:22: With him the alms of a man is as a signet. He will keep a man’s kindness as the pupil of the eye.
verses.SIR 17:23: Afterwards he will rise up and repay them, and give their repayment upon their head.
verses.SIR 17:24: However to those who repent he grants a return. He comforts those who are losing hope.
verses.SIR 17:25: Return to the Lord, and forsake sins. Make your prayer before his face offend less.
verses.SIR 17:26: Turn again to the Most High, and turn away from iniquity. Greatly hate the abominable thing.
verses.SIR 17:27: Who will give praise to the Most High in Hades, in place of the living who return thanks?
verses.SIR 17:28: Thanksgiving perishes from the dead, as from one who doesn’t exist. He who is in life and health will praise the Lord.
verses.SIR 17:29: How great is the mercy of the Lord, and his forgiveness to those who turn to him!
verses.SIR 1:1: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and is with him forever.
verses.SIR 1:2: Who can count the sand of the seas, the drops of rain, and the days of eternity?
verses.SIR 1:3: Who will search out the height of the sky, the breadth of the earth, the deep, and wisdom?
verses.SIR 1:4: Wisdom has been created before all things, and the understanding of prudence from everlasting.
verses.SIR 1:6: To whom has the root of wisdom been revealed? Who has known her shrewd counsels?
verses.SIR 1:8: There is one wise, greatly to be feared, sitting upon his throne: the Lord.
verses.SIR 1:9: He created her. He saw and measured her. He poured her out upon all his works.
verses.SIR 1:10: She is with all flesh according to his gift. He gave her freely to those who love him.
verses.SIR 24:1: Wisdom will praise her own soul, and will proclaim her glory in the midst of her people.
verses.SIR 24:3: “I came out of the mouth of the Most High, and covered the earth as a mist.
verses.SIR 24:4: I lived in high places, and my throne is in the pillar of the cloud.
verses.SIR 24:8: Then the Creator of all things gave me a command. He who created me made my tent to rest, and said, ‘Let your dwelling be in Jacob, and your inheritance in Israel.’
verses.SIR 24:9: He created me from the beginning, before the ages. For all ages, I will not cease to exist.
verses.SIR 24:10: In the holy tabernacle, I ministered before him. So I was established in Zion.
verses.SIR 24:11: In the beloved city, likewise he gave me rest. In Jerusalem was my domain.
verses.SIR 24:12: I took root in a people that was honored, even in the portion of the Lord’s own inheritance.
verses.SIR 24:19: “Come to me, all you who desire me, and be filled with my fruits.
verses.SIR 24:20: For my memory is sweeter than honey, and my inheritance than the honeycomb.
verses.SIR 24:21: Those who eat me will be hungry for more. Those who drink me will be thirsty for more.
verses.SIR 24:22: He who obeys me will not be ashamed. Those who work with me will not sin.”
verses.SIR 24:2: She will open her mouth in the congregation of the Most High, and proclaim her glory in the presence of his power.
verses.SIR 26:1: Happy is the husband of a good wife. The number of his days will be doubled.
verses.SIR 26:2: A faithful wife gives joy to her husband. He will fulfill his years in peace.
verses.SIR 26:3: A good wife is a great gift. She will be given to those who fear the Lord.
verses.SIR 26:4: Whether a man is rich or poor, a good heart makes a cheerful face at all times.
verses.SIR 26:13: The grace of a wife will delight her husband. Her knowledge will strengthen his bones.
verses.SIR 26:14: A silent woman is a gift of the Lord. There is nothing worth so much as a well-instructed soul.
verses.SIR 26:15: A modest woman is grace upon grace. There are no scales that can weigh the value of a self-controlled soul.
verses.SIR 26:16: As the sun when it arises in the highest places of the Lord, so is the beauty of a good wife in her well-organized home.
verses.SIR 27:30: Wrath and anger, these also are abominations. A sinner will possess them.
verses.SIR 28:1: He who takes vengeance will find vengeance from the Lord, and he will surely make his sins firm.
verses.SIR 28:2: Forgive your neighbor the hurt that he has done, and then your sins will be pardoned when you pray.
verses.SIR 28:3: Does anyone harbor anger against another and expect healing from the Lord?
verses.SIR 28:4: Upon a man like himself he has no mercy, and does he make supplication for his own sins?
verses.SIR 28:5: He himself, being flesh, nourishes wrath. Who will make atonement for his sins?
verses.SIR 28:6: Remember your last end, and stop enmity. Remember corruption and death, and be true to the commandments.
verses.SIR 28:7: Remember the commandments, and don’t be angry with your neighbor. Remember the covenant of the Highest, and overlook ignorance.
verses.SIR 27:4: In the shaking of a sieve, the refuse remains, so does the filth of man in his thoughts.
verses.SIR 27:5: The furnace tests the potter’s vessels; so the test of a person is in his thoughts.
verses.SIR 27:6: The fruit of a tree discloses its cultivation, so is the utterance of the thought of a person’s heart.
verses.SIR 27:7: Praise no man before you hear his thoughts, for this is how people are tested.
verses.SIR 2:1: My son, if you come to serve the Lord, prepare your soul for temptation.
verses.SIR 2:2: Set your heart aright, constantly endure, and don’t make haste in time of calamity.
verses.SIR 2:3: Cling to him, and don’t depart, that you may be increased at your latter end.
verses.SIR 2:4: Accept whatever is brought upon you, and be patient when you suffer humiliation.
verses.SIR 2:5: For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of humiliation.
verses.SIR 2:6: Put your trust in him, and he will help you. Make your ways straight, and set your hope on him.
verses.SIR 2:7: All you who fear the Lord, wait for his mercy. Don’t turn aside, lest you fall.
verses.SIR 2:8: All you who fear the Lord, put your trust in him, and your reward will not fail.
verses.SIR 2:9: All you who fear the Lord, hope for good things, and for eternal gladness and mercy.
verses.SIR 2:10: Look at the generations of old, and see: Who ever put his trust in the Lord, and was ashamed? Or who remained in his fear, and was forsaken? Or who called upon him, and he neglected him?
verses.SIR 2:11: For the Lord is full of compassion and mercy. He forgives sins and saves in time of affliction.
verses.SIR 2:12: Woe to fearful hearts, to faint hands, and to the sinner who goes two ways!
verses.SIR 2:13: Woe to the faint heart! For it doesn’t believe. Therefore it won’t be defended.
verses.SIR 35:1: He who keeps the law multiplies offerings. He who heeds the commandments sacrifices a peace offering.
verses.SIR 35:2: He who returns a kindness offers fine flour. He who gives alms sacrifices a thank offering.
verses.SIR 35:3: To depart from wickedness pleases the Lord. To depart from unrighteousness is an atoning sacrifice.
verses.SIR 35:4: See that you don’t appear in the presence of the Lord empty.
verses.SIR 35:5: For all these things are done because of the commandment.
verses.SIR 35:6: The offering of the righteous enriches the altar. The sweet fragrance of it is before the Most High.
verses.SIR 35:7: The sacrifice of a righteous man is acceptable. It won’t be forgotten.
verses.SIR 35:8: Glorify the Lord with generosity. Don’t reduce the first fruits of your hands.
verses.SIR 35:9: In every gift show a cheerful countenance, And dedicate your tithe with gladness.
verses.SIR 35:10: Give to the Most High according as he has given. As your hand has found, give generously.
verses.SIR 35:11: For the Lord repays, and he will repay you sevenfold.
verses.SIR 35:12: Don’t plan to bribe him with gifts, for he will not receive them. Don’t set your mind on an unrighteous sacrifice, For the Lord is the judge, and with him is no respect of persons.
verses.SIR 35:13: He won’t accept any person against a poor man. He will listen to the prayer of him who is wronged.
verses.SIR 35:14: He will in no way despise the supplication of the fatherless or the widow, when she pours out her tale.
verses.SIR 35:16: He who serves God according to his good pleasure will be accepted. His supplication will reach to the clouds.
verses.SIR 35:17: The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds. until it comes near, he will not be comforted. He won’t depart until the Most High visits and he judges righteously and executes judgment.
verses.SIR 35:18: And the Lord will not be slack, neither will he be patient toward them, until he has crushed the loins of the unmerciful. He will repay vengeance to the heathen until he has taken away the multitude of the arrogant and broken in pieces the sceptres of the unrighteous,
verses.SIR 36:1: Have mercy upon us, O Lord the God of all, and look at us with favor;
verses.SIR 36:2: and send your fear upon all the nations.
verses.SIR 36:4: As you showed your holiness in us before them, so be magnified in them before us.
verses.SIR 36:5: Let them know you, as we also have known you, that there is no God but only you, O God.
verses.SIR 36:9: Let him who escapes be devoured by raging fire. May those who harm your people find destruction.
verses.SIR 36:10: Crush the heads of the rulers of the enemies who say, “There is no one but ourselves.”
verses.SIR 36:11: Gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and take them for your inheritance, as from the beginning.
verses.SIR 36:12: O Lord, have mercy upon the people that is called by your name, and upon Israel, whom you likened to a firstborn.
verses.SIR 36:13: Have compassion upon the city of your sanctuary, Jerusalem, the place of your rest.
verses.SIR 36:14: Fill Zion. Exalt your oracles and fill your people with your glory.
verses.SIR 36:15: Give testimony to those who were your creatures in the beginning, and fulfill the prophecies that have been spoken in your name.
verses.SIR 36:16: Reward those who wait for you, and men will put their trust in your prophets.
verses.SIR 36:17: Listen, O Lord, to the prayer of your servants, according to the blessing of Aaron concerning your people; and all those who are on the earth will know that you are the Lord, the eternal God.
verses.SIR 39:6: If the great Lord wills, he will be filled with the spirit of understanding; he will pour forth the words of his wisdom and in prayer give thanks to the Lord.
verses.SIR 39:7: He will direct his counsel and knowledge, and he will meditate in his secrets.
verses.SIR 39:8: He will show the instruction which he has been taught and will glory in the law of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.SIR 39:9: Many will commend his understanding. So long as the world endures, it won’t be blotted out. His memory won’t depart. His name will live from generation to generation.
verses.SIR 39:10: Nations will declare his wisdom. The congregation will proclaim his praise.
verses.SIR 3:17: My son, go on with your business in humility; so you will be loved by an acceptable man.
verses.SIR 3:18: The greater you are, humble yourself the more, and you will find favor before the Lord.
verses.SIR 3:20: For the power of the Lord is great, and he is glorified by those who are lowly.
verses.SIR 3:28: The calamity of the proud has no healing, for a weed of wickedness has taken root in him.
verses.SIR 3:29: The heart of the prudent will understand a proverb. A wise man desires the ear of a listener.
verses.SIR 3:21: Don’t seek things that are too hard for you, and don’t search out things that are above your strength.
verses.SIR 3:22: Think about the things that have been commanded you, for you have no need of the things that are secret.
verses.SIR 3:23: Don’t be overly busy in tasks that are beyond you, for more things are shown to you than men can understand.
verses.SIR 3:24: For the conceit of many has led them astray. Evil opinion has caused their judgment to slip.
verses.SIR 3:2: For the Lord honors the father over the children, and has confirmed the judgment of the mother over her sons.
verses.SIR 3:3: He who honors his father will make atonement for sins.
verses.SIR 3:4: He who gives glory to his mother is as one who lays up treasure.
verses.SIR 3:5: Whoever honors his father will have joy in his own children. He will be heard in the day of his prayer.
verses.SIR 3:6: He who gives glory to his father will have length of days. He who listens to the Lord will bring rest to his mother,
verses.SIR 3:7: and will serve under his parents, as to masters.
verses.SIR 3:12: My son, help your father in his old age, and don’t grieve him as long as he lives.
verses.SIR 3:13: If he fails in understanding, have patience with him. Don’t dishonor him in your full strength.
verses.SIR 3:14: For the kindness to your father will not be forgotten. Instead of sins it will be added to build you up.
verses.SIR 42:15: I will make mention now of the works of the Lord, and will declare the things that I have seen. The Lord’s works are in his words.
verses.SIR 42:16: The sun that gives light looks at all things. The Lord’s work is full of his glory.
verses.SIR 42:17: The Lord has not given power to the saints to declare all his marvelous works, which the Almighty Lord firmly settled, that the universe might be established in his glory.
verses.SIR 42:18: He searches out the deep and the heart. He has understanding of their secrets. For the Most High knows all knowledge. He sees the signs of the world.
verses.SIR 42:19: He declares the things that are past and the things that shall be, and reveals the traces of hidden things.
verses.SIR 42:20: No thought escapes him. There is not a word hidden from him.
verses.SIR 42:21: He has ordered the mighty works of his wisdom. He is from everlasting to everlasting. Nothing has been added to them, nor diminished from them. He had no need of any counselor.
verses.SIR 42:22: How desirable are all his works! One may see this even in a spark.
verses.SIR 42:23: All these things live and remain forever in all manner of uses. They are all obedient.
verses.SIR 42:24: All things are in pairs, one opposite the other. He has made nothing imperfect.
verses.SIR 42:25: One thing establishes the good things of another. Who could ever see enough of his glory?
verses.SIR 44:1: Let us now praise famous men, our ancestors in their generations.
verses.SIR 44:10: But these were men of mercy, whose righteous deeds have not been forgotten.
verses.SIR 44:11: A good inheritance remains with their offspring. Their children are within the covenant.
verses.SIR 44:12: Their offspring stand fast, with their children, for their sakes.
verses.SIR 44:13: Their offspring will remain forever. Their glory won’t be blotted out.
verses.SIR 44:14: Their bodies were buried in peace. Their name lives to all generations.
verses.SIR 44:15: People will declare their wisdom. The congregation proclaims their praise.
verses.SIR 44:9: But of others, there is no memory. They perished as though they had not been. They become as though they had not been born, they and their children after them.
verses.SIR 47:2: As is the fat when it is separated from the peace offering, so was David separated from the children of Israel.
verses.SIR 47:3: He played with lions as with kids, and with bears as with lambs of the flock.
verses.SIR 47:4: In his youth didn’t he kill a giant, and take away reproach from the people when he lifted up his hand with a sling stone, and beat down the boasting Goliath?
verses.SIR 47:5: For he called upon the Most High Lord, and he gave him strength in his right hand to kill a man mighty in war, to exalt the horn of his people.
verses.SIR 47:6: So they glorified him for his tens of thousands, and praised him for the blessings of the Lord, in that a glorious diadem was given to him.
verses.SIR 47:7: For he destroyed the enemies on every side, and defeated the Philistines his adversaries. He broke their horn in pieces to this day.
verses.SIR 47:8: In every work of his he gave thanks to the Holy One Most High with words of glory. He sang praise with his whole heart, and loved him who made him.
verses.SIR 47:9: He set singers before the altar, to make sweet melody by their music.
verses.SIR 47:10: He gave beauty to the feasts, and set in order the seasons to completion while they praised his holy name, and the sanctuary resounded from early morning.
verses.SIR 47:11: The Lord took away his sins, and exalted his horn forever. He gave him a covenant of kings, and a glorious throne in Israel.
verses.SIR 48:1: Then Elijah arose, the prophet like fire. His word burned like a torch.
verses.SIR 48:2: He brought a famine upon them, and by his zeal made them few in number.
verses.SIR 48:3: By the word of the Lord he shut up the heavens. He brought down fire three times.
verses.SIR 48:4: How you were glorified, O Elijah, in your wondrous deeds! Whose glory is like yours?
verses.SIR 48:5: You raised up a dead man from death, from Hades, by the word of the Most High.
verses.SIR 48:6: You brought down kings to destruction, and honorable men from their sickbeds.
verses.SIR 48:7: You heard rebuke in Sinai, and judgments of vengeance in Horeb.
verses.SIR 48:8: You anointed kings for retribution, and prophets to succeed after you.
verses.SIR 48:9: You were taken up in a tempest of fire, in a chariot of fiery horses.
verses.SIR 48:10: You were recorded for reproofs in their seasons, to pacify anger, before it broke out into wrath, to turn the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.
verses.SIR 48:11: Blessed are those who saw you, and those who have been beautified with love; for we also shall surely live.
verses.SIR 48:12: Elijah was wrapped in a whirlwind. Elisha was filled with his spirit. In his days he was not moved by the fear of any ruler, and no one brought him into subjection.
verses.SIR 48:13: Nothing was too hard for him. When he was buried, his body prophesied.
verses.SIR 48:14: As in his life he did wonders, so his works were also marvelous in death.
verses.SIR 48:15: For all this the people didn’t repent. They didn’t depart from their sins, until they were carried away as a plunder from their land, and were scattered through all the earth. The people were left very few in number, but with a ruler from the house of David.
verses.SIR 4:11: Wisdom exalts her sons, and takes hold of those who seek her.
verses.SIR 4:12: He who loves her loves life. Those who seek her early will be filled with gladness.
verses.SIR 4:13: He who holds her fast will inherit glory. Where he enters, the Lord will bless.
verses.SIR 4:14: Those who serve her minister to the Holy One. The Lord loves those who love her.
verses.SIR 4:15: He who listens to her will judge the nations. He who heeds her will dwell securely.
verses.SIR 4:16: If he trusts her, he will inherit her, and his generations will possess her.
verses.SIR 4:17: For at the first she will walk with him in crooked ways, and will bring fear and dread upon him, and torment him with her discipline, until she may trust his soul, and try him by her judgments.
verses.SIR 4:18: Then she will return him again to the straight way, and will gladden him, and reveal to him her secrets.
verses.SIR 4:19: If he goes astray, she will forsake him, and hand him over to his fall.
verses.SIR 51:1: I will give thanks to you, O Lord, O King, and will praise you, O God my Savior. I give thanks to your name,
verses.SIR 51:2: for you have been my protector and helper, and delivered my body out of destruction, and out of the snare of a slanderous tongue, from lips that fabricate lies. You were my helper before those who stood by,
verses.SIR 51:3: and delivered me, according to the abundance of your mercy and of your name, from the gnashings of teeth ready to devour, out of the hand of those seeking my life, out of the many afflictions I endured,
verses.SIR 51:4: from the choking of a fire on every side, and out of the midst of fire that I hadn’t kindled,
verses.SIR 51:5: out of the depth of the belly of Hades, from an unclean tongue, and from lying words—
verses.SIR 51:6: the slander of an unrighteous tongue to the king. My soul drew near to death. My life was near to Hades.
verses.SIR 51:7: They surrounded me on every side. There was no one to help me. I was looking for human help, and there was none.
verses.SIR 51:8: Then I remembered your mercy, O Lord, and your working which has been from everlasting, how you deliver those who wait for you, and save them out of the hand of their enemies.
verses.SIR 51:12: You saved me from destruction and delivered me from the evil time. Therefore I will give thanks and praise to you, and bless the name of the Lord.
verses.SIR 51:13: When I was yet young, before I went abroad, I sought wisdom openly in my prayer.
verses.SIR 51:14: Before the temple I asked for her. I will seek her out even to the end.
verses.SIR 51:15: From the first flower to the ripening grape my heart delighted in her. My foot walked in uprightness. From my youth I followed her steps.
verses.SIR 51:16: I inclined my ear a little, and received her, and found for myself much instruction.
verses.SIR 51:17: I profited in her. I will give glory to him who gives me wisdom.
verses.SIR 51:18: For I determined to practice her. I was zealous for that which is good. I will never be put to shame.
verses.SIR 51:19: My soul has wrestled with her. In my conduct I was exact. I spread out my hands to the sky above, and bewailed my ignorances of her.
verses.SIR 51:20: I directed my soul to her. In purity I found her. I got myself a heart joined with her from the beginning. Therefore I won’t be forsaken.
verses.SIR 5:1: Don’t set your heart upon your goods. Don’t say, “They are sufficient for me.”
verses.SIR 5:2: Don’t follow your own mind and your strength to walk in the desires of your heart.
verses.SIR 5:3: Don’t say, “Who will have dominion over me?” for the Lord will surely take vengeance on you.
verses.SIR 5:4: Don’t say, “I sinned, and what happened to me?” for the Lord is patient.
verses.SIR 5:5: Don’t be so confident of atonement that you add sin upon sins.
verses.SIR 5:6: Don’t say, “His compassion is great. He will be pacified for the multitude of my sins,” for mercy and wrath are with him, and his indignation will rest on sinners.
verses.SIR 5:7: Don’t wait to turn to the Lord. Don’t put off from day to day; for suddenly the wrath of the Lord will come on you, and you will perish in the time of vengeance.
verses.SIR 5:8: Don’t set your heart upon unrighteous gains, for you will profit nothing in the day of calamity.
verses.SIR 6:5: Sweet words will multiply a man’s friends. A gracious tongue will multiply courtesies.
verses.SIR 6:6: Let those that are at peace with you be many, but your advisers one of a thousand.
verses.SIR 6:7: If you want to gain a friend, get him in a time of testing, and don’t be in a hurry to trust him.
verses.SIR 6:8: For there is a friend just for an occasion. He won’t continue in the day of your affliction.
verses.SIR 6:9: And there is a friend who turns into an enemy. He will discover strife to your reproach.
verses.SIR 6:10: And there is a friend who is a companion at the table, but he won’t continue in the day of your affliction.
verses.SIR 6:11: In your prosperity he will be as yourself, and will be bold over your servants.
verses.SIR 6:12: If you are brought low, he will be against you, and will hide himself from your face.
verses.SIR 6:13: Separate yourself from your enemies, and beware of your friends.
verses.SIR 6:14: A faithful friend is a strong defense. He who has found him has found a treasure.
verses.SIR 6:15: There is nothing that can be taken in exchange for a faithful friend. His excellency is beyond price.
verses.SIR 6:16: A faithful friend is a life-saving medicine. Those who fear the Lord will find him.
verses.SIR 6:17: He who fears the Lord directs his friendship properly; for as he is, so is his neighbor also.
verses.TOB 11:5: Anna sat looking around toward the path for her son.
verses.TOB 11:6: She saw him coming, and said to his father, “Behold, your son is coming with the man that went with him!”
verses.TOB 11:7: Raphael said, “I know, Tobias, that your father will open his eyes.
verses.TOB 11:8: Therefore anoint his eyes with the bile, and being pricked with it, he will rub, and will make the white films fall away. Then he will see you.”
verses.TOB 11:9: Anna ran to him, and fell upon the neck of her son, and said to him, “I have seen you, my child! I am ready to die.” They both wept.
verses.TOB 11:10: Tobit went toward the door and stumbled; but his son ran to him,
verses.TOB 11:11: and took hold of his father. He rubbed the bile on his father’s eyes, saying, “Cheer up, my father.”
verses.TOB 11:12: When his eyes began to hurt, he rubbed them.
